Construction technology is being reinvented. Be part of it.

Construction is one of the world's largest industries, and one of its least digitized. That is changing fast. At Hilti, we are not only developing software products - we are building and growing digital businesses around them. Hilti is at the centre of that shift, with a growing portfolio of software products that connect jobsites, offices, teams, and tools across the entire construction lifecycle. We are looking for ambitious, internationally mobile early-career talents with a global mindset who are excited about technology but see their future in business and leadership rather than in a purely technical software career.

The Software & Digital Business Track of Hilti's Outperformer Program is a two-year accelerated development program that prepares you for a commercial, international leadership career in our software and digital businesses. You will learn how technology becomes customer value, how software businesses grow, how products are brought to market, and how commercial decisions are made. This is not a rotation program where you shadow senior leaders. From day one, you carry real responsibility.

What You'll do

The Software Track is designed to build the next generation of software business leaders at Hilti – Business Owners, Business Directors, Segment Managers and ultimately Senior Management Team members. If you want a structured path to running a business, this program is built for that outcome.

The program places you inside one of two business units:

Construction Software: Home to Fieldwire (Field Software for project and workforce management), ON!Track (asset management), and 4PS (construction business management). You will work directly with customers, product teams, and business leadership across Europe and beyond.

Fastening & Protection Solutions: Where design & engineering software for structural connections (e.g. PROFIS Engineering Suite), MEP supports and passive fire protection systems are developed and brought to market across a global customer base of structural and mechanical engineers.

For the Construction Software business unit, the program is structured to provide a balanced foundation in customer and market exposure, software product understanding, and business experience, while giving you the opportunity to work with at least two software products during the program:

- ​Year 1: Begin with a 12-month sales assignment, developing direct customer insight and understanding the business challenges addressed by our software solutions.

- ​Year 2: Undertake three rotations of 3–6 months each across product and business teams, including exposure to an international project.

​For the Fastening & Protection Solution business unit, the program provides exposure to product management , software development, exposure to customers and start-ups and international project experience:

- ​Year 1: Begin with a 12-month product management assignment, building product understanding and market insight.

title: AI R&D Engineer – Model Training  (f/m/d)
description:
Our Mission

Aleph Alpha is one of the few companies in Europe doing serious foundation model pre-training like our recently released Kolibri-1 model . Our customers - in finance, manufacturing, public administration - need models that understand German, meet European regulatory requirements, and work reliably in high-stakes settings. We're building that in Heidelberg.

Team Culture

At Aleph Alpha, we foster a culture built on ownership, autonomy, and empowerment. Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We maintain a flat organizational structure with efficient, supportive management that enables quick decision-making, open communication, and a strong sense of shared purpose.

We believe a strong engineering culture is the key to model training success. We like Extreme Programming and favor trunk-based development. We often mob-program, which keeps us aligned and means we always learn from each other.

About the Role

As an AI R&D Engineer in Model Training (f/m/d), you will join our model training team in Heidelberg or Berlin. Most of the team is based in Heidelberg. The model training team is building and improving our model training pipeline, which has been used to train Kolibri. 

- You will work across our full stack. Some weeks you might be optimizing how training loads are scheduled on our cluster and making the pipeline more robust and performant so we can iterate faster. Other weeks, you will be enabling large-scale code execution for reinforcement learning. And at other times, you might dig deep into our evaluation codebase to lift inference throughput on evals.

- No two days are the same. Things move fast, and your ability to focus and prioritize is what lets you unblock the team day-to-day while designing the high-quality tooling and infrastructure that speeds us up long-term.

- We're still building out our training pipeline and infrastructure. Some pieces exist, some do not, and you will have real influence on what gets built and how. Your work directly shapes how quickly we can experiment and improve our models.

- Identifying issues and taking initiative is what drives our day-to-day work.

- Working mode, design decisions, priorities are all done in your team together with your team mates. 
The strongest teams often use highly collaborative techniques, like mob or pair programming.

- Due to the highly collaborative nature of our work you are expected to be on-site at least two days a week. If you are in Berlin, you should expect to travel around every second month for a few days to Heidelberg.

- We are specifically looking to strengthen the Software Engineering in the teams which are research heavy. Major points include improving the maintainability of our code through tests and design & architecture changes.

Requirements 

- At its core, you need to be able to dive into a codebase, change the behavior as necessary, and after the change the code should be better tested and easier to understand than before.

- As such we look for candidates for an understanding of how to design for low coupling and high cohesion paired with the ability to incrementally refactor.

- Experience with the following technologies is likely to be helpful:

- Test Driven Development (TDD)

- Trunk based development

- Continuous integration

- Domain Driven Design

Nice-to-haves 

- Most of our code is in Python, there is also the occasional Rust codebase.

- Large parts of our training pipeline are built on top of Kubernetes.

- We do not hire for skills in a particular technology or language, but rather ability to learn and mindset, yet experience with these technologies is a plus.

What we offer 

- Become part of an AI revolution!

- 30 days of paid vacation

- Access to a variety of fitness & wellness offerings via Wellhub 

- Mental health support through nilo.health 

- Substantially subsidized company pension plan for your future security

- Subsidized Germany-wide transportation ticket

- Budget for additional technical equipment

- Flexible working hours for better work-life balance and hybrid working model

- JobRad® Bike Lease

Note: We welcome applicants at every stage of their career. Your drive and willingness to learn are far more important to us than strict experience requirements.

title: Account Executive - Cologne/ Düsseldorf
description:
About Us 

Tebi is creating the first Connected Restaurant Management System that makes hospitality flow. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights.

Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is built in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Italy, Spain, Germany, Denmark and Finland already love running on Tebi.

About the Role 

We're looking for our first hospitality fan Sales person in NRW. Sales is at the heart of our business growth right now, and you will be driving it forward in your day-to-day. This role is about more than closing deals, it is about blending with the hospitality scene and winning the market.

In your day-to-day you can expect a mix of top of funnel activities, field sales, cold sales, networking, events and more.

What You’ll Do 

Our sales are not your typical SaaS or office sales. We meet our customers where they operate:

- Find the coolest new hospitality spots in town that everyone talks about

- Create engaging ways to show our product

- Use creative communication strategies to close the deal that will help the merchant operate smarter

- Do a smooth handover to the onboarding team to make sure we go live quickly and successfully

- Efficiently use our CRM and other Sales tools (Hubspot, Clay, AI) to leave more time for creativity and connection

- Continuously improve and revisit our sales funnel

- Keep an eye on the new developments in the industry and the merchants’ needs to create our own path

What You’ll Need 

You are a natural relationship builder with a passion for hospitality industry:

- Hands-on approach, independence and hunger for fast-paced operations

- Natural curiosity and a healthy appetite for calculated risk - we want you to try new things and not be afraid to fail

- Strong and engaging communication skills - you can grab an attention of a busy hospitality owner and keep them interested

- Passion and curiosity for hospitality and hospitality tech

- A minimum of 3 years of experience in Sales, Commercial Account Management or Hospitality

- You are comfortable working in both English and German

If this speaks to you we can be the right fit. Learn more about how we work from our Recipe here: https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers .

Benefits: 

- Start-up Equity

- Competitive Salary & Uncapped Commission

- Flexible time off

- Team events

What is Restaurant Software? 

Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it.

From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy.

How we use AI at Tebi 

We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.

At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it.

title: Part-time HR Generalist
description:
About 3E: 

3E is a mission-driven company dedicated to creating a safer and more sustainable world. We offer award-winning regulatory intelligence and AI solutions to help organizations protect people and products. With over 35 years of experience and a global presence, we empower our customers with innovative compliance solutions. 

You will get to work at a company that combines startup agility with the stability of an industry leader. Partner with enterprise customers and global experts to advance environmental safety and solve complex data science challenges.

Join us and make an impact! 

About the Role 

3E is seeking a part-time HR Generalist with the ability to work remotely within Germany. In this position, you will use your HR expertise to support employees across Germany as part of our collaborative, international EMEA HR Operations team.

This permanent, part-time role is ideal for HR professionals with at least 3 years of HR experience. You will work approximately 3 days per week (20–24 hours weekly), partnering with HR colleagues to support all aspects of the employee lifecycle, from onboarding and HR administration to payroll coordination and HR operations. You’ll communicate in German, prepare German-language employment documentation, and ensure compliance with German employment requirements, all from a remote setting within Germany.

In addition to daily HR responsibilities, you will help advance operational excellence by researching German HR topics, maintaining Standard Operating Procedures, and developing HR team knowledge bases. You will also use AI-enabled tools such as Microsoft Copilot and ChatGPT to aid research, documentation, and productivity while ensuring confidentiality and sound judgment.

We are seeking an organized, proactive HR professional who enjoys collaborating virtually, thrives in a dynamic environment, and is eager to drive continuous improvement.

Location: Remote within Germany 

What You'll Do 

- Coordinate onboarding and offboarding activities for employees in Germany.

- Prepare German-language employment contracts, amendments, reference letters, confirmations, and employee communications.

- Maintain accurate employee records and HR documentation in compliance with German employment regulations.

- Respond to employee and manager HR inquiries in German and provide timely, customer-focused support.

- Assist with HR case management, payroll coordination, benefits administration, and time and attendance activities.

- Support compliance with German employment laws, statutory leave, insurance, and other HR administration processes.

- Research HR topics and document processes to improve consistency, knowledge sharing, and operational efficiency.

- Collaborate with HR Operations, Payroll, Finance, Legal, and external vendors to support an exceptional employee experience.

- Support additional HR projects and continuous improvement initiatives as needed.

What Makes You a Great Fit 

- 3+ years of hands-on HR Generalist experience, ideally supporting the German market.

- Native or near-native (C2) German language skills are required.

- Professional working proficiency in English.

- Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- Demonstrated initiative and ability to manage HR responsibilities independently.

- Sound understanding of German labor law, employment practices, and HR administration.

- Interest in payroll, benefits administration, and employee services.

- Comfortable learning and using AI-enabled tools such as ChatGPT or Microsoft Copilot.

- Curious, customer-focused, and excited to learn and contribute in a fast-paced, international environment.

- Ability to work remotely from within Germany approximately 3 days per week (20–24 hours weekly).

Disclosures: 

3E is committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate based on any legally protected categories. For applicants who would like to request accommodation, please contact us Candidate Privacy Notice 

Agencies : 3E is not accepting unsolicited assistance from search firms for this employment opportunity. All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at 3E via email, the Internet, or in any form and/or method without a valid written search agreement in place for this position will be deemed the sole property of 3E. No fee will be paid if 3E hires the candidate because of the referral or through other means.

title: Information Security Engineer - Application Security
description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration , enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide , including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform . We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies , We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading. 

About the Role: 

Hi there! We're hiring an Information Security Engineer with a focus on Application Security to join our Information Security team at Camunda.

We are a team that takes security seriously without making it feel like a locked door. We work in a transparent, straightforward way, and we care about doing the work right rather than just checking a compliance box.

You will work side by side with our R&D engineers: reviewing designs, threat modeling new features, digging into code and helping teams make good, risk-based decisions about the vulnerabilities that come in. You'll also help build the internal tools that make this work scale, including our CVE registry and the LLM-assisted workflows we use to analyse code and triage findings.

Camunda is an AI-first company, and InfoSec is no exception: AI agents are part of how we review code, assess vulnerabilities, and build our tools. You will help shape how that works.

This is a hands-on role for someone who already has solid AppSec foundations and wants to grow. We are a generalist team, so you will also take part in our on-call rotation and incident response, and get exposure to other areas of security. But most of your time will be spent with engineers and building and maintaining internal tools and processes.

What You Will Do 

- Vulnerability management : triage findings from SCA, container and code scanning, external reports and internal security testing; assess whether Camunda is actually affected; agree fix / mitigate / accept with engineering and follow through to release.

- Threat modeling and security reviews : run threat modeling sessions and design reviews with R&D teams for new features and architecture changes, and turn the results into concrete, prioritised actions.

- Code analysis with LLMs : use and improve LLM-assisted tooling (agents, prompts, reusable skills) to review code, validate findings and reproduce issues, while applying your own judgement to know when the model is wrong.

- Build internal security tooling : contribute to the CVE registry and related automation that connects scanners, engineering teams, and customer communication. Much of it is built on Camunda itself.

- Help engineers do the secure thing by default : answer questions, review pull requests, improve guidelines and occasionally run a session or workshop.

- On-call and incident response : share the InfoSec on-call rotation with the other engineers and help investigate and resolve security incidents.

- Support the wider team : help write security advisories for our customers, answer customer security questions and support audits.

What You Will Bring to the Role 

- Around 3+ years in security or software engineering , with at least 2 of them working on application or product security (AppSec, product security, pentesting, or a security-focused developer role all count).

- Experience at a SaaS or software product company , working closely with engineering teams that ship often through modern CI/CD and cloud environments.

- Hands-on vulnerability triage : you've worked with tools like Snyk, Trivy, Semgrep, CodeQL or similar, can tell a real issue from a false positive, and can explain how exploitable something actually is in context (CVSS, exploitability, configuration).

- Threat modeling and design review experience (e.g. STRIDE) on real systems, ideally web apps, APIs, or distributed services.

- You read and write code. You're comfortable reading Java (Camunda is built on it) well enough to follow a data flow and spot a security bug. You can write scripts and small tools and contribute to an existing codebase with review.

- You build with AI, not just chat with it. You use AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or similar) in your daily work to write tools, analyse code or automate tasks. And you know their output still needs a second look, especially when it comes to security.

- Clear, friendly communication with engineers. You see yourself as an enabler, not a gatekeeper, and you can explain risk to people who aren't security specialists.

Nice to haves 

- Some Python and/or JavaScript experience, or experience building internal tools.

- Willingness to learn and use Camunda, since we build a lot of our own security automation on it. Prior BPMN / workflow experience is a plus.

- Experience responding to security incidents or being part of an on-call rotation.

- Exposure to security advisories, CVE disclosure or bug bounty programmes.

- Knowledge of AI/LLM security risks (OWASP Top 10 for LLMs / agentic apps, prompt injection, tool abuse).

- Experience securing Kubernetes or container-based workloads, or open-source / B2B software.

title: Creative Director Concept & Communication
description:
WongDoody – that’s over 2,000 colleagues across 22 design studios on four continents. In Germany, around 300 colleagues work with us at our locations in Berlin, Stuttgart, Düsseldorf, and remotely. Our service areas include Experience Design, Immersive Experiences, Influencer Marketing, and future-proof, holistic Digital Marketing. As part of Infosys, a global technology leader, we develop customer-centric solutions at the intersection of creativity, technology, and artificial intelligence. 

We combine deep industry expertise in FMCG, retail, automotive, mechanical engineering, and technology. For brands such as dm, Otto, Porsche, Bosch, TRUMPF, and Mercedes-Benz, we create user-centric strategies, distinctive brand presences, digital products, and influencer campaigns that seamlessly integrate creativity, data, and media. 

Our local benefits 

- Flexible working hours and 100% overtime compensation 
- Work where it works for you. At home or in the office, or any mix you like 
- Working for strong brands and clients we believe in 
- 30 days' vacation per year 
- Urban Sports Club 
- Corporate Benefits 
- Nice people in welcoming teams 
What you can expect 

- Own the big idea for a digital-first world: develop concepts, headlines, and communication platforms that start from digital thinking and extend across campaigns, brand communications, CRM, and OOH. 
- Set the bar for language: sharpen taglines, headlines, and copy across all our work, and be the person the team turns to when a line isn't good enough yet. 
- Lead and win pitches: shape distinctive creative territories for new business and existing accounts, and present them with conviction. 
- Guide a creative team: mentor copywriters and art directors through concept, refinement, and production with a clear point of view. 
- Partner with strategy: translate strategic thinking into ideas that are both culturally sharp and commercially relevant. 
- Stay culturally switched on: bring fresh reference points, tone, and craft into brand communication. 
- Think ahead of the format: know digital environments inside out, and bring a sharp, curious take on where technology — including AI — can push an idea further, without ever letting the tool replace the thinking. 
What we'd love to see 

- A background in copywriting (ideally) — art direction backgrounds are welcome too, as long as the idea and the words come first. 
- 8+ years of experience in creative direction or concept development at agencies or studios, with a track record of leading integrated, cross-channel campaigns. 
- A portfolio built on strong ideas: headlines, campaign platforms, and communication concepts that hold up across touchpoints — not just polished executions. 
- Experience leading and winning pitches, with confident, persuasive presentation skills. 
- A natural mentor for copywriters and art directors. 
- Fluent German is required, a very good level of English is appreciated. 
- Clear, strategic thinking, and the instinct for what makes communication culturally relevant, not just correct. 
- Genuine curiosity for what's next: fluent in digital culture and platforms, and someone who sees GenAI and emerging tools as a creative sparring partner — applied with judgment, not by default. 
- A strong point of view, brought with positivity, ambition, and empathy into every room. 
We care about your personality and professional skills. We don't care about your gender, age, nationality or appearance and are open to working with everyone.

title: Senior Value Engineer (Pharma) - AI & Process Optimization (Copenhagen)
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

This role is based in Copenhagen , Denmark. We welcome applicants open to relocate and eligible to work in Denmark.

The Team: Value Engineering is responsible for our largest Fortune 500 customers and owns their transformation journey by working on the very frontier of what’s possible with data and AI on the Celons Platform. Partnering closely with the Sales team, Value Engineering is responsible for ensuring that the Celonis Platform is deployed to tackle the most strategic business challenges, fits into the right place in our customers’ technology stack and most importantly generates strong ROI through deep and broad deployments.

The Role: As a Senior Value Engineer, you will spearhead AI and data-driven business transformation within the Pharmaceutical sector by contributing to your customer’s end-to-end value journey using the Celonis Context Model. Working alongside Lead and Principal VEs, you will combine technical execution with consulting and project management. As an AI-fluent operator, your core mandate is to orchestrate complex roadmaps and execute targeted transformation initiatives that improve how these businesses operate across their ecosystems.

The work you’ll do: 

- Value Selling & Realization: Uncover the real issues by peeling back layers of organizational complexity. Own the Outcome from first discovery through realized ROI for your process areas. Tell the Value Story by crafting powerful executive narratives and leading business value workshops.

- Stakeholder Management: Cultivate powerful executive sponsorship across core business units to champion transformation programs. Co-own change management with customer leaders and design CoE roadmaps that build self-sufficiency.

- Program Management: Steer Global Transformations across complex workstreams. Own and implement AI-driven account planning and AI-assisted project management. Automate executive governance (QBRs, SteerCos) with minimal manual friction.

- Platform & AI Fluency: Act as an AI-fluent operator, utilizing AI tools for rapid technical outputs while partnering with Applied Value Engineers for deep-dive solution builds. Champion platform adoption.

- Scale Value & Innovation: Build a strategic expansion roadmap embedding Celonis as a strategic platform to drive adoption. Provide feedback to R&D based on evolving customer use cases.

The qualifications you need: 

- Experience: 5+ years of experience taking ownership of complex workstreams, process areas, and customer relationships in Value Engineering, Consulting, or Pre-Sales.

- AI & Technical & Fluency: Solid background in enterprise IT and business software (e.g., SAP, Workday, Salesforce, Oracle). You operate primarily as an AI-fluent operator, utilizing AI copilots to generate outputs and automations, avoiding heavy manual coding.

- Builder Mentality: Comfortable setting your own direction within an account team. Driven to live for customer value , proactively hunting and ideating for highest-impact solutions.

- Process Improvement & Value Realization: Proven expertise in executing process improvements. 

- Strategic Program & Stakeholder Management: Demonstrated expertise orchestrating multi-region or business unit transformation programs. Expert at mobilizing VP/Director-level sponsorship. Flawless English communication with commanding executive presence.

- Domain & Industry: Deep understanding of the Finance/Supply Chain domains and Pharmaceutical trends. You stay continuously updated on business-critical use cases.

- Degree: Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Business Analytics, comparable technical degree or a Business/Economics degree paired with a technical minor

#LI-NS1 

What Celonis can offer you: 

- Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.

- Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.

- Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.

- Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.

- Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.

- Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.

- Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.

- Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.

- Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us: 

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video .

Celonis Inclusion Statement: 

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen. 

Your Privacy: 

Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices 

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process .

Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools 

We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.

The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it.

title: Strategy Analyst - Operations Strategy & CRM
description:
The company 

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team 

Our Operations teams deliver exceptional customer service, and the Operations Strategy & CRM team helps make that possible. We exist to understand Operations performance, find efficiencies and improve the service our customers receive. Our contact strategy is a core part of this, reaching customers at every stage, from sign-up to collections. Getting this right means customers get what they need without having to get in touch, so our teams can focus where they add most value.

The role 

As a Strategy Analyst, you’ll run the projects that decide when and how iwoca contacts its customers through our in-house CRM system. You’ll steer which experiments the team runs, with customer lifetime value as your key metric. You’ll work closely with the Senior CRM Executive, who will bring your changes to life in the messages customers receive. The role will include:

- Contact strategy. You’ll find the points in the customer journey where a message adds the most value. You’ll weigh the conversion a message brings against the risk of contacting customers too often. You’ll balance short-term gains against long-term customer value, and decide when an automated message is enough and when a person from Operations should step in.

- Model-driven emails. We’ve started using a model to choose who receives some of our emails. You’ll be responsible for understanding where this approach works well, and collaborate with the data science team to make any improvements.

- Split tests. You’ll design, run, and interpret controlled experiments on customer contact. For example, you might test the timing and content of emails at key points in the customer journey. You’ll apply statistical thinking so decisions rest on evidence.

- Ownership and growth. You’ll manage analytical and strategic projects end-to-end. You’ll share findings and recommendations directly with senior leadership, and join iwoca’s wider community of analysts and data scientists.

The requirements 

Essential: 

- Commercial experience. You’ve worked in strategy, analytics, product, finance, or consulting. You understand how to use data to make commercial decisions on revenue, cost, or risk that the business acts on.

- Quantitative foundations. You have a strong analytical background, either through academic qualifications (such as a STEM background) or through relevant professional experience. You can reason about uncertainty, grounded in the underlying statistics.

- First-principles thinking. You break complex problems into their core parts, decide which to tackle first, and iterate systematically to a solution.

- Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail for your audience.

- AI leverage. You know how to use AI to optimise your workflows, for example by checking your analysis or improving your write-ups. You judge when to use it and when not to.

Bonus: 

- Experimentation. You have designed, run, and interpreted controlled experiments, including A/B tests, to inform operational or product decisions.

- Model-based decisions. You have used the results of statistical or machine learning models to make commercial decisions. You don’t need to build the models yourself, but you know how to question their output and act on it.

- Coding abilities. You have experience using Python or SQL - either directly or through coding tools like Claude Code. If you haven’t coded before we’d want you to be excited to learn on the job so you can make the most out of iwoca’s vast amounts of data!

The salary 

We expect to pay from £60,000 – £70,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture 

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices 

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

- Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

- Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits 

- Flexible working hours.

- Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

- A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

- A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

- 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

- A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

- Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

- 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

- An employee equity incentive scheme.

- Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

- Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

- Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

- A learning and development budget for everyone.

- Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

- Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

Construction technology is being reinvented. Be part of it.

Construction is one of the world's largest industries, and one of its least digitized. That is changing fast. At Hilti, we are not only developing software products - we are building and growing digital businesses around them. Hilti is at the centre of that shift, with a growing portfolio of software products that connect jobsites, offices, teams, and tools across the entire construction lifecycle. We are looking for ambitious, internationally mobile early-career talents with a global mindset who are excited about technology but see their future in business and leadership rather than in a purely technical software career.

The Software & Digital Business Track of Hilti's Outperformer Program is a two-year accelerated development program that prepares you for a commercial, international leadership career in our software and digital businesses. You will learn how technology becomes customer value, how software businesses grow, how products are brought to market, and how commercial decisions are made. This is not a rotation program where you shadow senior leaders. From day one, you carry real responsibility.

What You'll do

The Software Track is designed to build the next generation of software business leaders at Hilti – Business Owners, Business Directors, Segment Managers and ultimately Senior Management Team members. If you want a structured path to running a business, this program is built for that outcome.

The program places you inside one of two business units:

Construction Software: Home to Fieldwire (Field Software for project and workforce management), ON!Track (asset management), and 4PS (construction business management). You will work directly with customers, product teams, and business leadership across Europe and beyond.

Fastening & Protection Solutions: Where design & engineering software for structural connections (e.g. PROFIS Engineering Suite), MEP supports and passive fire protection systems are developed and brought to market across a global customer base of structural and mechanical engineers.

For the Construction Software business unit, the program is structured to provide a balanced foundation in customer and market exposure, software product understanding, and business experience, while giving you the opportunity to work with at least two software products during the program:

- ​Year 1: Begin with a 12-month sales assignment, developing direct customer insight and understanding the business challenges addressed by our software solutions.

- ​Year 2: Undertake three rotations of 3–6 months each across product and business teams, including exposure to an international project.

​For the Fastening & Protection Solution business unit, the program provides exposure to product management , software development, exposure to customers and start-ups and international project experience:

- ​Year 1: Begin with a 12-month product management assignment, building product understanding and market insight.

- ​Year 2: Undertake three rotations of 3–6 months each, involving international projects that broaden your business perspective and global exposure.

You are close to graduating or have recently completed a Master's degree - your degree is likely to be in construction management, civil engineering, or mechanical engineering with a focus on construction, Computer Science, or also Business study programs with an affinity for Software and construction. What matters more than your degree subject is the combination of traits below:

- Global mobility - you are willing and able to relocate internationally, multiple times. A global thinker who is keen for diverse cultural experiences.

- Digital and AI orientation - you think natively in digital workflows, comfortable with software tools, and know the power and potential of AI.

- Language - you are fluent in English and/or German, Dutch, French, Spanish or Italian. 

- Commercial instinct - you are drawn to how businesses grow, how customers make decisions, and how products create.

The experience concludes with a 5-day on-campus summit to deepen insights and to foster business and leadership skills.

We continuously strive to ensure every voice is valued and every team member feels empowered to contribute. By building on this foundation, we strengthen our teams, our innovation, and our impact, making construction better together.

An overview of this role 

As a Threat Research Engineer, you’ll take ideas from the first question to a working proof of concept, deploy it, and analyze the results yourself. This is a full-stack role, with AI central to how we work. You’ll build agentic workflows for research, analysis, and detection, and use AI tools every day to move faster.

- Research new attack surfaces and threat vectors, including AI coding agents, agent plugins, and package ecosystems.

What you’ll bring 

- Hands-on security experience in research, malware analysis, penetration testing, or security tooling, with both a developer mindset and an adversarial mindset: you can build systems and think about how to break them.

- Strong programming skills in Go or Python, with good software engineering practices including testing, code review, continuous integration and continuous delivery, and maintainable code.

- Experience deploying and running production services on a public cloud.

- Understanding of how package ecosystems work and how software supply chain attacks happen.

- Clear writing that explains findings to both engineers and a general audience.

- Helpful, but not required: published vulnerability findings; security research on AI agents, large language model applications, or Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers; Google Cloud Platform experience; or infrastructure as code experience with Terraform or OpenTofu.

You don’t need deep knowledge of compilers or static application security testing engines. A high-level understanding is enough.

The Threat Research group researches security threats as they emerge and turns what we learn into protection for GitLab customers. We maintain the GitLab Advisory Database, which powers GitLab’s dependency scanning. We also build detection capabilities, do original vulnerability research, and publish what we find. title: Finance Business Partner
description:
About Everfield 

Everfield buys, builds, and grows European vertical market and specialist software companies, providing them with the tools they need to move to the next level. Our mission is to foster ambition, fuel growth, and unlock opportunities for Europe's software ecosystem.

Companies in the Everfield ecosystem follow a decentralised model, maintaining their team, brand, and offices, while focusing on what they do best - building products and supporting customers. This is not a reporting role. It's ownership of the financial engine for a portfolio of growing software businesses.

You'll be accountable end-to-end for the accounting integrity of your portfolio: closing the books accurately, building and leading a team of local finance experts to meet French statutory and regulatory requirements, and making sure every number that reaches Everfield's leadership is right and on time. But the job doesn't stop at accuracy. You'll sit next to Business Unit Leaders as their financial conscience and commercial sparring partner - coaching them on the numbers, challenging their growth plans, and pushing them to allocate resources where they'll actually compound.

Everfield deliberately gives this role more scope than a typical FP&A or controller seat carries at this career stage. You'll run the accounting, build and lead the regional finance team, and shape how each business thinks about growth - the full stack, across multiple companies.

What You'll Do 

Own the numbers 

• Be accountable for the accuracy and timeliness of monthly reporting (management P&L, KPIs, operating metrics) for each business in your portfolio - not just its preparation.

• Build and manage a team of local financial experts to meet French statutory and regulatory compliance requirements.

• Guide each business's finance and accounting team through migration onto Everfield's NetSuite instance.

• Own the accuracy and timeliness of the underlying accounting work behind every number you report.

• Build and defend annual budgets and rolling forecasts, incorporating strategic initiatives and long-term expectations.

• Prepare Quarterly Update Review (QUR) packs for Everfield's CEO, CFO, and COO.

Drive the growth agenda 

• Coach Business Unit Leaders on financial acumen - make sure they understand and consistently apply the Everfield ratios, not just report against them.

• Challenge and support Business Unit Leaders in applying Everfield's prescribed revenue system to their business.

• Help each business spot operating efficiencies, report headcount accurately, and manage overhead with intent.

• Partner with Business Unit Leaders on charting expense management and aligning resources toward growth, not just cost control.

• Play an active role in integration of newly acquired businesses - systems, data, and reporting design, alongside the Integration Director and Head of BI.

• Partner with your Strategic Business Partner (SBP) counterpart on the day-to-day relationship with each business in your region.

Who We're Looking For 

• An ambitious problem-solver who wants this role to be a stepping stone – experience on the path towards a CFO or Controller of a larger group of companies, or of a larger standalone business.

• Strong technical grounding in accounting practices and controls - you can run a clean close and hold a third-party provider to a standard, not just review their output.

• Commercial instinct to match: you can sit across from a Business Unit Leader and challenge their growth plan, not just report on whether they hit it.

• A completed university education plus a professional finance qualification (CA/ACA/CIMA or equivalent).

• 5+ years in Business Controlling, FP&A, or Finance Business Partnering.

• Ability to lead and build a team of regional finance specialists.

• Comfort operating in a decentralised, multi-entity, PE-backed environment - you'll manage stakeholders across businesses at very different stages of maturity.

• Fluent in English and French; effective communicator at every level of an organisation, from bookkeeper to CEO.

• Ideally, a background in fast-growing technology or SaaS companies.

• Willingness to travel occasionally.

• Remote flexibility.

title: iOS Engineer - Design System
description:
About the team: 

As an iOS Engineer on the Design System team, you'll translate SumUp's design language into a reusable, easy-to-use library of UI components and experience patterns, empowering product teams to build cohesive, accessible user experiences at scale.

The Design System team works hand-in-hand with the Mobile Platform team to set standards and provide guidance across all product teams at SumUp. As we expand our ecosystem of merchant and consumer-facing products, this role offers a rare opportunity to shape the foundation that helps developers build faster and ship higher-quality experiences to millions of users worldwide.

What you’ll do: 

- Shape the core experience for both users and developers interacting with SumUp's iOS ecosystem

- Collaborate closely with product and design teams to build components that are maintainable, consistent, and beautiful

- Embed accessibility best practices into every component — from content descriptions and touch target sizing to color contrast and dynamic type

- Provide hands-on technical guidance to product teams to deliver on company priorities, including the upcoming support for landscape orientation

- Review code contributions, enforce design system conventions, and mentor engineers on best practices for reusable UI development

- Lead the migration of legacy UIKit-based components to SwiftUI while maintaining system stability

- Proactively identify and address technical debt to uphold a high bar for engineering excellence and codebase health

You’ll be a great fit for this role if you: 

- Bring 3+ years of professional iOS development experience, ideally on large-scale or consumer-facing applications

- Are fluent in Swift, with deep hands-on knowledge of both SwiftUI and UIKit — and a clear view on when and how to use each

- Bring experience building or contributing to a design system, component library, or shared UI framework, and understand what it takes to make components truly reusable and scalable

- Take pride in crafting accessible user experiences — you know your way around VoiceOver, dynamic type, color contrast, and touch target standards, and treat accessibility as a first-class concern, not an afterthought

- Bring a strong grasp of testing best practices for UI components, including unit tests, snapshot tests, and UI automation

- Are comfortable reviewing code and mentoring peers — you enjoy sharing knowledge, giving constructive feedback, and raising the bar for the whole team

- Are self-motivated and structured in your working style — you manage your own priorities, communicate clearly in English, and thrive in a cross-functional, collaborative environment

- Stay genuinely curious about the iOS ecosystem — you follow Apple's releases closely, experiment with new APIs, and are excited to bring fresh ideas back to the team

Why you should join SumUp: 

🌎 Opportunity to work with a truly global, multicultural team from our Paris location. This involves an office-first setup
🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced
🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success
📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 for your individual development, which can be used to attend conferences and/or advance your career through further education
💼 Financial security: corporate pension contributions that support your long-term future
🏥 Healthcare support: we cover 50% of the monthly cost of your health insurance for your Mutuelle and Prévoyance
🚌 Extra allowances: we offer restaurant tickets (Swile) and cover transportation costs
🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service
🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

About SumUp 

We believe in the everyday hero.

Small business owners are at the heart of all we do, so we're creating tools that help them run their businesses. With a founder’s mentality and a 'team-first’ attitude, our diverse teams across Europe, South America and the United States work together to ensure that the small business owners we partner with can be successful doing what they love. 

SumUp is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer that proudly pursues and hires a diverse workforce. SumUp does not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. SumUp also strives for a healthy and safe workplace and strictly prohibits harassment of any kind. 

SumUp will not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from a candidate

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don’t tick every box, it’s ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

title: Juriste Stagiaire (PPI, Stage M2) - Droit Commercial
description:
En bref 

Tu as envie de contribuer à la révolution des supermarchés ? Chez Picnic, tu as l'opportunité de rejoindre une jeune équipe créative et bouillonnante, dans une culture start-up, où tout ce que tu fais compte. Grâce à une approche basée sur les données (data-driven) et un service unique, Picnic se bat pour faire des courses quelque chose de simple, drôle et accessible à tous. En outre, nous travaillons dans la perspective d'un avenir plus durable en utilisant des technologies de pointe et en exploitant une flotte de véhicules de livraison 100 % électriques.

En 2021, Picnic a levé 600 millions d'euros auprès de la Fondation Bill & Melinda Gates afin de se développer en Europe. Après avoir lancé avec succès les opérations en Allemagne et dans le Nord de la France, nous poursuivons maintenant notre expansion en France en nous développant notamment en région parisienne.

Tes missions 

Basé.e au bureau de Paris, tu feras partie de l'équipe juridique et travailleras avec le directeur juridique France, en étroite coopération avec l'équipe des Pays-Bas et les équipes opérationnelles en France. Concrètement, tes missions seront principalement :

- Contrats commerciaux : gestion des contrats quotidiens (les revoir et commenter, les négocier avec l'aide d'un responsable juridique, et les suivre jusqu'à la signature) ;

- Baux commerciaux : revoir les lettres d'offres et travailler sur les premiers drafts des baux, assurer le suivi du process jusqu'à la signature ;

- Être le premier interlocuteur des équipes opérationnelles, notamment des équipes commerciales, safety et infrastructure, pour toutes leurs questions juridiques ;

- Assister l'équipe juridique sur les projets de long-terme (pré-contentieux/contentieux) et les négociations de contrats complexes ; et

- Gestion du secrétariat juridique et des formations (augmentations de capital, approbation des comptes, gestion des pages permettant la formation des opérationnels, etc.).

À propos de toi 

- Élève-avocat.e (PPI) ou Master 2 en droit avec une connaissance générale du droit français des affaires (droit privé, contrats, consommation, distribution, immobilier, etc.)

- Tu es vif.ve, dynamique, autonome et rigoureux.se, tu as l'esprit d'équipe et es force de propositions

- Anglais professionnel, qui te permet de suivre des réunions, de communiquer et de lire et écrire parfaitement (l'anglais est la langue de travail de Picnic)

- Tu cherches un stage à partir de janvier 2027

- Tu vis déjà ou as la possibilité de te relocaliser à Paris

Avantages Picnic

Tout expert a un jour été débutant ! Tu auras de nombreuses occasions de te mettre au défi et de t'épanouir, notamment grâce aux sessions Lunch & Learn et à la formation sur mesure en compétences non techniques. Nous proposons également des cours de langue professionnels hebdomadaires gratuits.

Fais la différence. Tu travailleras dans un environnement stimulant, avec la liberté de mener tes propres projets et de créer un impact direct et visible. Grâce à nos véhicules entièrement électriques et à notre modèle économique durable, tu contribueras également à rendre le monde meilleur !

Le travail d'équipe nous fait avancer ! Avec plus de 80 nationalités réparties dans 3 pays, tu feras partie d'une entreprise diversifiée qui offre de nombreuses occasions de s'investir, qu'il s'agisse de soirées à thème, d'apéritifs entre collègues ou de nos séjours annuels au ski, etc.

Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.

Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.

Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.

Le contexte 

La squad Productivity est au cœur de la transformation produit autour de la gestion des affaires contentieuses de bout en bout.

Le scope de la squad s'est considérablement enrichi, au-delà du seul gain de productivité, en allant vers l'accompagnement de la réflexion et de l'argumentation juridique, à travers plusieurs langues.

Aujourd’hui, elle est responsable de toute la chaîne de valeur :

1. Analyse de documents

2. Rédaction automatisée des conclusions et documents juridiques

3. Réflexion stratégique sur l’argumentation

C’est le cœur de notre IA appliquée au raisonnement juridique : travail avancé sur les modèles LLM, le machine learning et la structuration de documents complexes.1.

Tu peux trouver des détails sur l’ensemble de la stack sur Github !

- Concevoir et développer des features produit de bout en bout — de la modélisation back-end à l'interface utilisateur, en ownership complet sur tes sujets.

- Intégrer des modèles d'IA et LLM dans les flux produit — pour enrichir l'expérience des avocats et juristes qui utilisent Doctrine au quotidien.

- Maintenir et faire évoluer notre architecture cloud — stack moderne, scalabilité, fiabilité des services en production.

- Participer activement aux choix techniques de ta squad — revues de code, décisions d'architecture, amélioration continue de la qualité du code.

- Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Produit et Design — pour transformer des problèmes métier complexes en solutions techniques concrètes et utiles.

- Tu es autonome et orienté ownership — tu prends un sujet, tu le cadres, tu le livres. Tu n'attends pas qu'on te dise quoi faire.

- Tu travailles bien avec le Produit — tu comprends le besoin utilisateur, tu sais challenger un spec, et tu penses impact avant technologie.

- Tu as une appétence pour l'IA — tu n'es pas forcément expert LLM, mais tu t'y intéresses activement et tu vois comment ça transforme les produits.

- Tu aimes partager et faire grandir les autres — revues de code constructives, documentation, pair programming. Tu laisses la codebase meilleure qu'à ton arrivée.

Les à côtés du poste 👁 

- Comme tous les ingénieurs de Doctrine, tu participeras à un de nos chapters transverse, en l’espèce le chapter Web. Au sein de ce chapter, tu contribueras à des projets internes pour améliorer nos process et notre vision long-terme. Le chapter se réunit toutes les semaines pour :

Notre processus de recrutement 🚀

title: AI/ML Engineering Intern: System 1 Models for Reactive Space Operations
description:
Wanna join the adventure?

Loft Orbital flies other people's payloads on standardized satellites, giving our customers a fast, simple, and reliable path to orbit. Our AI for Space team is looking for a motivated intern to explore how fast, lightweight “System 1” models can boost reactivity, performance, and usability across our satellite operational chains.

Reactivity use cases are at the heart of Loft's vision, and we are scaling them: from single-satellite reactive loops, to two-satellite / two-sensor tip & cue (a detection from one sensor automatically cueing an acquisition by another), and ultimately multi-satellite scenarios. Today we mostly rely on “System 2” models — powerful but slow and heavy at inference — from our partners. “System 1” models (fast, intuitive) are coming back strongly and could add value not only on reactivity, but also on performance and ease of use. This internship will assess that added value and prototype it on our reactivity scenarios.

Location: Toulouse office, city center (Jeanne d’Arc metro station)
Duration: 6-month, end-of-studies internship — target start date: early 2027.

About this role: 

- Review the state of the art on System 1 / fast, intuitive models and compare them with the System 2 models used today, including our partners' models.

- Map where System 1 models could bring value in our operational chain for reactivity use cases, from detection to tasking.

- Define benchmark scenarios of increasing complexity with the team: a single-satellite reactive loop, then a two-satellite / two-sensor tip & cue loop, and, as a stretch goal, a multi-satellite scenario.

- Set the latency budget, accuracy needs, and execution context for each scenario.

- Build datasets and evaluation sets from Loft data, partner outputs, and open datasets.

- Train or fine-tune System 1 models and benchmark them against System 2 baselines on reactivity (latency), performance (accuracy, compute footprint), and ease of use (integration and operational effort).

- Prototype an end-to-end reactive loop, possibly as a hybrid design where System 1 triggers and System 2 validates, and assess how it extends to multi-satellite coordination.

- Document results and recommendations for production use, and deliver a final demo.

Must Haves: 

- Final-year engineering or Master's student specialized in ML / deep learning / computer vision.

- Solid Python and PyTorch skills, and good software engineering practices.

- Strong understanding of the state of the art in LLM / VLM / Reinforcement Learning.

- Practical experience training neural networks (language models or computer vision) and/or LLM manipulation.

Nice to Haves: 

- Model optimization (quantization, distillation, edge inference).

- Exposure to satellite or geospatial data.

- Multi-agent or distributed systems experience.

- Genuine interest in space.

What Can We Offer? 
You will join the AI for Space team and directly support the scaling of reactivity use cases, a core part of Loft's vision — working toward shorter detection-to-tasking latency on single-satellite and tip & cue scenarios, and a first step towards multi-satellite reactive operations. You'll build new expertise on an emerging class of models, reusable across other detection-like use cases, with a concrete prototype and benchmark the team can build on. You'll help shape the future of our product, creating experiences that are intuitive, efficient, and user-centric, while collaborating closely with cross-functional partners. title: Manager Architect Cloud - Paris
description:
Présentation du poste : 

Concevoir une architecture d’IA, c’est engager une entreprise pour plusieurs années : l’emplacement des données, la gestion des accès, la manière dont un agent passe en production sous le regard des équipes de sécurité. Ces choix structurants, vous les construisez avec nos clients.

Tout le reste, ce sont les ambitions fonctionnelles et techniques du client, son cadre réglementaire, son budget, les compétences qu'il peut réellement mobiliser en interne, la gouvernance qu'il veut installer, et un écosystème d'éditeurs qui gravite autour de lui. Votre rôle est de trouver le point d'équilibre entre ces forces, de le faire accepter, puis de le réajuster dès que l'une d'elles bouge.

Votre point de départ n’est pas la technologie, mais l’ambition métier. Vous la traduisez en une plateforme data ou agentique pensée pour s’intégrer au système d’information existant, avec son histoire, ses contraintes et ses équipes. Votre rôle ne s’arrête pas à la validation du schéma cible : vous accompagnez les équipes de delivery jusqu’à la mise en production.

À titre d’exemple, chez l’un de nos clients, chaque nouvel agent repose désormais sur une plateforme commune qui gère nativement les droits d’accès, le monitoring et les coûts. Chaque cas d’usage s’appuie ainsi sur les fondations posées pour les précédents.

Ce poste s’adresse à vous si vous aimez embrasser un système dans son ensemble, prendre les décisions qui engagent et en expliquer les raisons.

Artefact est le partenaire de confiance des plus grandes entreprises mondiales pour déployer l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, vous rejoignez le département Engineering (environ 300 personnes, sous la responsabilité du CTO), au sein du chapter AI Architect.

Activités et responsabilités : 

Sur un projet, vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les AI Applied Engineers, qui construisent et font tourner ce que vous concevez, et avec les AI Product Managers, qui portent le produit avec le client.

Côté client, deux publics sont à convaincre : les directions métier, avec lesquelles vous définissez la cible, et les équipes IT, sécurité, réseau et exploitation, sans l’adhésion desquelles rien ne passe en production. Une architecture qu’elles n’ont pas validée ne dépasse pas le stade du document. Vous êtes aussi l'interlocuteur des achats, de la conformité et des éditeurs qui veulent se positionner.

Au sein du chapter, vous relisez les designs de vos pairs, contribuez à faire grandir les architectes et les profils d’ingénierie qui vous entourent, et mettez en commun ce qui fonctionne. Vous travaillez également avec nos partenaires technologiques et les autres équipes d’Artefact.

Vos responsabilités : 

- Traduire les objectifs, les contraintes et les délais du client en une architecture que le métier comme l’IT comprennent, et défendre vos choix devant eux.

- Concevoir des plateformes data et agentiques, on premise, dans le cloud ou en hybride.

- Découper les périmètres techniques en fonction de la façon dont les équipes du client sont organisées.

- Arbitrer entre les options en pesant leur valeur métier, leur coût total, leur conformité, leur dépendance à un éditeur et la capacité du client à les faire vivre.

- Aider le client à évaluer et à mettre en concurrence des éditeurs, sans parti pris.

- Préparer les propositions commerciales : cadrer la solution, la chiffrer et construire la roadmap de delivery.

- Tenir la ligne pendant le delivery : relire les designs, trancher les arbitrages et réajuster la cible quand le contexte du client change.

- Faire vivre les patterns de référence et les bonnes pratiques du chapter, et suivre de près les évolutions de l’IA, du cloud et de la data.

Profil recherché : 

Nous recherchons une personne qui pense comme un consultant et raisonne comme un ingénieur. Les architectes qui réussissent chez nous sont, entre autres, des profils techniques passés par le conseil, des pre-sales engineers, des FDEs, ou des personnes avec une expérience en tant que CTO.

Les indispensables : 

- Vous avez conçu une architecture data ou IA qui a été mise en production, et vous savez expliquer pourquoi vous avez écarté les autres options, techniques ou non.

- Vous avez déjà recommandé une option techniquement moins séduisante parce qu'elle correspondait mieux au budget, aux compétences, à la gouvernance ou à la réglementation du client.

- Vous maîtrisez au moins un grand cloud (Google Cloud, Azure ou AWS) ainsi que les fondamentaux de la sécurité et du réseau : IAM, gestion des secrets, architecture réseau.

- Vous avez rédigé des dossiers d’architecture (HLD et LLD) qui ont servi de base à une équipe de delivery.

- Vous avez codé pendant une partie significative de votre parcours. Aujourd'hui, vous savez lire du code, challenger un design et dire ce qu'exige un système en production : CI/CD, monitoring, gestion des incidents.

- Vous avez déjà cadré et chiffré une solution, par exemple pour une proposition commerciale ou un plan projet.

- Vous avez défendu une architecture à la fois devant une direction métier ou un comité de direction, et devant les équipes sécurité et exploitation, en reliant la valeur business, les choix techniques et le plan de delivery.

Un plus, pas un prérequis : 

- Architecture de plateformes agentiques : RAG, orchestration multi-agents, choix des technologies couche par couche.

- Gouvernance des données à l’échelle d’une grande entreprise : data mesh, gestion des accès.

- Plateformes on premise, hybrides ou souveraines, basées sur des technologies open source ou sur Kubernetes.

- Standards de run : SLA, PRA et PCA.

- Une expérience de CTO, de tech lead ou dans un rôle au contact des clients.

- Une certification d’architecture cloud.

- Une pratique régulière des coding agents.

Ce poste n'est probablement pas pour vous si votre expertise porte sur une seule plateforme ou un seul éditeur et que vous souhaitez continuer à l'approfondir. Ni si construire et écrire du code est ce qui vous anime le plus : le rôle d'AI Applied Engineer vous correspondra mieux.

Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.

Process de recrutement : 

- HR Interview (30-45 min) : Échange sur votre parcours, vos compétences managériales et l'adéquation culturelle avec un Talent Acquisition Specialist.

- Architecture Case (60 min) : Session d'architecture avec un AI Architect basé en France sur un cas basé sur une vraie mission.

- US / Manager Interview (60 min) : Échange avec un Director / Partner pour évaluer le fit managérial, opérationnel et la posture client.

Rémunération : Package : 75 000 € à 85 000 € brut annuel (fixe) + 8 000 € de variable, selon expérience et séniorité.

Présentation de l’entreprise 

Artefact est un cabinet de conseil spécialisé en data et en intelligence artificielle, qui accompagne les entreprises pour transformer ces technologies en impact business concret et mesurable.

A la croisée du conseil, de la data et de la technologie, nos 2 500 collaborateurs dans 27 pays mettent leurs expertises en commun pour concevoir, développer et déployer des solutions qui répondent aux enjeux de transformation de nos clients.

Envie d'en savoir plus? Découvrez Artefact, nos expertises et notre culture : https://www.artefact.com 

Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l'adéquation avec le rôle.
