title: Medical Affairs Project Associate Specialist, Post Graduate Trainee
description:
The Medical Affairs Project Associate Specialist (post-grad trainee) will join the International Medical TTR team and report to International Medical Strategy & Operations. The post-grad trainee will support the planning, governance and execution of the international Medical Affairs Strategy for ATTR-CM across Alnylam's international markets, working closely with regional and country Medical teams and cross-functional partners. The role contributes to medical operations and planning deliverables, evidence generation portfolio, scientific engagement and insight programs, field medical excellence initiatives and patient experience work and offers first-hand insight into how a regional Medical Affairs organization is run. The scope is intentionally flexible: the more capability, initiative and curiosity the post-grad trainee brings, the more the remit can expand, in line with results. 

Key Responsibilities 

- Support the International Medical Strategy & Operations team in planning, tracking and reporting on International Medical TTR strategic priorities and operating-model deliverables across international markets

- Help with the preparation of management materials, such as leadership updates, pre-reads, meeting materials and executive presentations, turning complex information into clear, decision-ready outputs

- Support medical planning and budget cycles by consolidating regional and country inputs, tracking spend against plan and preparing summaries, in partnership with Finance

- Contribute to evidence generation portfolio management by maintaining study trackers (e.g., investigator-initiated studies, research collaborations) and partnering with in preparing status, milestone and timeline overviews

- Support scientific engagement and medical education activities, including the speaker engagement process and congress planning, all scientific and non-promotional in nature

- Contribute to the TOP 41 Centers of Excellence (CoE) program, supporting the project owner in engagement mapping; this is a potential area where the post-grad trainee may take ownership of project deliverables, depending on experience and interest

- Support field medical excellence initiatives, such as field medical KPIs and dashboards, the quarterly medical insights process, training roll-out

- Contribute to patient experience work, including patient advocacy and engagement and patient support programs

- Gain first-hand insight into the regional medical leadership agenda by supporting cross-functional planning, governance meetings and operational follow-up

- Depending on experience and interest, support projects on AI-enabled tools, CRM and insights platforms, and other emerging medical priorities

Qualifications 

- Availability for a minimum of 9 months; 12 months is strongly preferred

- Completed bachelor's degree; a master's degree is a plus

- Academic background in life sciences, medicine, pharmacy, biomedical sciences, public health or another analytical discipline is preferred; interest in Medical Affairs, cardiology or rare diseases is valued

- Strong logical and analytical thinking, with the ability to navigate complexity and structure ambiguous problems

- Ability to read, interpret and critically summarize scientific and clinical literature

- Awareness of, or willingness to learn, the compliance principles that govern Medical Affairs

- Advance PowerPoint and Excel skills; confidence using Microsoft Copilot and AI-enabled productivity tools is highly valued

- Fast learner, proactive and adaptive, taking ownership of high-quality outputs and handling confidential information with discretion

- Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; additional languages are a plus

- Flexibility to work 2-3 days per week in the Zug office; occasional travel possible (mainly EU)

- Collaborative, flexible and comfortable working in a fast-moving, cross-functional and international environment

What We Bring 

- The opportunity to join a highly motivated, science-driven team in a leading RNAi therapeutics company 

- Hands-on exposure to how International Medical Affairs supports the AMVUTTRA ATTR-CM launch, with a focus on science, evidence and patients 

- The chance to contribute to Alnylam's mission of bringing groundbreaking medicines to patients 

- Direct one-to-one mentoring, supportive supervision, and regular development feedback 

- Collaboration with a diverse team of experts across medicine, scientific engagement, evidence generation, patient experience, and analytics 

- A strong office community, with events and opportunities to connect with colleagues across functions and disciplines 

About Alnylam: Alnylam Pharmaceuticals (Nasdaq: ALNY) has led the translation of RNA interference (RNAi) into a whole new class of innovative medicines with the potential to transform the lives of people afflicted with rare and more prevalent diseases. Based on Nobel Prize-winning science, RNAi therapeutics represent a powerful, clinically validated approach to treating diseases at their genetic source by “interfering” with mRNA that cause or contribute to disease. Since our founding in 2002, Alnylam has led the RNAi Revolution and continues to turn scientific possibility into reality.

Our culture: Our people-first culture is guided by our core values: fiercely innovative, open culture, purposeful urgency, passion for excellence, and commitment to people, and these values influence how we work and the business decisions we make. Thanks to feedback from our employees over the years, we’ve been fortunate to be named a top employer around the world. Alnylam is extremely proud to have been recognized as one of Science Magazine’s Top Biopharma Employers, one of America's Most Responsible Companies for 2024 by Newsweek, a Fast Company Best Workplace for Innovators, and a Great Place to Work in Canada, France, Italy, Spain, Switzerland, and UK – among others.

At Alnylam, we commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equal employment opportunity. We are dedicated to building an environment where employees can feel that they belong, can bring their authentic selves to work, and achieve to their full potential. By empowering employees to embrace their unique differences at work, our business grows stronger with advanced and original thinking, allowing us to bring groundbreaking medicines to patients.

title: Software Engineer, Knowledge Engine  – Data Infrastructure
description:
The Knowledge Platform team builds Exa's knowledge engine. We continuously synthesize information from across the web and beyond into one of the world's largest open-domain knowledge graphs, with hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims. The work has two halves: construction pipelines that decide what to trust, and retrieval engines that decide how best to search it. Our goal is to give agents answers to any factual question about the world with unprecedented precision and completeness.

In this role, you'll build the knowledge construction pipelines : turning everything from a 100k docs/s web crawl to vendor datasets into a graph of what is true about the world, and keeping it correct as data changes.

This is greenfield work with a massive scope. There is no off-the-shelf system for building a model of the world from the open web, so you'll make foundational decisions, from how claims are represented and resolved to how trust is assigned and how the graph evolves over time, that everything built on top of it depends on.

What you'll do

- Continuously synthesize the live web crawl, vendor deliveries and APIs, and other off-the-web sources into one typed graph: extraction that turns pages and records into ontology-shaped claims, each carrying its provenance, timestamp and confidence.

- Bring every new source in cleanly: versioned, append-only history with schema evolution, late-arriving and corrected records, and replayable cursors, so every claim traces back to the exact delivery that produced it.

- Decide what to trust: entity resolution across billions of records (blocking, pairwise scoring, clustering) into canonical people, companies, places and publications, then truth discovery that weighs source reliability, recency and corroboration to reconcile conflicting claims.

- Keep that picture current and convergent: streams arrive continuously, out of order and at very different rates, so the graph is eventually consistent by design. You'll build incremental computation over change data feeds, where each update is a diff of what changed and every job is idempotent and resumable, so the graph converges to the same state however runs interleave, fail or replay, and readers only ever see committed, consistent versions.

- Measure precision and completeness: labeled evals for extraction and resolution, per-source coverage and correctness metrics, and lineage that pinpoints which source or stage broke and why.

What we're looking for

- You've built and operated large-scale distributed data pipelines in production over petabytes of structured and unstructured data, with Spark over a lakehouse format (Delta Lake, Iceberg, Hudi).

- You understand incremental processing deeply: change data capture, idempotent writes, backfills and reprocessing.

- Strong in Python and at least one systems language; you can read and tune Spark query plans.

- You obsess over correctness, reliability and data quality as much as scale.

Bonus

- Entity resolution, record linkage, knowledge graphs or ontologies

- Information extraction or truth discovery at scale

- Lance or other columnar/vector-native formats

Example projects

- Take a new billion-row dataset from first delivery to queryable entities in days, not months.

- Keep a graph of hundreds of billions of claims current with incremental updates, so a fact that changes on the web reaches it in minutes.

- Build a system that knows every company and person in the world, with one evidence-backed record each, resolved across the web and every source we ingest.

Amsterdam (hybrid) | Part-time (freelance) 8 hours a week | €2,000 to €2,500 per month 

Foleon is a leading content creation platform providing business teams with a fast and scalable way to produce highly-engaging content experiences that bring a new level of intelligence to their customer journeys. 

Foleon is based in Amsterdam and New York and serves more than 1,200 global B2B brands. We value people who are bold, ambitious, collaborative, and customer-centric. Even better, the ones who know how to work hard and have fun at the same time. We’re a team of highly driven people, with a great sense of human connection and a clear focus. 

Your Mission 

As our Senior Product & AI Counsel, you’ll own the legal side of our product and AI proposition, working with us about one day a week on a retainer basis. It’s a new role. You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering and leadership to make sure what we build and ship holds up under the EU AI Act, cybersecurity law, digital accessibility rules and GDPR.

Your Job 

- Act as our product counsel: join product syncs, review features before they’re built, and flag legal and compliance questions early.

- Lead compliance for our AI proposition: classify our AI use cases, map our obligations as a provider or deployer under the EU AI Act, and set up the documentation, transparency and governance it requires.

- Make sure our platform, and the content our customers publish with it, meets the European Accessibility Act and related standards.

- Build privacy into the product by advising on GDPR questions tied to new features and data.

- Advise on cybersecurity law, including NIS2, the Cyber Resilience Act and incident reporting duties, working closely with our security team.

- Track changes in AI, cybersecurity, accessibility and privacy regulation, and turn them into practical guidance for the team.

Your Competencies & Skills 

- Senior and independent: you make calls and own them, without someone steering you.

- A practical communicator who explains complex regulation to product teams in plain language, with answers instead of memos full of caveats.

- Proactive and curious: you spot gaps before they become problems and want to understand how the product actually works.

- Comfortable working part-time and flexibly, and available when something urgent comes up.

Your Qualifications 

- A Master’s in Law (or equivalent) and 6+ years of experience, ideally a mix of law firm and in-house at a tech or SaaS company.

- Hands-on experience as product counsel for software, ideally including AI products.

- Deep working knowledge of the EU AI Act and how it applies to AI propositions in practice.

- Experience with cybersecurity law (NIS2, Cyber Resilience Act) and digital accessibility rules (European Accessibility Act).

- A solid grounding in commercial and corporate law, with working knowledge of employment law.

- GDPR and privacy expertise is a plus, ideally at DPO level or with a certification such as CIPP/E.

- Experience working with scale-ups on a retainer or fractional basis is a plus.

- Fluent English. Dutch is a plus.

title: Senior Quality Assurance Officer
description:
About Vitestro 

Founded in 2017 in Utrecht, Vitestro is pioneering the future of blood collection with the Aletta® Autonomous Robotic Phlebotomy Device™ (ARPD™) . This groundbreaking medical device combines advanced multi-modal imaging (near-infrared, ultrasound, and Doppler ultrasound) with robotics and AI to perform the entire diagnostic blood draw procedure autonomously.

By addressing critical healthcare staffing shortages and improving patient experience, Vitestro is transforming one of the most common and essential medical procedures. With more than 130 team members and growing rapidly, we are scaling our impact. As we placed our first devices with customers, we are now expanding our team to ensure successful implementation and long-term reliability.

At Vitestro, we are committed to continuous innovation and improvement. 

As our Senior QS officer, you focus on the continuous improvement of our quality systems and support the company through the change control process. You review existing quality processes, identify where they can be improved or made more compliant, and help develop practical solutions to make those improvements happen. 

You also guide colleagues through change control. Rather than executing every change yourself, you ensure people understand and follow the process, ask the right questions, consider the relevant implications, obtain the necessary approvals, and ensure that changes are completed Correctly and on time. 

This role requires a strong analytical and systematic mindset combined with a pragmatic approach to quality. You should be comfortable identifying problems, but more importantly, finding workable solutions and alternatives. You understand the requirements of working in a regulated environment without approaching quality as simply enforcing rules. You are able to adapt, think creatively and help the organisation find compliant ways forward. 

First months at Vitestro 

In your first months, you get to know Vitestro’s quality systems, processes, and the teams working with them. You build a thorough understanding of our Change Control process and start supporting colleagues through changes, helping them consider the right questions and ensuring changes are complete, appropriately approved, and progressing on time. As you become familiar with how we work, you identify opportunities to improve the compliance and efficiency of the Change Control process and develop a clear plan for implementing those improvements. 

This is what success looks like: 

After 12 months, you are a trusted partner for colleagues working with our quality systems and Change Control process. You confidently support the organization in executing changes, ensuring they are well considered, appropriately approved, and completed on time. You have improved the Change Control process to strengthen both compliance and efficiency, and have identified and implemented improvements across other areas of the QMS. You combine strong analytical thinking with a pragmatic and creative approach. You don’t just identify where something could be improved; you translate those insights into practical solutions and, when one approach doesn’t work, find alternative ways forward. 

What You’ll Bring: 

- Strong analytical thinking and the ability to assess existing processes, identify where issues occur and determine how they can be improved.

- Experience working in a regulated environment.

- Relevant professional experience that provides an understanding of how quality systems and processes work.

- A systematic, process-oriented way of working.

- The ability to identify and develop solutions to quality and process problems.

- A pragmatic and adaptable mindset, with the ability to think beyond rigid or established approaches while respecting regulatory requirements.

- The ability to guide colleagues through processes by asking questions, highlighting considerations and ensuring required steps are completed.

- Bachelor’s degree or higher in engineering, applied sciences, biomedical engineering, or similar technical field

- Minimum 3 to 5 years experience in Quality Assurance / Quality Systems for medical devices.

Nice to have: 

- Experience across multiple organisations or environments, providing exposure to different ways of working.

- Medical-device experience can be relevant but is not required.

- Experience with MDSAP 

How We Work 

At Vitestro, ownership is not a slogan - it is an expectation. We trust people to take responsibility, make decisions, and drive work forward.

We believe breakthroughs happen when talented people combine dedication, accountability, and teamwork. That means:

- We take initiative rather than wait for direction.

- We focus on execution and delivering results.

- We proactively remove blockers and help each other succeed.

- We challenge ideas, not people.

- We continuously learn, improve, and raise the bar.

- We celebrate team success over individual heroics.

We move fast, but we do so thoughtfully. We care deeply about quality because the technology we build ultimately impacts patients and healthcare professionals.

If you are looking for an environment where you can make a significant contribution, take ownership of meaningful work, and be surrounded by highly motivated colleagues, we'd love to meet you.

What we offer 

- Competitive salary including pension plan 

- 25 days of annual leave based on a full-time position 

- Hybrid work model

Jouw afstudeeropdracht 

Tijdens je afstudeerstage onderzoek je hoe het huidige marketing- en propositieproces verloopt: van een eerste idee tot content, campagne, lead en commerciële opvolging. title: Technical Integrations Manager
description:
At Vio we believe booking accommodation should feel smart, fair, and effortless — never overwhelming or unclear.

As one of the world’s fastest-growing travel tech platforms, we help millions of users make smarter travel decisions by comparing stays across 100+ booking sites — so they can find the perfect place, at the best price, anywhere in the world. We cut through the noise and complexity of hotel and vacation rental booking, surfacing real value with clarity, transparency, and full support. No tricks. No confusion. Just great stays — booked with confidence. With operations in 100+ markets and growing fast, our mission is to reshape how people discover and book accommodation through technology travelers can trust.

We are looking for an experienced Technical Integrations Manager to join our Supply Integrations team and help us onboard new hotel suppliers, keep 70+ live integrations healthy, and be the technical voice our partners talk to.

Vio connects to hotel suppliers through APIs: wholesalers, bed banks, hotel chains, and connectivity platforms. The Supply Integrations squad builds and runs those integrations. You will join a second Technical Integrations Manager and a team of backend engineers, reporting to the squad's Engineering Manager. This is a hands-on technical role, not a coordination role: you own each integration in your portfolio from the first look at a partner's API documentation through implementation, QA sign-off, launch, and live operations. You decide when an integration is good enough to go live, and you are the person a partner's representative emails when something looks wrong.

What you will do: 

- Assess new partner APIs: read the documentation critically, make test calls, find the gaps and limitations before our engineers hit them, and document what we need from the partner.

- Run technical onboarding with partners: credentials, environments, communication channels, and everything an engineer needs to start on day one.

- Act as the single technical point of contact for both partners and engineers during implementation, answering questions and unblocking issues fast.

- Own pre-launch quality: test search, booking, cancellation, and modification flows end to end; verify prices, availability, and tax and fee breakdowns; and sign off on go-live. No integration launches without your approval.

- Watch the live portfolio: use dashboards and alerts to catch throttling, error spikes, and data-quality drift early, investigate, fix what is in reach (configuration, CMS, small pull requests), and work with partners on the rest.

- Keep a per-supplier incident history, spot recurring patterns, and drive the automation and process changes that remove manual work.

- Maintain the integrations roadmap with the Engineering Manager, Product, and Partnerships, and keep stakeholders informed on progress and risks.

- Continuously improve our integration lifecycle checklist based on what each launch teaches us.

Who you are: 

- You have 3+ years in a partner-facing technical role, such as technical integrations manager, integration or solutions engineer, technical account manager, or connectivity manager, and have owned a portfolio of live API integrations.

- You are comfortable in Postman or similar software, not afraid of JSON and XML payloads, and can tell from a response what is wrong with it. Logs and dashboards are tools you reach for, not something you ask engineers to check.

- You read API documentation critically and can assess technical viability.

- You write clearly and briefly. A partner engineer can act on your email without a call.

- You manage many parallel threads without dropping follow-ups and are resourceful when a partner is slow or the documentation is incomplete.

- You improve processes rather than repeat them: you have built checklists, templates, or automation that made your previous team faster.

- Hotel distribution experience (rate types, board codes, merchant vs agency models) is a strong plus; we will teach it to someone with the skills above.

Why join us now? 

- We are one of the most innovative and fastest-growing accommodation booking platforms in the world today, having grown our bookings 30x between 2017 and 2025, and catering to the needs of over 100 million unique visitors worldwide each year. We do that by harnessing the power of advanced algorithms and an innovative suite of power features and managed to overcome the corona crisis remarkably fast ;

- The mobile applications ( iOS and Android ) we launched in 2023 are already a big success, reaching 5 million installs with great customer reviews, as we are beginning to build Vio as the brand for value-seeking travellers worldwide;

- We are a passionate and diverse team of tech enthusiasts and creatives with a commitment and focus on the traveler above all else - and it shows in our industry-leading TrustPilot score ;

Do you want to know if Vio is the right place for you? Find out by reading about the attitude that thrives at Vio.

The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Your Role in Our Story: 

As a Senior Recruiter at ACT, you will attract and hire commercial talent, primarily -and not alone- for our Front Office teams. You will manage the recruitment process from intake to offer, working closely with hiring managers to understand their business, challenge requirements and turn hiring needs into effective recruitment strategies.

You understand our markets and what motivates people working in environmental commodities, energy and trading. You use this knowledge to identify talent, build relationships and give practical advice on how to attract the right candidates.

- 
Own the full recruitment cycle, primarily for Front Office positions, including sales, trading and business development.

- 
Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements, agree on selection criteria and keep recruitment moving.

- 
Proactively source and engage candidates, building talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs.

- 
Bring market knowledge into hiring discussions, advising on talent availability, competitor activity and candidate expectations.

- 
Conduct thorough interviews and support objective, consistent hiring decisions.

- 
Deliver a positive candidate experience through clear communication, timely feedback and careful follow-up.

- 
Keep Greenhouse accurate and up to date, using recruitment data to identify bottlenecks and improve results.

- 
Work closely with fellow recruiters, HR and Employer Branding, sharing knowledge and contributing to team priorities.

Your Expertise: 

To be successful in this role, we are looking for candidates with the following qualifications and attributes:

- 
3–5 years of recruitment experience, with a strong track record of hiring for commercial or Front Office positions.

- 
Knowledge of environmental commodities, energy, trading or closely related financial and commodity markets.

- 
Strong sourcing skills and experience engaging passive candidates in competitive international markets.

- 
Confidence working with hiring managers, offering practical advice and respectfully challenging assumptions.

- 
An eager, proactive approach: you take initiative, spot opportunities and follow through.

- 
A collaborative mindset: you share insights, support colleagues and take responsibility for team results.

- 
Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage several vacancies and changing priorities.

- 
Experience using an ATS, preferably Greenhouse, and an interest in applying recruitment technology and AI effectively.

- 
Excellent communication skills in English and the ability to connect with people across different cultures and backgrounds.

If you meet these criteria and are ready to contribute your expertise to a dynamic and challenging environment, we encourage you to apply.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Auterion, you will play a pivotal role in the successful development, integration and deployment of Auterion-powered drone systems. 

In this role, you will collaborate closely with the production, hardware engineering, and firmware/software teams, as well as operations, ensuring that every platform transitions smoothly from an airframe concept into a fully validated flying robot ready for deployment. You will serve as the primary technical interface for partners, work closely with them to understand their technical requirements, configure and adapt existing solutions, contribute to core software development, and ensure successful implementation. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys combining hands-on technical work with customer collaboration and system-level problem solving, bridging the gap between hardware, firmware, and real-world flight performance. 

Responsibilities and Duties 

- Operate in a highly hands-on environment with evolving system requirements, rapidly iterating across hardware and software integration challenges.

- Manage software releases and perform firmware flashing and configuration using PX4 or adjacent autopilot ecosystems, including sensor calibration, ESC tuning, and system bring-up.

- Provide deep avionics and airframe expertise, including autopilot tuning, sensor and payload integration, power systems and airworthiness considerations.

- Work independently to troubleshoot integration and flight-readiness issues while collaborating cross-functionally with hardware engineering, firmware/software teams, operations, and QC engineering to escalate complex challenges when required.

- Act as the primary technical authority in customer engagements, translating mission requirements into concrete system architectures and demonstrable solutions built on AuterionOS and Skynode.

- Participate in flight testing activities to validate platform stability, safety, and mission performance, resolving technical issues often directly in the field during customer trials and demonstrations.

- Contribute to technical documentation and continuous improvement of engineering processes.

- Feed customer and market requirements back into product and engineering teams to influence the roadmap of the Auterion stack.

Qualifications and Skills 

- Degree in Software, Electrical, Mechanical, Aerospace or Robotics Engineering, or a related field

- Working proficiency in C/C++ and Python: you can read, debug and patch existing code and write small tools and scripts

- Comfortable in Linux environments, including the command line, logs, Docker and basic networking (IP, TCP/UDP)

- Hands-on hardware-software integration: system bring-up, wiring and connectors, and embedded interfaces (UART, CAN, I2C, SPI) at a practical level

- Structured troubleshooting: you can isolate whether a problem is software, hardware, configuration or RF, often under time pressure in the field

- Strong communicator: you can explain technical issues clearly to customers and operators, and report findings back to engineering in a way they can act on

- Willing to travel and work on-site with customers, including at test ranges and in field environments

- EU citizenship (required for security clearance and customer requirements)

Nice-to-have 

- Experience with PX4 or ArduPilot, MAVLink, QGroundControl or mission planning tools

- UAV flight testing and validation in operational environments

- Experience with datalinks and radio systems

- Previous customer-facing or field engineering role, especially with defense or government customers

- German language skills

Benefits 

- Flexible working hours

- Stock Options

- Generous holiday allowance

- Pension plan 

- Extended social security package 

- Enhanced maternity & paternity leave

About Auterion 

We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems.

At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.

title: HR Medewerker Senior (m/v/x)
description:
Een ervaren HR-professional die graag complexe HR-vraagstukken oppakt, kennis deelt, overzicht houdt en bijdraagt aan een goede HR-dienstverlening. 

Voor onze volop in beweging zijnde HR administratie/HR-support team zoeken we een ervaren HR-professional die goed thuis is in HR operatie en graag meedenkt over uiteenlopende HR-vraagstukken. Je bent een inhoudelijke vraagbaak voor collega’s en steekt zelf graag de handen uit de mouwen. Met een proactieve blik kijk je verder dan de dagelijkse praktijk en zie je kansen om processen te verbeteren. Herken jij jezelf hierin en bouw je graag mee aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze afdeling? Solliciteer dan snel!

Wat ga je doen?

Jij zorgt er samen met je hr-collega’s voor dat de basis van onze HR-administratie op orde is, maar jouw meerwaarde zit vooral in het behandelen van complexere operationele HR-vraagstukken, het ondersteunen van HR collega’s en het samen met de teamleider verder ontwikkelen van onze dienstverlening. Je bent een inhoudelijke vraagbaak voor het HR-team en een vertrouwd aanspreekpunt voor NLR medewerkers en HR-adviseurs.

Als senior HR medewerker heb je een veelzijdige rol waarin HR-administratie, dienstverlening, inhoudelijke expertise en procesverbetering samenkomen. Jouw HR collega’s houden zich bezig met de dagelijkse HR-processen, waarbij jij je richt op vooral vraagstukken die meer ervaring, inzicht en zelfstandigheid vragen. Daarnaast deel je actief je kennis met collega's, denk je mee over een slimme verdeling van het werk en draag je bij aan de kwaliteit van onze dienstverlening.

Jouw werkzaamheden in het kort: 

- Vraagbaak voor het HR-team : je behandelt tweedelijns HR-vraagstukken over bijvoorbeeld arbeidsvoorwaarden, personeelsregelingen en HR processen, detachering, inleen en deelt je kennis en ondersteunt collega’s.

- Samenwerken met de teamleider HR : je werkt aan HR-projecten, verbetert processen en bewaakt de voortgang, met name bij piekmomenten.

- Ondersteunen van de HR Adviseurs en managers : je helpt bij operationele HR-vraagstukken en zorgt voor een goede aansluiting tussen HR-processen en de praktijk.

- Zorgen voor goede HR-dienstverlening : je bewaakt de kwaliteit van de HR-administratie en hebt contact met medewerkers. Je draagt bij aan een juiste en tijdige verwerking van personeelsgegevens en ondersteunt waar nodig bij eerstelijnsvragen.

- Bouwen aan de HR-afdeling : je signaleert knelpunten, denkt mee over praktische/operationele verbeteringen, helpt werkprocessen te uniformeren en deelt je kennis met collega's.

Wat breng je mee?

We zoeken iemand die senioriteit laat zien in zowel gedrag als HR-kennis. Je hoeft niet alles te weten, maar je hebt een stevige basis, durft verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en weet wanneer je zelfstandig kunt handelen en wanneer afstemming nodig is. First time right is het devies, kwalitatieve en zorgvuldige HR administratie en dienstverlening vinden wij belangrijk.

Verder breng je mee: 

- Afgeronde opleiding in HRM of een vergelijkbare richting met minimaal vijf jaar relevante ervaring binnen HR, bij voorkeur in een brede HR-administratieve functie en kennis van AFAS.

- Je hebt gedegen kennis van HR administratie en support en ervaring met het zelfstandig behandelen van HR-vraagstukken over bijvoorbeeld arbeidsvoorwaarden en personeelsregelingen.

- Je bent communicatief sterk, toegankelijk en klantgericht. Je maakt gemakkelijk contact met medewerkers en collega’s op verschillende niveaus.

- Je werkt graag samen, durft je eigen perspectief in te brengen en staat open voor feedback en andere inzichten.

- Je werkt nauwkeurig, hebt oog voor details en houdt overzicht en helpt collega’s om werkzaamheden goed en tijdig af te ronden.

- Je bent gewend en krijgt er energie van om in een snel groeiende en veranderende organisatie te werken.

- Je beheerst het Nederlands en Engels goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk op C1 niveau.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Bij NLR krijg je de ruimte om impact te maken én jezelf te ontwikkelen. Je werkt in een innovatieve nationale en internationale hightechomgeving waar nieuwsgierigheid, samenwerking en vakmanschap centraal staan. We geloven dat mensen het beste presteren als ze de vrijheid krijgen om initiatief te nemen, zich te blijven ontwikkelen en een gezonde balans te vinden tussen werk en privé.

Verder bieden we je onder andere: 

- Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 4400,- en € 5000 (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek) , afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring;

- 45 verlofdagen (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek); 

- 8% vakantiegeld én een vaste eindejaarsuitkering van 8%;

- De kosten voor reizen met het openbaar vervoer worden volledig vergoed. Reis je met eigen vervoer? Dan ontvang je een kilometervergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer.

- Een zorgtoelage van €145,- bruto (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek) via onze collectieve zorgverzekering bij OHRA als extra ondersteuning voor jouw zorgkosten;

- Extra betaald ouderschapsverlof;

- Volop kansen om te blijven leren met opleidingen, trainingen, coaching en andere ontwikkelmogelijkheden;

- De mogelijkheid om 32-40 uur per week te werken inclusief thuiswerken.

Jouw nieuwe werkomgeving

Je wordt onderdeel van een breed HR-team met verschillende expertises, van HR-advies en beleid tot recruitment en Learning & Development. We sparren graag met elkaar, houden elkaar scherp en inspireren elkaar om verder te komen. Er is volop ruimte voor jouw ideeën, kennis en initiatief, met oog voor elkaar en het gezamenlijke resultaat. Samen werken we aan HR-dienstverlening die aansluit bij de behoeften van de organisatie en bijdraagt aan onze strategische ambities.

Onze HR-afdeling is volop in ontwikkeling en werkt aan verdere professionalisering en verbetering van processen en samenwerking. Dat biedt kansen, maar vraagt ook iets van jou. Je komt terecht in een HR-afdeling waar we volop werken aan het verbeteren van onze dienstverlening. We brengen meer structuur aan, maken onze processen eenvoudiger en werken steeds nauwer samen. Dat betekent dat niet alles al vastligt en dat er ruimte is om mee te denken en dingen slimmer te organiseren. Je standplaats is Amsterdam of Marknesse , maar je bent ook regelmatig op onze andere locatie voor overleg en samenwerking met collega’s.

Wat betekent werken bij NLR?

Koninklijke NLR is al meer dan 100 jaar een toonaangevende kennisinstelling voor toegepast onderzoek in de lucht- en ruimtevaart. Samen met meer dan 1000 professionals werken we aan innovatieve oplossingen voor een duurzamere, veiligere en efficiëntere lucht- en ruimtevaart. We willen dat iedereen bij NLR de ruimte krijgt om zichzelf te zijn, talenten te ontwikkelen en ideeën in te brengen. Door verschillen te waarderen en van elkaar te leren, creëren we samen een inclusieve werkomgeving.

Wil jij meer weten?

Mail dan met Christel Bouwers (Recruiter) via Onze collega’s vertellen jou graag hoe het is om bij NLR te werken. Vergeet trouwens ook niet eens een kijkje op onze socials te nemen zoals ons YouTube kanaal . 

Solliciteren?

Mooi, we zijn benieuwd naar jou! Stuur je motivatiebrief en CV via de ‘Solliciteren’ button. 

Een positieve uitkomst van een veiligheidsonderzoek (VGB) is een voorwaarde voor indiensttreding. Meer informatie daarover lees je op de website van de MIVD.

Acquisitie wordt niet op prijs gesteld!

title: Product Designer
description:
Software is not just vital but a strategic cornerstone of our operations. We’re looking for a Product Designer to set the cross-application UX direction for our commercial software - from pharma cold-chain visibility that helps temperature-sensitive medicines move safely around the world, to ULD tracking for airlines. You’ll define a consistent, high-quality experience across our modules and applications and support our specialised designers in bringing that experience to life, while remaining hands-on in discovery, from the first user conversation through to the final UX.

📍 Location: We are open to candidates based anywhere within the UK, Spain, and the Netherlands, with remote working available within these countries . Hybrid option available in the Netherlands.

Founded in Switzerland in 2012, SkyCell is transforming global pharmaceutical supply chains through a combination of advanced temperature-controlled containers, IoT connectivity, and digital solutions.

Our integrated product ecosystem helps leading pharmaceutical companies reduce risk, improve operational efficiency, and ensure the safe delivery of life-saving medicines worldwide.

Today, SkyCell operates at the intersection of hardware, software, data, and logistics - combining Swiss engineering excellence with a growing digital platform to shape the future of connected pharma supply chains.

Why SkyCell? 

🌱 Purpose-Driven Work: Make a real difference by contributing to a more sustainable future in global logistics and healthcare.

🚀 Innovation at Heart: Work with cutting-edge technology and be at the forefront of supply chain innovation.

🌎 Stronger together: Join a supportive team of talented individuals from over 40 countries, where we work together every step of the way.

💡 Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in our people – continuous learning and development are key pillars of SkyCell.

🏆 Award-Winning Culture: Join a workplace recognized for its commitment to excellence with a ‘Great Place to work’ award, as well as a Platinum Ecovadis rating highlighting our sustainability and employee well-being.

What You'll Do: 

A dedicated framework team owns our Design System and Design Guidelines, while embedded designers craft the screens and flows within each product module. Your role is to set the overall direction for the experience they design towards — including experience principles, end-to-end journeys and measurable outcomes that help multiple modules feel like one product. 

You will:

- Lead discovery end-to-end, including user research and interviews, journey mapping, jobs-to-be-done, pain points and opportunities, and translate research into a shared foundation for UX and product decisions

- Create wireframes, mock-ups and prototypes hands-on using Figma and/or code to explore and test concepts during discovery, and run evaluative tests with users and engineers

- Define the cross-application UX vision, design principles and success metrics together with Product and Marketing

- Support and align our specialised designers - framework and embedded - around a consistent experience across modules and applications

- Communicate UX principles and investment priorities to senior leadership, demonstrating the value and potential impact of UX-related roadmap items

- Maintain the UX roadmap and prioritise pattern and design investments with the framework team

- Produce high-level experience flows and service blueprints that connect journeys across applications and domains

- Review Design System and module deliverables for alignment with experience strategy and brand

- Support embedded designers from discovery through to delivery by co-framing problems, reviewing flows against the cross-application blueprint and ensuring continuity across user journeys

- Set KPIs and use analytics, user research, A/B tests and competitive analysis to inform and refine design decisions

- Promote a UX culture centred on user needs, inclusive design and accessibility standards such as WCAG across the organisation

- Collaborate with Marketing on tone, terminology and brand consistency across products

What You'll Bring: 

- Degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

- Experience as a senior or lead product designer working on complex B2B software, ideally within supply chain, logistics, aviation/air cargo or pharma

- Strong experience leading discovery, from understanding user needs through research and prototyping to defining and refining UX solutions

- Advanced proficiency in Figma, with experience creating and iterating wireframes, mock-ups and prototypes

- Experience bringing together multiple designers, including without formal reporting lines, to create a consistent experience across products or modules

- Ability to communicate UX strategy, priorities and recommendations clearly to senior stakeholders

- Working knowledge of design systems and accessibility standards such as WCAG; experience partnering with design system teams is an advantage

- Experience designing for multiple user groups, such as pharma quality/logistics teams and airline cargo operations, is beneficial

If you don’t meet every requirement but bring relevant experience and skills, we’d still like to hear from you.

What's In It For You? 

⚡ Flexibility & Balance: Flexible working hours and work-life balance allow you to tailor work to fit your life.

🌟 Recognition & Growth: Opportunities for career advancement in a company that values your contributions.

🌍 Flexible ways of working: Our global teams work across our offices in Zurich, Zug, Hyderabad and Basel, with a mix of on-site, hybrid and remote working. Role-specific locations and working arrangements are detailed above. 

🎉 Company-wide Events: Join us for company events to celebrate successes, build teams, and share our vision. Plus, new joiners experience SkyWeek, our immersive onboarding program.

👶 Generous Maternity & Paternity Leave: Support for new parents with competitive maternity and paternity leave.

🏖️ Annual Leave & Bank Holidays: Enjoy a generous annual leave package, plus local bank holidays to recharge and unwind.

Ready to Make an Impact? 

We’re not just offering a job; we’re offering a chance to be part of something bigger. At SkyCell, you’ll help build a future where pharmaceutical delivery is efficient, sustainable, and transformative.

title: Senior Engineer I, Systems Engineering - Controls Engineer
description:
Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture. ​

For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving.  But we’re more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world. Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential. 

Senior Engineer I - Controls Engineer 

ASM | Simulation & Modeling Hub | Almere, Netherlands 

Design, tune and validate control systems for ASM semiconductor process tools, with an emphasis on precision temperature control. Work with experienced controls engineers and equipment and process teams to translate process requirements into control strategies, then verify their performance on physical tools. The role combines dynamic modeling, controller development and hands-on testing, with opportunities to take ownership of control functions.

Responsibilities 

- Translate process and equipment needs into measurable control requirements for temperature accuracy, stability, uniformity, repeatability and response during recipe changes.

- Design and tune feedback and feedforward control strategies for heating and cooling systems. Address interactions between zones and account for sensor and actuator limits.

- Plan and run tests on laboratory and production-representative equipment. Analyze sensor and actuator data, use system identification to develop or calibrate dynamic models, and compare predictions with measured responses.

- Work with software, equipment and process engineers to integrate control logic, troubleshoot performance on the tool, and support commissioning and validation.

- Document control logic, test procedures, tuning parameters and validation results so other engineers can reproduce tests and maintain the controls.

Required qualifications 

- Degree in controls, electrical, mechanical or mechatronics engineering, applied physics, or related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

- Hands-on experience designing, testing or tuning closed-loop controls on physical equipment. Relevant industry, laboratory or applied research projects are welcome.

- Working proficiency in MATLAB/Simulink or an equivalent environment for dynamic modeling, data analysis and control design. Familiarity with system identification and instrumentation.

- Ability to troubleshoot equipment methodically and communicate results to colleagues across engineering disciplines.

Preferred experience 

- Precision temperature control, heat transfer or thermal instrumentation in semiconductor equipment or other precision industrial systems.

- Experience with multizone or cascade control, model-based control, sensor calibration or equipment commissioning.

- Experience with Simcenter Amesim or other tools for modeling system dynamics and validating control strategies

Apply today to be part of what’s next. 

We make the tech that enables the chips in devices which improve lives around the world. We do this with an eye to the future, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible through cutting-edge innovation, and driving the next wave of technological breakthroughs that shape how we live, work, and connect.

Tide is hiring a VP of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind Ongoing Monitoring. You will report directly to the Chief Data and Technology Officer. Ongoing Monitoring protects our members by detecting fraud, financial crime and regulatory risk across every transaction Tide processes. The engineering, data science and platform capability behind it is one of the most technically demanding estates at Tide.

You will be accountable for the engineering strategy, organisation and execution across all Ongoing Monitoring value streams: real-time transaction monitoring for bank payments fraud, acquiring fraud, Anti Money Laundering, Counter Terrorist Financing, sanctions and prohibited activities monitoring, and the tooling our financial investigators depend on. Our first line operations teams are the primary internal customer, our second line sets the risk appetite, and our regulators set the bar. - Build the operating model that connects first line operations, second line risk and compliance, payments and acquiring engineering, KYX, AI Platforms and data science leadership behind one roadmap

title: Staff Fullstack Engineer
description:
Deep Tech Recruitment is partnering with a Speedinvest venture-backed European AI company building the modern software backbone for specialist pharmaceutical and chemical manufacturers.

Its mission is to strengthen the resilience of essential European supply chains by helping manufacturers overcome skilled labour shortages, respond faster to disruption and reduce the operational risk created by ageing ERP systems, spreadsheets and fragmented knowledge. The business is developing an AI-native operating environment that provides consistent data and intelligent workflows across order management, production planning, materials planning and procurement, while retaining the human oversight required in regulated industries.

The company 

The company is building an AI native software backbone for specialist manufacturers, initially across mission critical pharmaceutical and chemical supply chains. Many of these businesses still run critical order, planning and procurement processes through ageing ERP systems, spreadsheets and knowledge held by a small number of experienced employees.

The product combines workflow automation, AI agents and human approval to help operational teams respond faster while maintaining accuracy, traceability and compliance. The engineering team works close to customers, including visits to operational environments, to understand how work happens and turn it into dependable software.

The role 

As an early staff engineering hire, you will help shape the platform from its first production versions. This is a hands on full stack role with strong backend ownership. You will work directly with the founders, influence architecture and engineering standards, and stay close to the users whose workflows you are improving.

Why consider it 

You will have meaningful influence over the architecture, product and early engineering culture.

The technical work combines AI enabled systems, enterprise integration and demanding operational constraints.

The product supports essential European industries where software reliability and human judgement both matter.

The package includes a competitive base salary and meaningful early stage equity through a VSOP.

What you will do 

- Build end to end product features with TypeScript, Node.js, React and Next.js.

- Design and evolve backend services, APIs and system architecture for complex operational workflows.

- Model and optimise data in PostgreSQL, with attention to reliability, performance and auditability.

- Develop multi step AI agent workflows with validation logic, evaluations, monitoring and human approval points.

- Integrate with enterprise systems including ERPs, communication tools and document platforms through REST APIs and other interfaces.

- Support cloud and on premises deployments, working directly with customer IT teams where required.

- Build secure, traceable workflows suitable for regulated environments and contribute to audit readiness and compliance documentation.

- Join customer conversations, understand real operating constraints and translate them into product and technical decisions.

- Help establish the engineering culture, technical bar and practical ways of working for the team as it grows.

What AI native means here 

The company uses external language models and coding agents to build and ship software faster. The role involves engineering reliable AI enabled workflows around those models. It does not involve training foundation models or conducting AI research. Strong software engineering judgement remains central, particularly around evaluation, failure modes, observability and human oversight.

What you bring 

- Around 3 to 5 or more years of experience building and operating production software.

- Strong backend engineering skills with Node.js, API design and system architecture.

- Solid PostgreSQL experience, including data modelling and query optimisation.

- Experience integrating REST APIs and external systems.

- The ability to work across the stack using JavaScript or TypeScript and React or Next.js.

- A hands on approach. You can reason about architecture and still write, test and ship production code.

- Fluent English for technical collaboration and customer conversations.

- The willingness to work with the team from the Berlin office five days a week.

Useful additional experience 

- Enterprise software or products built for regulated, high security environments.

- LLM integrations using providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic or Google, including evaluation and monitoring.

- ERP integrations such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 or Infor.

- Cloud infrastructure, DevOps and connections to on premises or legacy systems.

- German language skills for direct customer communication.

- Strong product and UX instincts, or experience working with design systems.

How the team works 

- High ownership and direct access to the founding team.

- Fast iteration informed by customer workflows and operational reality.

- Clear expectations, practical decision making and space to shape how engineering is done.

- A long term product build with the opportunity to grow into broader technical leadership as the team expands.

The process combines founder & engineering conversations with practical technical assessment. You should expect an architecture discussion and a hands-on coding exercise focused on how you think, communicate and build with modern engineering tools, including AI-assisted development.

Inclusion and accessibility 

Our client is committed to an inclusive environment in which people of every gender identity, sexual orientation, race, religion, age, neurotype and disability can belong and contribute. Diverse teams make better decisions, and equity is treated as a condition for innovation.

If you need reasonable adjustments during the application or interview process, including assistive technology, additional time or another format, tell your Deep Tech Recruitment contact and we will support you.

title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
description:
At CesiumAstro , we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team. 

In this position, you will be responsible for low-level and high-level software in CesiumAstro’s products through all phases of the development process. Key projects will include Linux-based single-board computers and high-reliability microcontroller systems. Cesium’s goal is to create an out-of-the-box hardware and software experience which enhances our customers’ ability to rapidly integrate our products into their systems. 

As a CesiumAstro software team member, you will be responsible for software designs from concept through production, including product roadmaps, block diagrams, detailed design and coding, analysis, test, qualification, and in-orbit support. The ideal candidate will have development experience at nearly every level of the software stack, including microcontrollers, low-level drivers, board support packages (BSP), end-use applications, and user interfaces. Additionally, the ideal candidate will have experience in software testing and high-reliability qualification, as well as software engineering and software project management practices. 

The successful candidate will present engineering design review materials to our customers and executive team, as well as participate in proposal-writing efforts. As such, excellent written and verbal communication skills are required. 

SUMMARY OF RESPONSIBILITIES 

- Design and implement software for embedded devices and systems, from requirements to production and commercial deployment 

- Design, develop, code, test, debug and document system software 

- Review code and system designs 

- Analyze code for efficiency, stability and scalability 

- Integrate and validate new product designs 

- Support software quality assurance and optimize I/O performance 

- Provide post-production/in-orbit customer support 

- Interface with hardware design and development engineers 

- Assess third party and open-source software 

JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS 

- Bachelor of Science (BS) or Master of Science (MS) degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or Computer Engineering 

- Minimum of 5 years of industry experience in software development. 

- Experience in hands-on development and troubleshooting of embedded hardware. API design for interfacing with FPGAs. 

- Experience with products for aerospace applications 

- Programming experience in C or C++ 

- Experience in embedded systems design with preemptive, multitasking real-time operating systems (experience with real-time Linux is desirable) 

- Familiarity with software configuration management tools, defect tracking tools, and peer review 

- Excellent knowledge of real-time system coding techniques, IP protocols, interfaces, and hardware subsystems 

- Excellent understanding of multi-threaded applications and resource management 

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills 

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE 

- Adequate knowledge of reading electronics schematics and component data sheets 

- Experience with ARM processors and fully-featured microcontrollers 

- Experience in design and development of a Software Development Kit (SDK) 

WHAT WE OFFER 

- The opportunity to help establish CesiumAstro’s European office and grow our Munich team.

- High-impact role with direct exposure to leading EU space programs.

- Competitive compensation and benefits package.

- A collaborative, innovative environment shaping the future of space communications.

title: Principal Software Architect
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Product Architecture and Safety Teams 

Our Product Architecture and Safety teams connect Wayve’s core AI Driver with the vehicle platforms that bring autonomous driving technology to customers. Working across Engineering, Product, Safety, Validation and customer programs, we define how our software integrates with OEM and Tier 1 systems, supporting safe, reliable deployment while maintaining a consistent core product architecture.

🧠 Your day-to-day 

As a Principal Software Architect, you’ll lead the technical architecture for integrating Wayve’s autonomous driving technology with automotive OEM vehicle platforms. You’ll work at the boundary between our core AI Driver and external vehicle systems, translating product ambitions and customer needs into clear interfaces, requirements and technical decisions.

Your work will span high-level architecture and implementation details, from sensors and middleware to ECU constraints, timing, diagnostics, safety assumptions, data logging and validation. You’ll bring structure to ambiguous problems, guide architecture work across teams and own key decisions across customer programs. Along the way, you’ll build alignment with engineering, product, safety, validation, program and commercial leaders.

🧩 What you’ll be working on 

- Defining integration architecture: Shape how Wayve software interfaces with OEM and Tier 1 vehicle systems, balancing customer program needs with the evolution and reusability of our core architecture.

- Making ownership explicit: Turn customer and partner discussions into clear interface contracts, ownership boundaries, assumptions, dependencies and open technical decisions, including what is Wayve-owned, partner-owned, jointly defined or out of scope.

- Translating needs into requirements: Partner with Product and Engineering to develop actionable technical specifications. Establish a consistent approach to decomposing customer requirements into system and software requirements, including allocation, traceability and change control.

- Owning architecture decisions: Lead architecture reviews, maintain decision records and make the final technical call within your scope when consensus cannot be reached.

- Planning for successful delivery: Assess feasibility, integration complexity, technical gaps and risks. Identify dependencies and required partner deliverables to support customer program planning.

- Building verifiable solutions: Work with Safety and Validation teams to define safety assumptions, integration test requirements and clear evidence that customer requirements have been met.

- Representing Wayve with partners: Lead technical discussions with OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers, supported by clear interface specifications, integration guides, architecture diagrams and decision records.

- Leading across teams: Coordinate architects and engineering teams, negotiate competing priorities, resolve or escalate conflicts early, and mentor architects and senior engineers to build a shared architecture culture.

🙌 You should apply if 

- You bring substantial experience in ADAS, autonomous driving, embedded software or vehicle systems, particularly at the software–vehicle interface. Typically, you’ll have 12+ years of relevant experience, including architecture ownership for a complete product or multiple programs.

- You can define clear product boundaries, ownership models and interface contracts between internal software and external vehicle systems.

- You understand vehicle electronics and embedded software constraints, including ECU integration, real-time execution, timing, diagnostics and production vehicle software environments.

- You’re familiar with automotive communication protocols and electrical/electronic architectures, such as CAN, FlexRay, Automotive Ethernet, SOME/IP or AUTOSAR.

- You’ve worked with automotive OEMs or Tier 1 suppliers and can navigate their requirements, standards and integration constraints.

- You’ve established and run requirements processes across multiple teams or programs, translating ambiguous needs into clear, traceable and verifiable system and software specifications.

- You can move confidently between system-level architecture and implementation details, making sound technical decisions under uncertainty and maintaining consistency as programs evolve.

- You’ve led architecture work across teams and influenced senior stakeholders without direct authority, building support and handling competing priorities constructively.

- You communicate complex technical ideas clearly through specifications, diagrams and reviews, and enjoy mentoring others.

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

More about Wayve: 

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working: 

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

🔍 The Interview Process: 

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

- Initial call / recruiter screen 

- Hiring Manager Interview 

- Deep-dive technical interviews 

- Final interview : mission & values alignment 

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

What’s in it for you (Location dependant): 

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

description:
About Us 

We are building Physics AI for hardware design . Our software platform helps hardware designers and physics simulation engineers explore, analyze, and optimize hardware systems, leveraging cutting-edge AI to deliver ultrafast, accurate physics intelligence within the realities of engineering design workflows.

Our first product bridges the gap between the accuracy & determinism of traditional simulation and the speed & scaling of AI, and is redefining how the world’s most advanced semiconductors are designed, verified, built, brought to market and integrated in complex systems.

Role Overview 

As a pivotal leader within our European Forward Deployment team , you will drive the adoption of Vinci’s platform among the region's top engineering organizations. In this strategic role, you will build, mentor, and guide a high-performing team of thermal engineers dedicated to engaging prospective customers and demonstrating our software's transformative value.

As trusted technical advisors , you and your team will use deep simulation expertise to help enterprise customers validate and optimize complex, real-world designs . Through these collaborative engagements, you will champion Vinci's value proposition by showing how our platform delivers systemic improvements in thermal performance, product reliability, and time-to-market.

Leveraging strong fundamentals in continuum mechanics , you will guide analyses of complex physical phenomena, including linear, geometric and material nonlinearities, and contact interactions. Your team will evaluate critical factors such as warpage, stress evolution, thermal cycling, and reliability across advanced semiconductor devices, electronics packages, and wafer-scale systems. 

You will work closely with customer engineering teams to understand their technical challenges, provide expert guidance, and clearly articulate Vinci’s capabilities in solving real-world problems. You will also serve as a key feedback channel t o product and engineering teams, translating customer insights into actionable inputs that shape product direction and drive continuous improvement.

Responsibilities 

- Build, lead, and scale a high-performing team of thermo-mechanical engineers , setting the technical direction, hiring, mentoring team members, and driving field execution across Europe.

- Collaborate closely with the sales team to lead technical discussions, scope proof-of-concept (PoC) evaluations, and deliver compelling product demonstrations to prospective enterprise customers.

- Guide customer engineering teams through the evaluation phase by overseeing simulation setup, running complex test cases, and interpreting results to explicitly prove Vinci’s technical and business value.

- Provide product guidance and feedback, identify customer pain points and workflow bottlenecks , partnering directly with internal product and engineering teams to transform field feedback into critical new product features.

- Represent Vinci at major industry conferences and semiconductor events , engaging technically with key prospects and partners through technical presentations and live platform demonstrations.

- Maintain a strong understanding of competitive technologies, industry trends, and market positioning to communicate Vinci’s differentiators effectively.

Qualifications (Minimum Qualifications) 

- Education: Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related technical field.

- Technical depth: Expert-level mastery of commercial FEA software (e.g., Ansys Mechanical, Abaqus, or equivalent), with 15+ years of hands-on experience in thermo-mechanical simulations— either as a practitioner running simulations or as a technical account manager for commercial physics simulation software.

- Industry Domain: Deep familiarity with semiconductor electronics packaging, advanced packaging technologies (e.g., 2.5D/3D IC), or foundry ecosystems.

- Customer Engagement: Prior experience in dedicated customer-facing roles, with a strong ability to build trust and manage engineering client relationships.

- Automation & Scripting: Practical programming experience using Python or C++ to automate workflows or parse simulation data.

- Leadership Impact: Proven track record of prior managerial or technical leadership experience, with the ability to scale, mentor, and drive execution across engineering teams.

- Communication: Elite interpersonal and communication skills, with a proven ability to distill complex physics and simulation results into clear, high-impact narratives for both deep technical panels and business-oriented executives.

Preferred (Desirable Differentiators) 

- Multiphysics Breadth: Familiarity with thermal management and cooling solutions and/or Electrical Signal Integrity and Power Integrity (SI/PI) workflows.

- Commercial Track Record: Direct experience commercializing technical software—ideally electronic design automation (EDA) or CAE simulation tools—into major semiconductor and electronics enterprises.

- Go-To-Market Experience: Prior experience explicitly within technical pre-sales, application engineering (FAE), or strategic technical sales environments.

- Emerging Tech Adjacency: Ability to rapidly adopt and champion next-generation, physics-based workflows and AI-assisted design or simulation tools.

Why Join Us 

- Not just use AI; be part of a team actively redefining how next-generation silicon and hardware are architected.

- Work at the absolute convergence of state-of-the-art AI models, fundamental physics, and high-stakes enterprise engineering.

- Collaborate with world-class engineers and researchers in a fast-moving startup environment.

Resident Advisor helps users explore the world of electronic music, from finding their next night out and buying tickets to discovering the artists, clubs and scenes behind it.

The mandate

We're looking for a senior product designer to join our design team and set the design direction for our consumer products: ra.co and the RA Guide app, used by millions of ticket buyers, readers and electronic music fans annually. The role also encompasses RA PRO, our B2B offering for promoters listing events and tickets on RA.

You'll work closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Data, Commercial and Growth teams to design experiences that help users stay engaged with the electronic music community via RA while contributing to the future development of the platform.

This is a senior role for a designer who combines strong product thinking and exceptional craft with hands-on experience of AI-assisted design. You'll lead projects from discovery through delivery, set the standard for design quality across the team, and own the evolution of the RA Design System so it works as well for AI tools and agents as it does for designers and engineers.

Responsibilities

Product design and leadership

- Lead design for Resident Advisor's consumer products end to end, across web and native app touchpoints.
- Set design direction and quality standards, and partner with Product, Engineering and Data leads to shape strategy, roadmaps and prioritisation.
- Mentor and coach other designers through critique, pairing and feedback, raising the bar for craft across the team.
- Lead discovery activities including user research, workshops and analysis of customer feedback and data.
- Work closely with engineers throughout implementation to ensure quality execution and close the gap between design and code.

Design systems and AI

- Own the RA Design System: maintain, evolve and govern tokens, components and patterns so they stay consistent across Figma and code.
- Structure and document the design system so developers and AI can use it reliably and efficiently.
- Bring AI into the design workflow, using it for research synthesis, ideation, prototyping and production, and helping the wider team adopt it thoughtfully.
- Document design decisions, patterns and best practices in a way both people and AI tools can use.

Who we are looking for

- A portfolio demonstrating strong product design thinking, visual craft and impact on products shipped at scale.
- 4+ years of Product Design experience, including time in a senior or lead role setting design direction for a product area.
- Experience mentoring designers and influencing product and engineering stakeholders.
- Hands-on experience using AI in your design practice, from ideation and prototyping to working with AI coding tools, and a considered point of view on where it helps and where it doesn't.
- Deep experience building and maintaining design systems, including design tokens, component libraries and documentation, and keeping Figma and code in sync.
- An understanding of what makes a design system usable by AI: structured tokens, consistent naming, well-defined component properties and clear usage guidance.
- Expert UI and interaction design skills with a keen eye for detail.
- A strong grasp of user-centred design and balancing user and business needs.
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills, and experience working in Agile product teams.
- Experience designing AI-powered or personalised product experiences is a plus.

title: Chief Content Officer - Berlin
description:
About RA

Resident Advisor has been a home for electronic music culture since 2001. Event discovery, ticketing, news and long-form editorial, artist profiles, original films, and a weekly mix series two decades deep. Around 7 million people use the web platform every month, with a wider audience across our apps and other channels. Underneath the platform sits a network of contributors and city managers across dozens of cities, which is how we stay connected to the scenes we cover rather than reporting on them from a distance. RA is 25 years old, independent, B Corp certified and intent on being indispensable to the artists, promoters and audiences who make this culture.

The mandate

RA is looking for a Chief Content Officer to lead our media team and shape how we tell the story of electronic music and club culture. The role covers every place our voice shows up: editorial, films, audio formats and social output. You'll bring these together as one multimedia strategy, not separate channels.

Content is central to how people discover music and events on RA. You'll make sure it serves the business as well as the culture: driving discovery, supporting promoters and our network, and building RA's long-term relevance.

You'll set the creative vision and empower the team to deliver it with autonomy. You'll bring strong editorial judgement and a clear sense of what RA stands for, thinking quarters and years ahead without losing sight of what goes out this week. You'll own how the team works: formats, frequency, planning and process. A Managing Editor runs this day to day, and section leads report to you. Your job is to set the direction, standards and rhythm, including how AI changes the way the team works.

- Set RA's editorial strategy across all media formats, grounded in RA's scope of coverage and tied to company goals.
- Build a unified multimedia approach, planning stories across formats and choosing the right outlet, frequency and context for each.
