- Stay close to the scenes, first-hand and through RA's network around the world, and turn what you see and hear into what RA covers next.
- Make the final call on sensitive or high-profile content, resolve competing priorities and keep work moving.
- Work closely with Growth, Product and the network so content drives discovery across RA's platforms and supports the wider business.

- Bring RA's creative vision to events and live programming, working with the events team on curation.

- Lead and grow a multidisciplinary team of editors, writers, producers, video and audio makers, and social specialists.
- Work with and develop strong section leads, giving them clear ownership and authority over their areas and offering constructive feedback.

- Own the team's operating rhythm with the Managing Editor, so planning, commissioning, production and publishing hold up at pace, seven days a week.
- Manage budget, resources and schedules.
- Set objectives and reporting that make performance clear to the team and leadership.

- Lead how AI is used across the team, in research, fact-checking, production and distribution, wherever it improves quality or speed.
- Set clear rules for its responsible use, in line with our editorial standards.

- Know how audiences find and engage with modern media: long- and short-form video, podcasts, social media and RA's own platforms. Grow reach, engagement and loyalty across all of them.

You will be responsible for the day-to-day management of key products in the PRINCE2 portfolio – including certifications, official publications and learning materials – making sure they remain high quality, relevant and well supported in market.

As Product Manager PRINCE2 your tasks will be the following:

Product strategy and vision

- Contribute to the product vision and strategy, and develop and maintain the roadmap for your product set.
- Conduct market research and analysis to identify trends, customer needs, and competitive landscape that will inform the product strategy.
- Track agreed product goals and KPIs, and recommend actions to improve performance.
Product management

- Monitor and analyze product performance, making data-driven recommendations to optimize and enhance your products.
- Prioritise maintenance and improvement activities for your in-market products, to ensure continued relevance and positive customer experience.
New product development

- Work proactively and collaboratively with teams across the business to ensure all aspects of product development, launch and in-market support are considered early in the business case and product design phase
- Support the successful development and launch of new or updated products
- Participate in all aspects of Product design, including: persona development; full end-to-end user journeys; service blueprints; key content and technical specifications
- Design and manage the testing strategy for all products in development, to ensure they are consistently meeting the needs of our target audiences
Stakeholder collaboration

- Contribute key elements to the go-to-market plans developed by Marketing, including positioning, key messaging and more.
- Contribute to pricing proposals for your product set by providing market, competitor and partner insight, and supporting the relevant internal teams in pricing decisions.
- Engage with internal and external stakeholders to secure buy-in and understanding of the product vision.
What we look for:

- Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, or related field.
- Minimum of 3 years’ experience in a Product Manager or Product Owner role in one of the following sectors: education, training, professional qualifications (e.g. ACA / CIPD etc.)
- Knowledge of PeopleCert best practices and ideally familiar with PRINCE2 or other similar PPM (project, programme and portfolio) certification products.
- Proven track record of managing multiple products and delivering successful outcomes.
- Demonstrable experience of managing products through their whole lifecycle
- Familiarity with all elements of product development, from discovery to delivery
- Proven ability to evaluate product feedback objectively, and propose solutions to address business needs
- Strong business/commercial acumen
- Excellent people and management skills to interact with colleagues, cross-functional teams, and third parties around the world
- Problem-solving and analytical capabilities.
- Prior exposure in Education, Consulting, Examination/Certification, or Technology sectors will be considered an asset.
- Excellent command of the English language (C2 level certification desired; LanguageCert C2 LTE or C2 IESOL a plus).
- Advanced computer literacy required; ECDL Advanced certification desirable. Familiarity with Microsoft Dynamics CRM or equivalent software will be considered an added advantage.
What we offer:

- The opportunity to shape globally recognized frameworks used by professionals around the world.
- A collaborative, high-impact international team and a purpose-driven working culture.
- Flexible working conditions (location and hours).
- Two free vouchers for all certifications from PeopleCert's Portfolio per year for all employees
- Competitive compensation and personal development opportunities.
- A global network of professionals and subject matter experts.
If you want to become a member of our international, dynamic and agile team that creates world leading software products, then we should certainly like to hear from you! 

About PeopleCert

PeopleCert is a global leader in assessment and certification of professional skills, partnering with multi-national organizations and government bodies for the development & delivery of standardized exams. Delivering exams across 200 countries and in 25 languages over its state-of-the-art assessment technology, PeopleCert enables professionals to boost their careers and realize their life ambitions.

Quality, Innovation, Passion, Integrity, Clarity, and Velocity are the core values which guide everything we do. 

Our offices in UK, Greece, and Cyprus boast a culture of diversity, where everyone is different, yet everyone fits in. All of us at PeopleCert are committed to the reflection of the diversity and inclusion of our customers and the communities in which we do business.

Working on Home Office (HO) Secure English Language Tests (SELTs) 

Any person who is engaged by PeopleCert to work on the SELT service must undergo a Background Check (the results of which must be acceptable to PeopleCert and the HO) prior to commencing their SELT duties. All SELT personnel will be required to complete a declaration (provided by PeopleCert) where the existence of any criminal record and/or bankruptcy must be declared.

If working on the SELT service in the UK, background checks will include:

- A basic or enhanced Disclosure Barring Service (DBS) check
- Right to Work in the UK check (including nationality, identity and place of residence)
- HO security check (Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) or Counter Terrorist Check (CTC)
- Financial background check
- Employment reference check.
- If working on the SELT service anywhere in the world (outside of the UK) personnel will undergo background checks that are equivalent to those stated for the UK.
In addition, if personnel are required to speak to SELT candidates they must be appropriately skilled in English language and, where SELT services are provided anywhere in the world (outside of the UK), the official language of the relevant country.

All applications will be treated with strict confidentiality.

Sprachen. Du beherrschst Deutsch und Englisch fließend in Wort und Schrift (jeweils C1).

Homaris ist konsequent langfristig ausgerichtet. Wir investieren nicht in kurzfristiges Wachstum mit dem Ziel, schnell zu verkaufen. Wir bauen etwas Nachhaltiges und Substanzielles auf – und suchen Menschen, die diesen Weg gemeinsam mit uns gehen und langfristig Verantwortung übernehmen wollen.

title: Senior Manager, Paid Social
description:
ABOUT QUINCE 

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE 

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

- We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.

- Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. 

- Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. 

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE 

Senior Manager, Paid Social 

We are seeking a Senior Manager, Paid Social to join our growing team. 

Paid social is one of the main ways Quince finds new customers, and this role sits at the centre of it. As Senior Manager, Growth Marketing (Paid Social), you will own strategy, execution and optimisation across Meta and other social platforms for a set of Quince departments, turning business goals into efficient media investment and steady, scalable growth.

This is a hands-on, analytical role. You will manage significant media budgets against clear efficiency targets (ROAS, CAC and NC MTA ROAS), work out what is really driving performance, and work closely with creative, merchandising and analytics colleagues so that targeting and creative keep getting better. The role is critical to scaling our paid social acquisition engine.

Responsibilities 

Paid social strategy and investment (the main focus of the role)

- Own paid social strategy and delivery for selected Quince departments across Meta, TikTok and emerging social channels.

- Manage and optimise significant paid media budgets to meet customer acquisition and efficiency targets.

- Monitor performance across campaigns, audiences and creative, and act quickly on what you find.

- Run a continuous programme of testing across audience segmentation, creative formats, messaging, bidding and budget allocation.

- Scale the campaigns that work, and deal with underperformance promptly.

- Adjust spend quickly in response to performance signals and changing product priorities.

Performance analysis and optimisation 

- Analyse campaign results across different attribution frameworks.

- Identify what drives incremental customer acquisition and revenue growth, and turn those findings into practical campaign and creative decisions.

- Build and maintain dashboards, reporting frameworks and performance analyses.

- Work with our analytics team to improve the accuracy of measurement and attribution.

Creative and testing collaboration 

- Work closely with the Creative, Studio and Production teams to shape creative that performs.

- Develop ways of working that make sure creative suits each platform.

- Keep testing volume high enough to support growth targets, with a steady supply of new creative.

Cross-functional collaboration 

- Work with Merchandising and Product to agree priority categories and launches.

- Partner with Analytics and Data on attribution and measurement.

- Present performance insights and growth opportunities to leadership.

Growth experimentation and channel development 

- Find opportunities to expand into new paid social surfaces and formats.

- Test new growth approaches, including audience expansion, creator-led ads and performance creative formats.

- Keep improving our testing frameworks so we can run more experiments and learn more from each one.

What success looks like

In this role, you will:

- manage and optimise significant paid social spend for your departments against clear targets for ROAS, CAC and NC MTA ROAS;

- drive scalable customer acquisition through testing, experimentation and analysis;

- find new audience, creative and bidding opportunities that unlock incremental growth;

- build a high-performing creative pipeline in partnership with the creative teams;

- use data and attribution models to guide budget allocation and channel strategy; and

- respond quickly, and sensibly, to what the numbers are telling you.

Qualifications Required: 

- 
six or more years of experience in performance marketing or paid social growth;

- 
deep experience managing Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram) at scale, with real ROAS and CPA pressure;

- 
experience managing TikTok, Pinterest, YouTube and other paid social channels;

- 
strong analytical skills, with experience of attribution models and performance data;

- 
a proven record of managing and optimising large paid media budgets;

- 
experience of running performance creative tests and working closely with creative teams;

- 
a data-led mindset, together with strong operational discipline; and comfort working in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.

WHY QUINCE? 

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY 

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. 

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form . We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds 

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE 

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

- We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.

- Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. 

- Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. 

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE 

The Senior Manager, CRM Lifecycle + Journeys owns every triggered flow in the customer journey across email, SMS, push, and in-app for UK, Germany, and France. You will build the automation engine that runs Quince's retention programme: from the welcome series a UK customer sees the day we launch, to the win-back flow that recovers a French customer six months later.

This is a builder role. You will spend most of your first six months in Iterable and the CDP. You will write the flow logic, set up the data pipes, design the experiments, and ship the AI agents that take work out of building, testing, and reporting on flows. The Director, CRM owns the retention strategy and the campaign calendar. You own the triggered flow programme that runs alongside it.

Two constraints shape this job. UK and EU privacy rules mean the US lifecycle playbook does not transfer unchanged: you will rebuild the identity-resolution layer and shift weight toward logged-in and app behaviour. Channel economics also differ across markets, with SMS in particular materially more expensive in Europe than in the US, so the sequencing of email, SMS, push, and in-app per flow per market is not the same as the US default.

You will be joining a team that values speed, candor, and rigour. This role is for you if you like building things, you can hold a roadmap in one hand and a SQL query in the other, and you have an opinion on how AI changes lifecycle work over the next 18 months.

Responsibilities 

- Build, launch, and own every triggered lifecycle flow for UK (July 2026), DE (October 2026), and FR (November 2026): welcome, browse abandon, cart abandon, post-purchase, low stock, back in stock, win-back, replenishment, care instructions.

- Partner with MarTech to Ship AI agents and tooling that take work out of flow build, copy, segmentation, and QA. Target at least one end-to-end CRM agent in production by EoY1 and a 50% reduction in flow concept-to-deployment time within 90 days.

- Partner with the Data team to run the triggered-flow testing roadmap with statistically sound design. Minimum 6 A/B tests per quarter per flow per market.

- Build channel-cost decision logic across email, SMS, push, and in-app per flow per market.

- Recover signal lost from fingerprinting and consent restrictions in UK/EU by pushing app and logged-in routing for non-consenting users.

- Stand up and run the localisation pipeline with freelance copywriters for EN-UK, DE, and FR. Localised flow content live before each market launch.

- Partner with tech team to maintain CDP quality across UK/EU: data model, integrations (Iterable, Attentive, app SDK, site events), data hygiene, latency, and identity-resolution accuracy.

Qualifications 

Required: 

- 6+ years lifecycle/CRM marketing in DTC or ecommerce, including at least 3 years owning automated/triggered flows end to end (not campaign/blast).

- Hands-on with Iterable (preferred), or comparable ESP (Braze, Klaviyo, SFMC). Must have built flows in the tool, not just briefed them.

- Hands-on with a CDP: Segment, mParticle, Hightouch, Census, or similar. Must understand identity resolution and data hygiene.

- Has built or deployed AI agents or LLM workflows in a marketing context (copy, segmentation, flow logic, QA). If you have not shipped one yet, you can describe the one you would ship in your first 90 days here.

- SQL proficient. Can self-serve in Looker, Lookr, or BigQuery without waiting for an analyst.

- A/B testing rigour. Knows what statistical significance means and where it breaks in lifecycle (sample size, primary metric selection, novelty effects).

- Working knowledge of UK/EU privacy law (GDPR, PECR) and consent management. Understands what changes operationally when fingerprinting is restricted.

- Detail-oriented. Triggered flows live or die on edge cases (locale, currency, time zone, opt-in state, suppression rules).

- Strong cross-functional operator. Will work daily with creative, brand, data science, tech, and US CRM counterparts.

Preferred: 

- Multi-market lifecycle experience (UK + DE or FR), fashion or home goods background, app-native lifecycle experience, fluency in DE or FR. 

WHY QUINCE? 

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY 

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. 

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form . We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds 

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

title: Senior Software Engineer m/w/d
description:
Als Arbeitgeber sind wir  PRO YOU – weil bei uns der  Mensch im Mittelpunkt steht . Wir übernehmen Verantwortung füreinander, schaffen kontinuierliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und bieten ein Umfeld, das berufliches und persönliches Wachstum fördert - mit flexiblen Arbeitszeitmodellen.

Enit wurde 2014 als innovatives Spin-off aus dem renommierten Fraunhofer-Institut für Solare Energiesysteme (ISE) in Freiburg gegründet. Teil von etwas Großem: Der Geschäftsbereich Digital Shopfloor 

Im Zuge unserer strategischen Weiterentwicklung haben wir uns mit der Böhme & Weihs GmbH zusammengeschlossen und agieren heute als starke, eigenständige Produktmarke unter deren Dach. Als Teil der Proalpha Group – einem der führenden Anbieter von ERP- und Business Applications für die mittelständische Fertigungsindustrie – bilden wir das Herzstück des Geschäftsbereichs Digital Shopfloor .

Durch diese starke Allianz brechen wir Datensilos auf: Wir verbinden die Welten von Qualitätsmanagement (CAQ), Produktionssteuerung (MES) und unserem Energiemanagement (EMS) zu einer lückenlosen Einheit. Für unsere Kunden bedeutet das: Qualitäts-, Maschinen-, Prozess- und Energiedaten in Echtzeit aus einer Hand – direkt verzahnt mit der ERP-Ebene.

Du arbeitest in Vollzeit an unserem Standort in Freiburg . 

Deine Aufgaben – contra boring, PRO YOU   

In Freiburg entwickelst Du vor Ort mit Deinem Team eine vollständig serverlose AWS-Lösung für das Energie- und CO₂-Management. Im engen Austausch bringst Du eigene Ideen ein und gestaltest die technische Weiterentwicklung mit. 

- Entwicklung: Du übernimmst die Fullstack -Entwicklung von der Cloud über das Backend bis zum Frontend – von der Konzeption bis zur Umsetzung. 

- Datenverarbeitung: Vom Stromzähler bis zur Cloud-Datenbank stellst Du eine stabile Datenübertragung und -verarbeitung sicher und entwickelst die Datenflüsse weiter. 

- Betrieb: Gemeinsam mit Deinem Team verantwortest Du DevOps, entwickelst die AWS-Infrastruktur und Services weiter und sicherst Deployments sowie den laufenden Betrieb. 

- Architektur: Du gestaltest Architekturentscheidungen mit und richtest die Cloud-Lösungen auf Skalierbarkeit, Zuverlässigkeit und Wartbarkeit aus. 

- Qualität: Mit Clean Code und automatisierten Tests sicherst Du die Qualität Deiner Software und schaffst eine verlässliche Grundlage für weitere Entwicklungen. 

Dein Profil – contra 08/15, PRO YOU   

- Ausbildung:  Abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, eine vergleichbare Ausbildung oder relevante Praxiserfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung 

- Berufserfahrung:   Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Full-Stack-E ntwicklung sowie in Software- und Microservice-Architekturen 

- Fachkenntnisse:  Mehrjährige Cloud-Erfahrung mit AWS,   Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Python o der TypeScript /React , Serverless -Architekturen, Infrastructure as Code, Domain Driven Design, Test Driven Development, Clean Code und skalierbaren Architekturen 

- Persönlichkeit: Verantwortungsbereite, eigeninitiativ arbeitende Persönlichkeit mit Teamfähigkeit, Kommunikationsstärke und Freude am Pair Programming 

- Sprachkenntnisse:  Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse für die Kommunikation in einem internationalen Umfeld 

Deine Benefits – contra basic, PRO YOU   

- PRO Flexibilität:  Flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle, Homeoffice, Workation, Wertguthabenkonto (z.B. für ein Sabbatical) 

- PRO Entwicklung:  Förderung persönlicher und beruflicher Weiterentwicklung, internationale Karrieremöglichkeiten, gruppenübergreifende Karrierechancen, vielfältiges Schulungsangebot, Entwicklungsgespräche  

- PRO Werte:  Offene Kommunikation, Du-Kultur, Teamgeist, Respekt, Wertschätzung, gemeinsame Team- und Firmenevents 

- PRO Extras:  Onboardingkonzept, Employee Assistance Service, Wellhub, JobRad, Mitarbeiterangebote , betriebliche Altersvorsorge 

PRO YOU – Deine Stärken, Deine Karriere 

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung und darauf, Dich kennenzulernen! 

Für Deine Bewerbung benötigen wir nur Deinen Lebenslauf , Zeugnisse sind optional. Du kannst Deine Unterlagen gesammelt in einer Datei über unser Online-Portal unter „Lebenslauf“ hochladen. 

Nach Eingang Deiner Bewerbung erhältst Du eine Bestätigung, und wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei Dir zurück. Der nächste Schritt kann ein Vorabgespräch mit uns oder direkt ein erstes Kennenlernen mit dem Fachbereich sein. 99% der Erstgespräche finden online statt.  

Fragen? Melde Dich – wir helfen gern!

title: (Senior) Consultant* – Securities & Custody Operations
description:
Standort: Frankfurt / München (Hybrid) | Practice Area: Capital Markets | Anstellungsart: Unbefristet 

Gestalte die Zukunft von Securities & Custody Operations im Finanzdienstleistungssektor. 

Die Rolle 

Als (Senior) Consultant* in unserer Capital Markets Practice arbeitest Du mit führenden Finanzinstituten zusammen, um deren Securities-, Custody- und Capital-Markets-Operations zu transformieren und zu optimieren.

Du bringst fundierte Fachkenntnisse entlang des Wertpapier-Lebenszyklus und im Post-Trade-Umfeld mit. Gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden analysierst Du komplexe operative Herausforderungen, identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale und übersetzt Anforderungen in praxisorientierte Lösungen. Du begleitest Transformationsprogramme von der Analyse und Konzeption bis hin zur Implementierung und arbeitest dabei eng mit Stakeholdern aus Operations, Technologie und Change zusammen.

Was Du bei uns machst 

- Du unterstützt Transformationsinitiativen in den Bereichen Securities, Custody und Post-Trade Operations – von der Anforderungsanalyse bis zur Implementierung.

- Du analysierst bestehende Operating Models, Prozesse und Kontrollen und identifizierst Möglichkeiten zur Vereinfachung, Optimierung und Effizienzsteigerung.

- Du arbeitest mit Stakeholdern aus Business, Operations und Technologie zusammen, definierst Anforderungen und übersetzt diese in praxisorientierte Lösungen.

- Du setzt Dein Wissen über Wertpapierprozesse ein – einschließlich Trade Lifecycle, Settlement, Asset Servicing und Custody Operations – um komplexe Herausforderungen unserer Kunden zu lösen.

- Du unterstützt die Projektdurchführung durch Workshops, Analysen, Dokumentation, Stakeholder Management und Implementierungsbegleitung.

Was wir von Dir erwarten 

- Relevante Beratungs- oder Finanzdienstleistungserfahrung in den Bereichen Securities, Custody, Post-Trade oder Capital Markets Operations.

- Fundierte Kenntnisse des Wertpapier-Lebenszyklus und operativer Prozesse wie Settlement, Custody, Asset Servicing und/oder Corporate Actions.

- Erfahrung in Business Transformation, Prozessoptimierung, Operating Models oder Change-Initiativen innerhalb der Finanzdienstleistungsbranche.

- Ausgeprägte analytische und problemlösungsorientierte Fähigkeiten sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe Anforderungen in klare und praxisorientierte Lösungen zu übersetzen.

- Sichere Kommunikations- und Stakeholder-Management-Fähigkeiten sowie Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Business- und Technologie-Teams.

- Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

Von Vorteil 

- Erfahrung bei oder mit Global Custodians, Investmentbanken, Asset Managern, Marktinfrastrukturen oder Securities-Services-Anbietern.

- Kenntnisse regulatorischer und branchenspezifischer Entwicklungen im Securities- und Post-Trade-Umfeld.

- Erfahrung mit Operating Model Design, Prozessoptimierung oder umfangreichen Transformationsprogrammen.

- Kenntnisse von Wertpapierplattformen, Custody-Systemen oder Post-Trade-Technologien.

- Beratungserfahrung bei der Umsetzung von Veränderungen in komplexen Finanzdienstleistungsorganisationen.

Warum Capco? 

- Arbeite an wirkungsvollen Lösungen für führende Finanzinstitute.

- Erlebe eine kollaborative, flache und unternehmerisch geprägte Beratungskultur.

- Nutze kontinuierliche Lernangebote, Trainings und Branchenzertifizierungen.

- Werde Teil eines Teams, das die Zukunft der Finanzdienstleistungsbranche mitgestaltet.

- Gestalte die Transformation im Capital-Markets-Umfeld aktiv mit.

Wir bieten Dir ein wettbewerbsfähiges Benefits-Paket, das Deine persönliche und berufliche Entwicklung unterstützt:

Benefits 

- Flexible Arbeitsmodelle und hybrides Arbeiten je nach Projekteinsatz möglich

- Ein umfassendes Onboarding und Dein persönlicher Coach und Buddy

- Bike Leasing Programme

- Capco Benefits Card mit monatlicher Gutschrift i.H.v. 44 EUR

- Regelmäßige Gesundheitschecks sowie Mental Health Kurse

- Der PME-Familienservice bietet Unterstützung für alle Lebenslagen

- Kontinuierliches Feedback und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten (z.B. über interne Trainings und Udemy Business)

- Großartige Firmenevents & After Work Veranstaltungen

- Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag

- Autonomie, flache Hierarchien, Hands-on-Mentalität und schnelle Entscheidungswege

- Ein dynamisches, wachstumsstarkes und internationales Umfeld mit zahlreichen Möglichkeiten Dich und Deine Talente einzubringen

Inklusion bei Capco 

Wir setzen uns dafür ein, unseren Recruiting-Prozess für alle zugänglich und unkompliziert zu gestalten. Wenn Du in irgendeiner Phase Unterstützung oder Anpassungen benötigst, lass es uns einfach wissen – wir helfen Dir gerne weiter.

Wir schätzen die individuellen Perspektiven und Beiträge jedes Einzelnen. Bei Capco glauben wir, dass Du am stärksten bist, wenn Du Du selbst sein kannst. Unsere #BeYourselfAtWork-Kultur fördert Individualität und Zusammenarbeit – eine Haltung, die jeden Tag prägt, wie wir mit unseren Kunden und miteinander arbeiten.

title: Mid/Senior AI Cinematic Video Editor (Freelance - Full Remote - Germany)
description:
Our Vision & Products

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship 

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World 

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next 

At EverAI , we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting , we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform , redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first .

And we’re only just getting started! 

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership 

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO) 

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23 

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM 

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands) 

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth 

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) 

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A 

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone) 

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited) 

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited) 

Your Role

We are looking for a Mid/Senior AI Cinematic Video Editor who is deeply embedded in generative video workflows and can independently craft high-quality, narrative-driven content from concept to final output. 

You are a sharp-eyed video editor comfortable operating at the intersection of creativity and emerging technology, building visually compelling long-form videos using AI-first pipelines. You take ownership of the entire production stack — from prompting and generation to editing, compositing, graphic design work and final delivery. You thrive in a high-performance environment where your quick wits and passion for story-telling shine.

Reporting to your Content Lead, this is what you'll be doing:

Key Responsibilities

- Conceptualise scripts based on current production needs and centred around existing AI characters (our own IPs)

- Create narrative-driven, longform video content , including stylized and explicit NSFW visuals, with a strong focus on storytelling, atmosphere, and visual coherence throughout

- Own and manage end-to-end AI video production workflows , from ideation and prompting to generation, editing, and post-production

- Utilise tools such as Kling, Seedance, Happy Horse and other AI video models/platforms to produce high-quality visual sequences

- Develop and maintain consistent character appearance, style, and scene continuity across longer narratives using advanced techniques

- Integrate motion graphic design and colour correction to deliver cohesive final outputs

- Experiment rapidly with new AI models, tools, and techniques , incorporating them into production workflows and sharing skills with the rest of the team

- Align with your Content Lead’s creative direction while maintaining a high degree of autonomy in execution and technical decision-making 

- Continuously refine workflows for efficiency, scalability, and output quality 

Your Qualifications

Hard Skills

- 4–6+ years of experience in video production, VFX, or digital art , with a strong portfolio (AI-driven video work is a must)

- Hands-on experience with the latest AI video tools and models (e.g., Kling, Seedance, Happy Horse, and similar emerging options)

- Solid understanding of AI image/video generation pipelines , including prompting, batching, consistency techniques, and post-processing

- Experience with traditional tools like Premiere Pro, After Effects or similar for final assembly and polish

- Strong grasp of visual storytelling, pacing, composition, and cinematic language 

- Ability to maintain character and scene consistency across sequences in AI-generated content

Soft Skills

🗣 Strong communication & collaboration skills (fluent in English)

🎯 High ownership — able to take ideas from concept to completion independently

⚡️ Experimental mindset — comfortable navigating ambiguity and evolving tools

⏱️ Fast iteration cycles — able to test, fail, refine, and improve quickly

🧠 Curious and self-driven — constantly exploring new AI capabilities and workflows

🧢 Open to feedback and continuous improvement

🍭 #NSFW — Comfortable working with uncensored models and explicit adult content

Bonus Points

- Experience in AI-native storytelling or filmmaking

Ziel ist es, eine effiziente, sichere und regelkonforme Bereitstellung sämtlicher IT-Dienstleistungen sicherzustellen.

In dieser Position übernehmen Sie die zentrale Verantwortung für die lokale IT-Organisation und arbeiten eng mit den globalen IT-Teams und relevanten Stakeholdern zusammen, um technologische Initiativen voranzutreiben, die Qualität der IT-Services kontinuierlich zu verbessern und das Unternehmenswachstum zu unterstützen.

Ihre Aufgaben

1. Strategische Planung und Umsetzung

- Entwicklung und Umsetzung von IT-Strategien, Initiativen und Maßnahmenplänen im Einklang mit den Unternehmenszielen.

- Sicherstellung der erfolgreichen Umsetzung, Überwachung und kontinuierlichen Optimierung genehmigter IT-Maßnahmen.

- Mitgestaltung der lokalen IT-Roadmap in Abstimmung mit der globalen IT-Strategie und IT-Architektur.

2. IT-Führung und Personalmanagement

- Gestaltung und Weiterentwicklung einer effizienten und skalierbaren IT-Organisationsstruktur.

- Fachliche und disziplinarische Führung, Motivation und Weiterentwicklung des lokalen IT-Teams.

- Unterstützung bei Recruiting, Onboarding, Leistungsbeurteilungen, Nachfolgeplanung und Personalentwicklungsmaßnahmen.

- Förderung einer Unternehmenskultur, die durch Eigenverantwortung, Zusammenarbeit und kontinuierliche Verbesserung geprägt ist.

3. Budgetplanung und Finanzmanagement

- Erstellung und Steuerung des jährlichen IT-Budgets.

- Sicherstellung eines wirtschaftlichen und effizienten Einsatzes von IT-Ressourcen und Investitionen.

- Überwachung der IT-Ausgaben, Kostenkontrolle und Sicherstellung finanzieller Transparenz.

- Identifikation und Umsetzung von Maßnahmen zur Effizienzsteigerung und Kostenoptimierung.

4. IT-Governance, Compliance und Prozessmanagement

- Sicherstellung der Einhaltung interner Unternehmensrichtlinien, Kontrollmechanismen und IT-Prozesse.

- Aufbau, Implementierung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung effektiver IT-Governance-Strukturen und operativer Prozesse.

- Gewährleistung der Einhaltung unternehmensweiter Standards, Sicherheitsanforderungen und regulatorischer Vorgaben.

5. IT-Sicherheit, Recht und Risikomanagement

- Proaktive Identifikation, Bewertung und Minimierung IT-bezogener Risiken.

- Sicherstellung angemessener Cybersicherheitsmaßnahmen, Datenschutzstandards und IT-Asset-Management-Prozesse.

- Unterstützung bei der Einhaltung geltender gesetzlicher, regulatorischer und unternehmensinterner Anforderungen.

- Berichterstattung über wesentliche IT-Risiken und entsprechende Gegenmaßnahmen an die Geschäftsleitung.

6. IT-Strategie, Architektur und Technologielösungen

- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den globalen IT-Teams bei der Definition von IT-Architekturen, Standards und technologischen Roadmaps.

- Bewertung, Empfehlung und Implementierung geeigneter IT-Lösungen zur Unterstützung der Geschäftsziele.

- Sicherstellung, dass lokale IT-Systeme und Dienstleistungen den globalen IT-Frameworks und technischen Vorgaben entsprechen.

7. IT-Projektmanagement, Beschaffung und Dienstleistersteuerung

- Leitung und Umsetzung lokaler IT-Projekte sowie Initiativen zur Weiterentwicklung bestehender Systeme.

- Unterstützung bei IT-Beschaffungsprozessen, Dienstleisterbewertungen und der Auswahl geeigneter Lieferanten in Zusammenarbeit mit der globalen IT-Organisation.

- Steuerung und Überwachung externer IT-Dienstleister hinsichtlich Leistung, Servicequalität und Erfüllung geschäftlicher Anforderungen.

8. IT-Betrieb und Service Management

- Gesamtverantwortung für den täglichen IT-Betrieb, die IT-Infrastruktur, Unternehmensanwendungen und den Endanwendersupport.

- Sicherstellung einer effektiven Systemüberwachung, Wartung, Kapazitätsplanung, Modernisierung und Leistungsoptimierung.

- Weiterentwicklung von Incident- und Problem-Management-Prozessen sowie kontinuierliche Verbesserung der IT-Servicequalität.

- Gewährleistung einer hohen Verfügbarkeit, Zuverlässigkeit und Nutzerzufriedenheit aller IT-Dienstleistungen.

9. Weitere Verantwortlichkeiten

- Übernahme zusätzlicher Aufgaben und strategischer Initiativen gemäß den Anforderungen der Geschäftsleitung.

Ihr Profil

Fachliche Qualifikationen und Berufserfahrung

- Abgeschlossenes Bachelorstudium in Informatik, Informationstechnologie, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einem vergleichbaren Fachgebiet.

- Mindestens 8–10 Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung im IT-Bereich mit zunehmender Verantwortung, einschließlich mehrjähriger Führungserfahrung.

- Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Leitung von IT-Betrieb, IT-Infrastruktur, Cybersicherheit und Unternehmensanwendungen in der Automobilindustrie bzw. im Automobilbau .

- Erfahrung in internationalen Unternehmen sowie in der Zusammenarbeit mit globalen IT-Organisationen.

- Fundierte Kenntnisse in IT-Governance, Risikomanagement, Compliance und Cybersicherheit.

Generalunternehmer schreiben ihre Projekte auf unserer Plattform an mehr als 250.000 Nachunternehmer aus, und unsere agentische KI findet die passenden Firmen, erkennt Auffälligkeiten in Angeboten und vergleicht jeden Preis mit 6,5 Millionen Datenpunkten aus über 136 Milliarden Euro verarbeitetem Angebotsvolumen. 2019 in Berlin gegründet und von Cherry Ventures und Spark Capital mit über 40 Millionen Euro finanziert, skalieren wir jetzt Sales, Customer Success und Marketing. Dafür bauen wir ein eigenes Consulting-Team auf, und genau hier kommst du ins Spiel.

Die Rolle 

Du übernimmst neue Kunden direkt nach der Unterschrift und bringst sie in den ersten 90 Tagen in die produktive Nutzung. Du leitest den Kick-off, klärst mit dem Kunden, wer ausschreibt und mit welchem Projekt es losgeht, schulst Einkauf, Kalkulation und Projektleitung und sorgst dafür, dass die ersten Ausschreibungen rausgehen und Angebote zurückkommen. Wenn ein Kunde hängt, merkst du es früh und drehst ihn, notfalls über die Geschäftsführung. Nach 90 Tagen übergibst du ihn mit klarem Stand an seinen Account Manager.

Du begleitest viele Kunden parallel, vom Familienbetrieb bis zum Generalunternehmer mit mehreren Niederlassungen. Als Senior Implementation Consultant übernimmst du die komplexen Einführungen: mehrere Standorte oder Gesellschaften, Freigabeprozesse, Systemlandschaften und viele Beteiligte. Und du entwickelst mit, wie unser Consulting-Team arbeitet.

Du berichtest an die Leiterin unseres Consulting-Teams.

Woran wir dich nach 12 Monaten messen 

- Deine Kunden sind nach 90 Tagen produktiv: Sie schreiben über Cosuno aus und erhalten Angebote, nachweisbar im Activation Report.

- Jeder Kick-off endet mit klaren Zusagen: ausschreibende Nutzer, erstes Projekt, Termine, Mandat der Geschäftsführung.

- Kunden, die hinter Plan liegen, haben schnell einen Plan, und die meisten holen auf.

- Deine Kunden bewerten ihr Onboarding gut, und dein Account Manager weiß bei der Übergabe genau, wo der Kunde steht.

- Als Senior: Deine komplexen Einführungen erreichen ihr Ziel, und das Team arbeitet mit Bausteinen, die du entwickelt hast.

Wer bei Cosuno erfolgreich ist 

- Ownership. Du sprichst über eigene Fehler, bevor jemand fragt, und darüber, was du daraus geändert hast.

- Speed. Du löst Probleme pragmatisch und heute, nicht perfekt und nächstes Quartal.

- Drive. Wenn ein Kunde hängt, rufst du an, statt auf die nächste Mail zu warten.

- Low Ego. Du teilst, was bei dir funktioniert hat, damit das Team besser wird.

Diese Rolle ist für dich, wenn 

- du gern erklärst und es dich reizt, gerade die Skeptiker zu überzeugen.

- du lieber vom Ziel rückwärts planst, als Schulungen abzuarbeiten.

- du bei vielen Kunden parallel den Überblick behältst und weißt, wer heute deine Zeit bekommt.

- du mit Kalkulatoren und Geschäftsführern gleichermaßen auf Augenhöhe sprichst.

- du verstehen willst, wie am Bau eingekauft und vergeben wird.

Diese Rolle ist nichts für dich, wenn 

- du Onboarding als eine Reihe von Produktdemos verstehst.

- du lieber in langen Projekten mit wenigen Kunden berätst als viele Kunden schnell zum Ergebnis zu bringen.

- du wartest, bis der Kunde sich meldet.

Harte Anforderungen 

- Mindestens ein Jahr eigene Verantwortung für die Einführung einer Software beim Kunden, etwa als Implementation Consultant, Onboarding Manager oder Customer Success Manager mit Onboarding-Schwerpunkt, idealerweise im B2B-SaaS.

- Erfahrung mit vielen parallelen Kunden und belegbare Ergebnisse, zum Beispiel Go-live- oder Aktivierungsquoten.

- Du hältst Schulungen und Workshops souverän, online und vor Ort.

- Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau. Gutes Englisch, Erfahrung mit Bau, Immobilien oder Vertical SaaS und sicherer Umgang mit KI-Werkzeugen sind ein Plus.

- Für Senior Implementation Consultant zusätzlich: Einführungen bei Kunden mit mehreren Standorten, Gesellschaften oder Systemen und viel Kontakt zur Geschäftsführung.

Was wir bieten 

- Aufbau: Du bist von Anfang an Teil eines neuen Teams und gestaltest mit, wie wir Kunden in die Nutzung bringen.

- Wirkung: Klare Ziele und direkter Einfluss darauf, ob ein Kunde bleibt.

- Entwicklung: Vom Implementation Consultant zum Senior über immer komplexere Kunden, mit regelmäßigen 1:1s und offener Feedbackkultur.

- Vertrag: Unbefristet, moderne Ausstattung.

- Arbeitsort: Remote innerhalb der EU möglich, Berlin-Kreuzberg bevorzugt.

- Team: Firmen- und Teamevents, online und offline.

So läuft dein Bewerbungsprozess 

- Kennenlernen mit unserem Head of Customer Success (45 Minuten)

- Gespräch mit der Leiterin unseres Consulting-Teams (30 Minuten)

- Case Study an einem realistischen Neukunden, dazu ein Gespräch mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus dem Team

- Referenzgespräch, danach unser Angebot

title: Sales Development Representative - German Speaking (Relocation to Barcelona)
description:
About Us 

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem .

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role 

We are looking for an ambitious, German-speaking Sales Development Representative (SDR) to help us accelerate our growth across the DACH market.

Reporting to the SDR Team Lead, you will play a critical role in generating a qualified sales pipeline by engaging with prospective clients. Joining a high-performing sales team, you’ll sell a disruptive corporate travel and spend platform, learn from experienced industry leaders, and build a foundation for rapid career progression within Perk.

What You'll Do 

- Multichannel Outreach: Execute targeted outreach campaigns using phone, email, and LinkedIn/social touches to engage target prospects.

- Lead Qualification: Conduct discovery calls with key decision-makers—such as CFOs, Travel Managers, and Office Managers—to assess fit and schedule qualified meetings for Account Executives.

- Value Articulation: Clearly communicate Perk’s value proposition and build immediate credibility with prospective clients.

- CRM Hygiene: Maintain accurate prospect data and activity tracking within Salesforce.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Marketing to refine target accounts, test new messaging, and optimize the lead-qualification process.

- Product Mastery: Stay expert-level on Perk’s product offerings and industry trends.

What We're Looking For 

- Languages: Native or near-native fluency in German with professional fluency in English.

- Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication, with strong phone-based rapport-building skills.

- Sales Acumen: Familiarity with B2B SaaS sales processes or outbound prospect outreach.

- Process & Execution: High organizational skills, comfort working with CRMs (Salesforce preferred), and a focus on hitting output metrics.

What Success Looks Like in This Role 

- Consistent Pipeline Generation: You hit and exceed your monthly targets for qualified meetings booked and opportunities created.

- High Outreach Discipline: You maintain steady, structured daily outreach activity (calls, emails, social touches) using Salesforce and modern sales tools.

- Value-Driven Discovery: You master Perk’s value proposition early, allowing you to ask smart discovery questions and handle client objections with confidence.

- Cross-Functional Alignment: You collaborate seamlessly with Account Executives to ensure smooth handover of leads and high show-up rates for meetings.

- Growth Mindset: You actively apply feedback from coaching sessions, continuously refining your messaging and cold-calling techniques.

Interview Process 

- Recruiter Screen: 30-minute virtual chat with Talent Acquisition.

- Role Assessment: 60-minute in-person interview & practical exercise.

- Values & Culture Fit: 30-minute virtual interview.

What We Offer 

- Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

- Rest and recharge with our generous allocation of vacation days plus public holidays

- Take control of your physical health with your choice of private healthcare or a gym allowance

- Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

- Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

- Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

- Make your money go further with our flexible compensation plan

- Focus on your family with 17 weeks’ paid parental leave during your child’s first year

- Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

- Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

- Nurture your language skills with in real-life English, Spanish, and Catalan lessons

- Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

- Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

Want to Learn More Before You Apply? 

Join our DACH team for The SDR Diaries: DACH Edition to hear directly from our current SDRs about life at Perk! We’ll cover day-to-day responsibilities, live objection handling, real experiences relocating to Barcelona, and tips for navigating our interview process.

🔗 Register for the event here: https://luma.com/kztwu46o 

How We Set You Up to Succeed (Work Schedule) 

- First 6 Months (Onboarding & Probation): 5 days a week in our Barcelona office. This gives you hands-on coaching, real-time feedback on live calls, and direct access to your manager while you master the role.

- Post-Probation Schedule: Standard hybrid model, 3 days in the office and 2 days working from home.

AI at Perk 
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work 

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams 

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @ perk.com or @ externalperk.com , our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com , and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

title: People Business Partner
description:
Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in-person collaboration that helps foster trust, innovation, and a strong team culture. 

About Superhuman 

Grammarly is now part of Superhuman, the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company’s products include Grammarly’s writing assistance, Superhuman Docs’s collaborative workspaces, Mail’s inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. Learn more at superhuman.com .

As a People Business Partner, you will work closely with our Europe Engineering, Product & Design, and G&A teams, partnering with leaders and managers to support org health, talent strategy, and people programs that move the business forward. - Collaborate with the broader People team (L&D, Compensation, Ops, Recruiting) to help run and deliver programs and projects that serve your client groups

- Partner with leaders, finance, and recruiting on headcount planning and team structure conversations, translating business needs into the right people investments

Qualifications 

- 3+ years of people partner or HR business partner experience, ideally with exposure to global or multi-region companies

- Experience supporting Engineering, Product, Design, and/or G&A orgs is preferred

- Demonstrated ability to build high-trust relationships with managers and leaders, and to show up as a credible, strategic partner

- Strong judgment in navigating employee situations with speed, structure, and genuine care

- Understanding of the cultural and employment landscape across key European markets

- Comfortable working across time zones and geographies — you understand what it takes to bridge a global company and bring people together

- Experience partnering with other People teams and business partners like Finance and Recruiting

- Ready to roll up your sleeves and figure out and build the right solutions with cross-functional partners, not just execute established processes

- Thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and can operate proactively with independence

- Has a demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal guidance, proactively manages tasks and priorities across multiple projects, analyzes and executes work efficiently, collaborates effectively with cross-functional teams, and thrives in fast-paced, results-driven environments.

Nice to Have: 

- Prior exposure to compensation review processes or pay equity analysis

- Experience in a compound startup, multi-product company, or post-acquisition environment

Support for you, professionally and personally 

- Professional growth: We believe that autonomy and trust are key to empowering our team members to do their best, most innovative work in a way that aligns with their interests, talents, and well-being. We also support professional development and advancement with training, coaching, and regular feedback.

- A connected team: Superhuman builds a product that helps people connect, and we apply this mindset to our own team. Our remote-first hybrid model enables a highly collaborative culture supported by our values. We work to foster belonging among team members in a variety of ways. This includes our employee resource groups, Superhuman Circles, which promote connection among those with shared identities including BIPOC and LGBTQIA+ team members, women, and parents. We also celebrate our colleagues and accomplishments with global, local, and team-specific programs.

- Comprehensive benefits for candidates based in Germany: Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing life care (including mental health care and risk benefits) and ample and defined time off. We also offer support to set up a home office, wellness and pet care stipends, learning and development opportunities, and more.

- Relocation Support: Superhuman provides comprehensive relocation support to make your move to Berlin seamless. Our package includes visa assistance, destination services to help you and your family settle in comfortably, and a relocation bonus to cover additional expenses, such as temporary housing.

We encourage you to apply 

At Superhuman, we value our differences, and we encourage all to apply. Superhuman is an equal-opportunity company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race or ethnic origin, religion or belief, gender, disability, sexual identity, or age.

title: AI Engineering Manager
description:
Every team has AI. Few have mastered it. Humans were built to adapt, but AI is now moving faster than most workforces can.

Multiverse is the AI adoption layer: the missing link between the AI tools that companies have invested in and the people expected to use them.

Our ambition is to put AI capability in every worker’s hands. Apprenticeships got us started: we’ve trained over a third of the UK’s data and AI apprentices, worked with a third of the FTSE 100, and generated £2bn+ in verified ROI. Now Mastry, our new adaptive learning platform, takes that further, guiding a company’s AI workforce transformation from start to finish. Mae, our AI guide inside Mastry, is a real-time AI agent that thinks, speaks, listens and sees, working alongside the tools you already use, like Claude and Copilot.

We closed our latest fundraising round in April 2026, with $500m+ raised in total from VC partners including Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Schroders Capital and Lightspeed. With a $2.1bn valuation, we are Europe’s first EdTech double unicorn, and we are just getting started.

If you want to shape how the workforce wins in the AI era, come and join us.

Why this role exists 

Every foundation model lab is solving the same problem: build more capability. Almost nobody is solving the harder one — what happens when that capability meets a real organisation and real people who have to relearn how they work. That's the adoption layer , still wide open, and Multiverse sits in the unique position to solve this problem with ten years of proprietary learner and employer data driven from 1,500+ companies that no one else has.

Diagnose & Prescribe ( D&P ) is the engine room of that problem. It works out what a learner or employer actually needs, then decides what they get funded for and which apprenticeship or learning path they're pointed to next. D&P is how we assess a learner's or employer's skill gaps, decide what they need, and point them to the right apprenticeship or learning path — so the blast radius here is human and financial, not just a dashboard metric.

The line between leading this team and building the product has already blurred, which is why this role exists as it does. We need a leader who stays close enough to the work to have credible judgment in it, and who builds a high-trust team where diverse perspectives actually make the problem-solving better.

This is a broad, domain-coherent, event-driven and increasingly AI-native estate. The dominant challenge isn't deep algorithmic difficulty in any single repo — it's holding the whole D&P picture, sequencing work across varied services, and keeping load-bearing decisions safe as the system evolves underneath you.

What you're signing up for 

- A genuinely unsolved problem — the constraint here is people and adoption, not model capability.

- High agency. We set outcomes, not playbooks. You and your team define how this evolves.

- Real commercial breadth. This team sits at the intersection of Product, go-to-market, and eligibility — closer to the customer than most engineering roles.

- Craft that's respected, not traded off. Strict typing, layered testing, ADRs, observability — and AI-native ways of working as the baseline, not an experiment.

- A company mid-transformation, told straight. Multiverse is rebuilding itself into a product-powered, AI-native company in real time. You're not inheriting a finished system — you're one of the people defining it.

What you'll do 

You will own delivery, technical direction, and team health in the D&P service estate — the full learner and customer journey from diagnosis through prescription to onboarding and growth tracking. Concretely, that means leading the team(s) across surfaces like:

- Diagnosis & needs assessment — AI-heavy services (retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), LLM-scored assessment) that turn raw signal into a picture of where a learner or employer actually is.

- Prescription & eligibility — build the product which helps learners and customers understand the best learning course for their skills and career development, that leverages a customer's levy funds. Much of this is load-bearing logic with a genuine financial and regulatory blast radius.

- Recommendation & onboarding — turning a diagnosis into the right prescribed path and getting learners into it, where those decisions become visible to customers and learners.

- The platform arc — continuing to carve D&P logic out of the shared legacy monolith into dedicated services, while backing the newer AI-native product from beta toward scale.

- Coach and build the team. Hire well, give every report a real growth plan, and move the team into a high-performing, AI-native operating rhythm — promotions and performance issues are never a surprise.

- Stay hands-on. Whiteboard distributed designs, review and negotiate the RabbitMQ event schemas and API contracts that ripple across services, and write production code yourself when it's the fastest way to de-risk or unblock.

- Deliver predictably. Use cycle time, change failure rate, and MTTR to balance shipping speed, debt, and change-safety on logic with genuine financial and regulatory blast radius.

- Raise the AI-native bar. Prove better discovery-to-build-to-review loops on your own team and share what works across engineering.

- Partner on strategy. Work directly with Product and Design — and closely with go-to-market — to turn learner and customer behaviour into technical direction on the surfaces where eligibility and recommendation decisions become visible to real customers.

What we need 

A few terms you'll see below: D&P (Diagnose & Prescribe, this team's name), BAM (our hiring framework — Behaviour, Achievement, Mastery), ADRs (architecture decision records), IfATE (the UK body governing apprenticeship standards).

- Engineering management of full-stack teams shipping production software, with real technical depth to review architecture and challenge design.

- A team you led has shipped AI features to real users and operated them — not a side experiment.

- Strong Python/TypeScript (if you don’t have Typescript, you will need to learn): React/Next.js (App Router, RSC, server actions), tRPC/GraphQL, Node/Express.

- PostgreSQL at scale via an ORM, with migration discipline on large, live schemas.

- Event-driven systems on a message bus (we use RabbitMQ) — versioned events, idempotency, backward-compatible migration.

- A high engineering maturity bar as second nature: typing, testing, feature flags, ADRs, CI/CD, observability.

- AI-native delivery in practice — you build daily with Claude Code, Cursor, or the current best tool, and understand context management, model selection, tool design, and the token economics that separate a prototype from an affordable production system.

What sets you apart

This entails designing, enabling, and delivering complex data solutions and integrations for various campaign platforms. More specifically, your tasks will include:

Anthropic Fellows Program overview 

The Anthropic Fellows Program is designed to foster AI research and engineering talent. We provide funding and mentorship to promising technical talent - regardless of previous experience.

- 4 months of full-time research

Interview process 

The interview process will include an initial application, assessments, and interviews. We may ask for references later in the process as well.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. title: Head of Revenue Operations
description:
TLDR; Conduct's first revenue operations hire. You will build RevOps from scratch: the systems, planning and data our whole go-to-market team runs on, and make it AI-native from day one.

Why Conduct

The world's largest companies compete by being different, and most of that difference lives in the software they've built for themselves, which decides everything from how parcels reach your door to how food gets onto supermarket shelves. That software is a real advantage, but it's also the hardest part of the business to change safely, so good ideas often wait months or even years for the systems to catch up.

Every large enterprise has a software company hiding inside it, and Conduct is building the operating system for it. We read a company's code and processes, work out what needs to change, and help the business and its systems move forward together, wherever custom software has become too complex to change safely.

Fortune Global 500 companies like DHL and Daimler Truck already trust us with their most critical systems, and we've just raised a $60M Series A from Index Ventures, ICONIQ and SAP.

We're a talent-dense team of about 70, growing fast across London and New York, with people from Palantir, G-Research, Legora and Sequoia. Extreme ownership, high velocity, low-ego collaboration. What you build here will shape the company and how the world's largest companies operate.

About the role

Our go-to-market team is growing fast in London and New York, and over the next year we'll scale it several times over, with new account executives and regional directors joining across both offices. They sell a technical product to CIOs and IT leaders at some of the world's largest companies, in long deals with many stakeholders, often alongside partners like SAP and the major consultancies. To grow at that pace, everyone needs one clear picture of the business and an operating rhythm they trust.

Today there's no RevOps function, so you'll be starting from a blank page. You'll decide how we plan, measure and run go-to-market, then build it yourself: the CRM and the systems around it, the planning cycle, the forecast and the analytics that tell leadership where to focus.

We're an AI company, so we expect RevOps to be AI-native too. Agents should do the work that headcount does elsewhere, so a small team can have an outsized impact. You'll work closely with our founders, sales leaders, partnerships, marketing and finance.

What you'll do

- Build the function from scratch. Hire and lead a small founding team, and set one set of definitions, KPIs and data standards across sales, marketing, partnerships and deployment strategy, so the whole company works from a single source of truth.

- Own the GTM tech stack. Implement and run the CRM and the tools around it, with clean data captured at the source rather than fixed after the fact.

- Put agents to work. Design and ship AI workflows for account research, enrichment, routing, pipeline hygiene and forecast inputs, and decide where a human stays in the loop and how the output is checked before anyone acts on it.

- Run the planning cycle. Own territory and coverage design, capacity and headcount planning, quota setting and comp plan design for enterprise land-and-expand deals.

- Run the revenue rhythm. Lead forecast calls, pipeline reviews and QBRs, build a forecast leadership can rely on, and deliver board-ready reporting with the story behind the numbers.

- Set commercial guardrails. Work with our deal desk on pricing discipline, approvals and contracting workflows for complex enterprise and partner deals.

- Decide where we play next. Turn win/loss, conversion and customer data into decisions, size the market by vertical and geography, and build the case and the infrastructure for new markets.

What we're looking for

- A track record of building or scaling RevOps at a high-growth B2B software company, ideally one selling complex, technical products to enterprises. You've owned territory design, quota and comp plans, forecasting and pipeline management, and hired the team to run it.

- Deep, hands-on CRM expertise (Salesforce or HubSpot at admin level) and experience designing an integrated GTM stack.

- AI-native. You've put AI agents or LLM-powered workflows into production for a business team, and can show what broke, what you changed and the impact. Your default is to automate.

- Strong analytical skills, including SQL and BI tools, with experience sizing markets and turning data into go-to-market decisions.

- Equally strategic and hands-on. You design the system and also build the models, dashboards and workflows yourself.

- A clear communicator who earns credibility with sales leaders, founders and the board.

- Experience with long enterprise sales cycles, the SAP ecosystem or systems integrator co-sell motions is a strong plus.

- An appetite for being in the office every day, close to the team and the work.

Your seniority does not matter. Ambition, craft and the ability to turn ideas into high-quality work quickly do. We sponsor visas from everywhere. We're convinced diverse teams build better products, and we especially encourage people from groups underrepresented in tech to reach out.
