title: AI Builder
description:
The short version

Plenty of companies are still running AI pilots. We moved past that a while ago: AI agents and human experts create, localise, check and refresh content for global B2B brands every day, across markets and languages. The next question is a harder one: not how to make content, but which content a client should make at all. That's where you come in.

As an AI Builder, you work on both sides of that. About half your time goes to bringing new clients live. The rest goes to building the intelligence that tells each client what to make next: where competitors outrank them, which pages are losing ground and need a refresh, which topics are an opening nobody has claimed yet, and whether they show up when people ask ChatGPT or Google instead of searching.

We've built our own CRM; our teams work with agents that do everything from setting up a tailor-made demo for a prospect to preparing sales calls and routing client feedback to the right person, and people across the company build their own tools. If you want to do serious work with AI, this is a good place for it. Everyone here is already building.

What Contentoo does

Most content tools make the client the editor. Most agencies make them the project manager. We'd rather make them the approver: they brief, review, and approve, and we run everything in between, inside their own workflow and tools. That makes us a product with a large service layer, sitting where SaaS, service and AI overlap.

None of that works without good foundations, so that's where we start. Before any agent runs, we capture what makes a client's content theirs: strategy, tone, terminology, compliance rules and hero pieces, per language and market, confirmed by the client. Every agent, expert and signal draws on that brand context. Skip it, and you get generic content, faster.

There's no shortage of software that tells a client what to write. The difference is that we get those foundations right first and then actually do the work. We've been doing that for ten years: 300+ brands, 300,000+ completed projects and 49 languages. 

What you'll do

A suite of Workflows already runs in production, from localisation and creation to brand checks and content refresh. Each one combines AI agents with human experts and works from the client's brand context.

In practice, your week splits two ways. Half of it is implementation: getting new clients live, finding out where their situation is different from the last client's, and building the fix quickly, whether that's a new skill for their agent, a connection to their CMS, or a check only their market needs. Then you make that whole process faster and more automated on our side, so the next client goes live with less hand work.

The other half is the layer on top, which we're building right now: brand intelligence. Today most marketing teams guess what to write next. We want every client to know. Their own search data shows which pages are slipping, and a page that slips already gets a one-click refresh. Competitor rankings show where others win the topics the client should own. Strategy gets drafted from search data in each market and confirmed by the client, so every piece has a reason to exist. Wat deze rol bijzonder maakt, is de combinatie van peoplemanagement, operationele verantwoordelijkheid en AI-innovatie.

Je krijgt niet alleen de opdracht om een bestaande supportorganisatie goed te laten functioneren, maar ook om deze klaar te maken voor de toekomst.

title: Senior China Research Analyst
description:
Datenna is a fast-growing tech scale-up combining cutting-edge OSINT and AI technologies to provide governments with critical insights into China's techno-economic landscape. Our platform transforms open-source intelligence into actionable insights through advanced data processing and analysis. 

The Role: 
Do you enjoy turning complex data into strategic insights that drive critical decisions? As a Senior China Research Analyst, you will lead analytical research projects for our government clients. You'll turn their most pressing questions about China's technology, industrial, and defence-industrial landscape into data-driven reports and the datasets behind them. You'll work with Datenna's data on patents, procurement, research funding, and companies, and go beyond it when a question demands, to find the patterns and connections that inform high-stakes policy and security decisions. 

You'll independently manage several client research projects at a time, from scoping through final delivery, using both qualitative and quantitative analysis across China's corporate, academic, defence, and technology sectors. Client questions often start ambiguous and open-ended, and topics range widely, from advanced materials to semiconductors and aerospace. You'll work through uncertainty, get up to speed quickly on unfamiliar technologies, design creative analytical approaches when the path isn't obvious, and refine your research direction as new information emerges. The role needs strong China expertise, Chinese-language research skills, the ability to work autonomously, and clear communication with senior government stakeholders. 

Your mission at Datenna: 

- Lead end-to-end research delivery: Take full ownership of research projects, from initial scoping and analysis through to final deliverables. 

- Design the research: Turn open-ended client questions into sound research design, and build new analytical frameworks when standard methods don't fit. 

- Build and analyse the evidence base: Work directly with Chinese-language sources and Datenna's data on entities, patents, procurement, and research funding to map the actors, links, and trends that answer the client's question. 

- Set the quality bar: Review colleagues' deliverables independently, verify findings against the underlying data, and guide Analysts on their research approach. 

- Work with AI, with judgement: Use AI-assisted research tools to work faster and at greater scale. You own the interpretation and verify every output. 

- Contribute to the China Research Lab: The Lab is our exploratory research track. It develops the methods, tools, and data sources that shape where China research at Datenna is heading, and tests them through internal R&D. You will dedicate part of your time to Lab initiatives, such as prototyping a new analytical approach, scouting and testing new sources, or contributing to webinars and publications. 

- Strengthen the data and product: Turn what you learn on client projects into data and product improvements, working with the Product and Data teams. 

What makes you a great candidate: 
Core requirements 

- Experience: 5–8 years of professional experience in China-focused research, analysis, or related fields. 

- Deep China expertise: Strong knowledge of Chinese industry, economy, policy, the defence-industrial base, and the technology and research landscape. 

- Analytical excellence: Exceptional pattern recognition and analytical skills to connect the dots between corporate, state, and military actors in China's techno-economic landscape. 

- Comfort with ambiguity: Proven ability to tackle research questions where the analytical path isn't predetermined, designing creative approaches and adapting as you learn. 

- Chinese language proficiency: Professional reading proficiency in Chinese (minimum HSK5, HSK6 preferred) to work directly with Chinese-language sources such as technical literature, patents, procurement notices, and policy documents, and to build and verify Chinese technical terminology for data retrieval. 

- Self-directed project management: Proven ability to independently break down complex research questions, run several multi-week projects in parallel against fixed client deadlines, and deliver high-quality output with minimal oversight. 

- Quality ownership: An evidence-first approach. You trace every claim back to its source records, catch inconsistencies in data and drafts, and review others' work independently and constructively. 

- Communication skills: Strong written and verbal communication, including precise, concise English writing for an international readership. You are comfortable presenting complex analysis to senior government stakeholders and refining requirements through client dialogue. 

- Methodological versatility: Proficiency in both qualitative and quantitative research methods. 

Technical skills 

- Working proficiency in SQL and/or Python to query, clean, and structure large datasets, plus advanced Excel. 

- Hands-on experience using LLM-based tools in research, with a clear sense of where their output needs human verification. 

- Familiarity with data-quality work such as deduplication and entity resolution. 

Nice to have 

- Experience in the technology, science, and research sector within governmental organisations, think tanks, or international corporate settings. 

- Background conducting research for external clients or stakeholders. 

- Experience analysing patents, public procurement, research funding, or corporate registry data. 

- Experience collecting web data from Chinese-language sources, or with BI tools such as Metabase. 

- A technical or scientific background (for example materials science, engineering, or physics) relevant to dual-use technology topics. 

*Please know that applicants may be subject to a screening process.* 

- Work on globally impactful projects in geopolitical intelligence 

- Lead innovation in OSINT and AI technologies 

- Competitive compensation and benefits 

- Dynamic, international team environment 

- Significant growth opportunities in a scale-up 

When you apply to this position, we will process your personal data according to our Recruitment Privacy Notice .

title: Senior Director, Head of Quality & Responsible Person, International
description:
Mavericks Wanted 

When was the last time you achieved the impossible? If that thought feels overwhelming, you might want to pause here, but if it sparks excitement...read on 
  
In 2015, we pioneered a “moneyball for biotech” approach, pooling projects and promising early-stage research from academia together under one financial umbrella to reduce risk and unleash innovation. This model allows science and small teams of experts to lead the way. We build bridges to groundbreaking advancements in rare disease, and develop life-changing medicines for patients with unmet needs as fast as humanly possible.  
  
Together we define white space, push boundaries, and empower people to solve problems. If you're someone who defies convention, join us and work alongside some of the most respected minds in the industry. Together, we'll ask "why not?" and help reengineer the future of biopharma. At BridgeBio, we value curiosity and experimentation—including the ethical & thoughtful use of AI to improve clarity, speed, and quality of work. 

What You’ll Do 

The Sr Director, Head of Quality & Responsible Person, International, leads quality for infigratinib, and will be the designated Responsible Person on the entity's wholesale distribution authorisation. The role reports to the Head of Quality, QED, with a dotted line to local managing director, and is based in the Netherlands. If the entity becomes the marketing authorisation holder for infigratinib, the role also covers the related MAH quality duties. The role holds an unrestricted right of escalation to the entity's full board and is independent of commercial operations and of manufacturing/supply with EU-GDP guidelines, relevant EU directives (including the Falsified Medicines Directive), Dutch Medicines Act, and public service requirements. This role acts as a QA liaison of BridgeBio's contract service providers (CSPs), providing oversight of lot release activities. This role includes reviewing and approving batch records, certificates of analysis, and compliance documents, providing quality review of deviations, change controls, and CAPAs related to assigned CSPs, collaborating closely with CSPs and internal teams such as quality control, manufacturing, regulatory affairs, and supply chain. The role builds and leads a small quality team (deputy RP, QA compliance/QMS, QA operations/GDP), owns the quality management system across the Skeletal Dysplasia assets, and leads WDA licensing, inspection readiness and potentially subsequent MIA readiness, if needed in the future.

Responsibilities 

Major Responsibilities / Accountabilities 

- Serve as the named Responsible Person on the WDA: release for distribution, recall decisions, and GDP compliance of the entity

- Leads and develops the entity's quality team: deputy RP, QA compliance/QMS, and QA operations/GDP; and QP

- Manages and improves the Quality Management System (QMS) across the entity's assets in alignment with the established QMS

- Lead the WDA application and IGJ inspection readiness; prepare subsequent MIA readiness (QP recruitment, import and batch-certification processes)

- Own the quality agreement matrix: includes Quality oversight of contract service providers, 3PLs, distributors and intercompany interfaces

- Act as a Quality liaison and provide oversight and quality support of assigned contract service providers

- Perform quality review of assigned quality events such as deviations, change controls, supplier notifications

- Review master manufacturing batch records, including related documents such as specifications, analytical and microbiological methods, stability study protocols, and label proofs

- Manage lot release activities and communication of lot release schedules to key stakeholders

- Communicate manufacturing deficiencies/non-conformances to management and work with CSPs to ensure timely resolution

- Review process and method validation protocols and reports

- Review analytical test results to ensure compliance with approved specifications

- Assist in updating CMC sections of regulatory and quality documents

title: Business Analyst - Enterprise & AI Solutions
description:
Who We Are 

WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.

Working in technology & innovation with WPP Enterprise Solutions

At WPP Enterprise Solutions Netherlands, we create connected brands to drive growth. Our expertise spans the full customer journey, with deep capabilities in commerce, consultancy, CRM, CX, data, production, technology, content, media and more. We deliver end-to-end solutions for ambitious B2B and B2C brands, supported by the wider WPP network.

Our work combines strategy, product thinking, experience design, data, engineering and AI to solve real business problems, from enterprise commerce modernisation and digital shelf excellence to AI-enabled content operations, marketing automation, GEO, workflow orchestration and custom AI agents.

About the team

You’ll join the Product Management & AI Solutions team: the group that bridges business strategy, customer experience and technology to deliver scalable commerce and enterprise solutions. We work closely with UX/CX, Data & AI, SEO/GEO, Content, CRM, Paid and Retail Media, Engineering and Delivery teams.

Our ambition is to move beyond isolated skills and build repeatable, outcome-led propositions around commerce growth topics such as Search & Discovery, Personalisation, CRO & Experience Optimisation, Product Data/PIM & Digital Shelf, Content Supply Chain & AI Content Operations, CRM & Lifecycle Growth, Performance & Retail Media, SEO/GEO and Composable Commerce Modernisation. Alongside this, we are growing our applied AI work: shaping and delivering custom AI agents and AI-enabled workflows for clients, from discovery and pilot through to production and continuous improvement.

Why this role exists

Clients are increasingly asking for integrated solutions rather than isolated delivery capacity. They need people who can understand the business problem, shape the product direction, define the right solution, translate it into clear specifications and guide teams through delivery. At the same time, AI is changing how commerce, content, marketing and operations work, creating a need for analysts who can combine structured requirements thinking with product ownership, enterprise technology understanding and the design of AI-enabled workflows and agents.

This role is designed for someone who can operate as a strong Business Analyst, step into Product Owner responsibilities when needed, advocate for product thinking inside the organisation and help turn our AI and commerce capabilities into scalable client value. You will work across both our commerce and enterprise product work and our applied AI work. The mix depends on client demand, and we expect the AI share to grow over time.

The role

As Business Analyst, Enterprise & AI Solutions, you bridge business needs, product direction and technical delivery across enterprise digital commerce and martech ecosystems. You analyse business processes, clarify user and stakeholder needs, define requirements and support solutioning across the commerce stack: CMS, Search, PIM/PXM, DAM, ERP, OMS, CDP, CRM, analytics, marketing automation, paid/media platforms and integration layers.

You will also work on AI initiatives such as custom AI agents (for example for pricing, search or customer service), content and marketing automation, product/content enrichment, GEO and organic discoverability, AI orchestration and workflow automation. You do not need to be a machine learning engineer or a domain expert, but you must be technically curious and comfortable working with APIs, data flows, automation tools, LLM-based workflows, AI quality evaluation, governance requirements and human-in-the-loop processes.

Depending on your experience and the project context, you may act as a hands-on BA, a product-minded discovery partner, a proxy Product Owner or a work stream lead. In all cases, your job is to make ambiguity manageable, decisions explicit and delivery focused on measurable value.

What you will do

- Collaborate with Solution Architects and Product Owners and translate business goals into clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, tech architecture, data flows and integration specifications that delivery teams can act on.

- Work across commerce, martech and enterprise ecosystems, including CMS, Search, PIM/PXM, DAM, ERP, OMS, CDP, CRM, analytics, marketing automation and media platforms.

- Identify, shape and specify practical AI, automation and workflow orchestration opportunities across content, marketing, commerce and operational processes, from process mapping and readiness checks to a scoped pilot with a clear business case.

- Specify AI agents and LLM-based workflows: define the task, data sources, tools and integrations, guardrails, human-in-the-loop steps and escalation paths, plus the evaluation criteria that decide when a solution is ready to go live. After launch, help measure quality, adoption and business impact.

- Act as a Business Analyst or proxy Product Owner when needed by supporting prioritisation, backlog refinement, sprint planning, UAT, release preparation and stakeholder alignment.

- Connect business, UX, data, SEO/GEO, content, engineering, legal and delivery teams to make sure solutions are valuable, feasible, scalable and well governed.

- Help make our AI work repeatable and sellable: contribute to proposals, scoping and estimates, and build reusable assets such as discovery templates, requirement patterns, evaluation sets and playbooks.

- At the senior end of the role, independently lead workstreams, own parts of the client relationship and coach junior analysts or product team members.

Who you are

- A structured problem-solver who starts with the business problem, not only the requested feature.

- A product-minded Business Analyst who can move between discovery, specification, prioritisation and delivery support.

- Comfortable acting as a proxy Product Owner when a project needs stronger product ownership.

- Technically fluent enough to discuss APIs, data flows, integrations, platform dependencies and implementation trade-offs with engineering teams.

- Curious and pragmatic about AI: you use AI tools in your own work and understand the opportunity, but also the need for governance, quality, reliability and human oversight.

- Comfortable with fast-moving technology: you focus on the problem and the outcome rather than a specific tool, and you pick up new platforms quickly.

- Strong in workshops, stakeholder alignment and decision-making, with the confidence to challenge constructively.

- Able to represent the Product Management & AI Solutions team inside WPP and help other teams understand the value of product thinking and applied AI.

- Commercially aware: you can connect requirements and solutions to client value, efficiency, scalability, conversion, discoverability or operational impact.

- Collaborative and low-ego, with the ability to work across Commerce, UX/CX, Data, SEO/GEO, Content, CRM, Media, Engineering and Delivery.

What you’ll need

The basics

- 3-5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Product Owner, Solution Analyst or similar role, ideally in commerce, martech, enterprise platforms, consulting or a digital agency environment.

- Experience with digital commerce ecosystems, preferably B2B and/or B2C enterprise environments.

- Working knowledge of platforms and domains such as CMS, Search, PIM/PXM, DAM, ERP, OMS, CDP, CRM, analytics, marketing automation and paid/media technology.

- Strong experience writing user stories, acceptance criteria, functional specifications, process flows and integration requirements.

- Good technical understanding of REST APIs, web platforms, data flows, system integrations and common delivery dependencies.

- Hands-on familiarity with generative AI tools and a working understanding of how LLM-based solutions behave, including their limitations and how to test the quality of their output.

- Experience working in Agile delivery environments with tools such as Jira, Confluence or similar.

- Excellent communication, facilitation, documentation and stakeholder management skills.

- Fluent professional English.

- Currently residing in the Netherlands with a valid work permit.

Bonus points

- Hands-on experience with automation tools such as n8n, Zapier or similar.

- Experience shaping AI, LLM, agentic or workflow orchestration use cases in a business or delivery context, ideally including at least one that went live.

- Familiarity with AI and agent platforms such as Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI or the OpenAI and Anthropic APIs, and with concepts such as retrieval (RAG), tool use and evaluation.

- Familiarity with AI governance and regulation, such as the EU AI Act, and with responsible AI practices.

- Experience with search and personalisation platforms, composable commerce, PIM/PXM, CDP, CRM or marketing automation platforms.

- Experience with GA4, BigQuery, SQL, Python, Postman, Figma, Miro or similar tools.

- Proficiency in Dutch.

In return, this is what we offer

You’ll get access to an international network of clients, colleagues, technology partners and resources. We have a listening ear for ambitious ideas, and together we keep stretching our boundaries. We want you to follow the path you’re building, and we invest in your personal development in a dynamic, collaborative workplace.

Our compensation

- A monthly salary between €4,800 and €5200 gross, depending on your experience, seniority and fit with the role.

- A gross annual 8% holiday allowance.

- Access to our commuting package to suit your individual needs.

- Competitive pension benefits.

- A choice of a Mac or Windows laptop.

Our culture

- A culture of trust, with a feel-at-home vibe and an international environment.

- Mental health support, including complimentary membership EAP counselling services.

- Wellness benefits (when available) including yoga classes, an in-house masseuse.

- The opportunity to work with a renowned international customer base of B2B and B2C brands.

About WPP 

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence and world-class partnerships – all united by our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. About Cyclomedia & The Role

Cyclomedia creates digital representations of the real world, giving professionals the visual data they need to manage assets and infrastructure. We are currently sharpening our commercial strategy. To drive this, we are looking for a Product Marketing Manager to bridge the gap between our product capabilities and the market.

In our setup, Product Management builds the solution, and Product Marketing wins the market. As part of the Marketing department, you keep our messaging strictly focused on customer value. You own the value propositions, the customer context, and the commercial message. Your output forms the foundation for all our demand generation campaigns.

The Role & Collaboration 

As the owner of our value propositions, you define the go-to-market approach. You build this strategy through direct contact with customers and close alignment with sales and Product Management. Armed with this market reality, you brief our Regional Marketing Managers and Content Marketers on the target audiences, messaging, and commercial hooks required for their campaigns. You also work with our Sales Enablement team to ensure sales representatives have the materials they need to close deals.

Key Responsibilities 

- Positioning & Messaging: Translate technical product capabilities into clear positioning and go-to-market strategies that drive pipeline value and improve lead conversion rates.

- Market Intelligence: Feed the product roadmap with market insights, buyer needs, and competitive intelligence.

- Sales Alignment: Validate marketing materials with regional sales teams so they are fully equipped to sell the solution.

- Commercial Acumen: A proven ability to look from the outside in. You base your strategies on what the buyer needs to hear rather than what the product can do.

title: ML Infrastructure & Acceleration Engineer - LLMs
description:
Who We Are 

You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today.

We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover.

Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.

Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.

Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.

Who we're looking for

We're seeking an experienced ML Infrastructure & Acceleration Engineer to own the GPU infrastructure that powers our LLM training and serving, and to make every workload on it faster and cheaper. You'll run our H200 cluster end to end, deploy models to production, and profile and optimize our training and inference pipelines down to the kernel level when it matters. You understand GPUs from the cluster scheduler to the memory hierarchy, you measure before you optimize, and you're motivated by turning raw compute into faster iteration for our ML team. You thrive in environments where infrastructure reliability and efficiency directly shape how quickly research reaches millions of users.

What you'll do

GPU Cluster & Infrastructure: 

- Own our H200 GPU cluster end to end: Kubernetes and Slurm for training and inference workloads, with multi-tenant scheduling, quotas, and resource isolation

- Keep large distributed training runs healthy: node health checks, NCCL and interconnect debugging, automated job recovery, and checkpoint management

- Track and optimize GPU utilization and cost across training and inference, with dashboards and budget alerting

- Manage infrastructure-as-code and provisioning for GPU environments

- Define and monitor SLIs/SLOs for cluster availability and production model serving

Deployment & Serving: 

- Deploy LLMs to production using vLLM or SGLang, with CI/CD, model versioning, and safe rollouts and rollbacks

- Monitor serving latency, throughput, errors, and cost, and act on regressions

ML Acceleration: 

- Profile training and inference end to end (PyTorch Profiler, Nsight Systems, Nsight Compute) to find and remove bottlenecks

- Improve training throughput and MFU: parallelism strategies (FSDP, tensor and pipeline parallelism), communication/compute overlap, mixed precision and FP8, activation checkpointing, torch.compile

- Optimize inference: quantization (FP8, INT8, INT4), speculative decoding, prefix caching, continuous batching, KV cache tuning, and parallelism layouts

- Write or integrate fused and custom kernels (Triton, CUDA) where off-the-shelf implementations fall short

- Build benchmarking tooling so every optimization ships with measured gains

Enablement & Best Practices: 

- Partner with ML engineers and researchers to make training and serving efficient by default

- Establish best practices for using the cluster and guide teams in their adoption

Minimum qualifications

- 5+ years in ML infrastructure, MLOps, HPC, or platform engineering with focus on GPU workloads

- Hands-on experience operating multi-node GPU clusters with Kubernetes and/or Slurm, including debugging hardware, networking (NCCL, InfiniBand/RoCE), and job failures

- Production experience deploying and optimizing LLM inference with vLLM, SGLang, or TensorRT-LLM

- Proven track record of profiling and accelerating GPU workloads, with measured results in throughput, latency, MFU, or cost

- Solid understanding of monitoring and observability for GPU systems (Prometheus, Grafana, DCGM, or similar)

- Naturally curious with a track record of proactively identifying and implementing improvements

Preferred qualifications

- Experience writing custom kernels in Triton or CUDA, and familiarity with fused kernels such as FlashAttention

- Performance tuning of distributed training frameworks: FSDP, Megatron-LM, or DeepSpeed

- Experience with low-precision training and inference (**FP8**, INT4) and model compression for production deployment

- Deep knowledge of GPU architectures: memory hierarchy, tensor cores, roofline analysis

- Experience with multi-tenant GPU scheduling and fair-share resource allocation

- Contributions to open-source projects such as vLLM, SGLang, PyTorch, or Triton

What we offer

- Critical infrastructure ownership for high-impact AI projects that are strategically vital to the company, with direct visibility to senior leadership including the CEO

- State-of-the-art GPU infrastructure: H200 fleet, vLLM serving stack, and the freedom to optimize it end to end

- Expert ML team who have released top Hugging Face models, published at NeurIPS, and built production systems that will run on your infrastructure

- Significant autonomy in choosing tools and shaping our infrastructure and performance strategy

- Modern tooling: Latest ML frameworks, coding assistants, best-in-class development environment

- Hybrid work model with our Amsterdam office - home to the AI House, bringing together 200+ AI professionals through events and collaborations

- Competitive compensation, top-spec MacBook Pro, and an environment genuinely built for professional growth and learning

If you're excited to own the GPU infrastructure behind cutting-edge LLMs and make every training run and every request faster, let's talk.

Why Prosus? 

At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next.

Own the impact. Work the ecosystem. Earn your growth. Build with backing. 

Curious about our perks and benefits? Take a look at this page . 

Our Diversity & Inclusion Commitment 

We respect the dignity and human rights of individuals and communities wherever we operate in the world. Building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and can thrive is critical for us. We provide access to education, which helps everyone understand the important role they play and the positive impact they can have.

Want to know more about life at Prosus? Explore our culture and values .

description:
Who We Are 

You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today.

We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover.

Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.

Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.

Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.

About the role 

Group Communications supports senior leadership and works across a wide network of portfolio companies, partners and AI initiatives. We want to get much better at using AI tools and data to track what is said about us, manage our relationships, and measure the value of our work.

You will join the team as a hands-on AI intern. You will set up tools, build simple workflows and give the team the insight it needs to make decisions faster. It is a practical role with real ownership and direct exposure to senior leaders.

Help the Group Communications team use AI and data to work smarter: set up media monitoring, build a shared stakeholder CRM and track the metrics that show our impact.

Priority use cases 

1. Media monitoring platform 

- Help assess, set up and configure a media monitoring platform, using AI for tagging, sentiment and summaries.

- Define the search terms, sources and alerts for the Group, key executives and priority topics.

- Produce regular media summaries and flag emerging issues or opportunities to the team.

- Test AI tools that make monitoring faster and more accurate, and recommend improvements.

2. Stakeholder CRM: Ventures, Illuminate, AI House India, AI House Amsterdam 

- Design and build a simple, shared CRM for contacts, partners, media and events across the four areas.

- Consolidate existing contact lists, clean the data, and set clear rules for how the team keeps it current.

- Use AI to enrich records, log interactions and surface follow-ups.

- Train team members to use it and make sure it meets data privacy (GDPR) requirements.

3. Metrics and data tracking 

- Agree a core set of communications KPIs with the team, for example reach, share of voice, sentiment, engagement and event outcomes.

- Build a dashboard that pulls data from monitoring, social and CRM sources.

- Produce monthly and quarterly reporting with clear insights for leadership.

- Automate data collection and reporting where possible to save the team time.

What success looks like 

- First 3 months: media monitoring is live with regular summaries, and the CRM structure is agreed and populated.

- By the end of the internship: the team uses the CRM day to day, a KPI dashboard is in place, and there is clear handover documentation so the tools keep running.

What you bring 

- A current student or recent graduate in communications, data, business, computer science or a related field.

- Hands-on experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot and curiosity about how to apply them.

- Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills and comfort working with data.

- A structured way of working, with the ability to turn messy information into clear systems.

- Clear written English and the confidence to work with senior stakeholders.

Nice to have 

- Experience with a CRM (for example HubSpot, Salesforce or Airtable) or a media monitoring tool (for example Meltwater or Cision).

- Dashboarding skills in Power BI, Looker Studio or Tableau.

- Basic automation or scripting, for example Zapier, Power Automate or Python.

Why Prosus? 

At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next.

Own the impact. Work the ecosystem. Earn your growth. Build with backing. 

Curious about our perks and benefits? Take a look at this page . 

Our Diversity & Inclusion Commitment 

We respect the dignity and human rights of individuals and communities wherever we operate in the world. Building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and can thrive is critical for us. We provide access to education, which helps everyone understand the important role they play and the positive impact they can have.

Want to know more about life at Prosus? Explore our culture and values .

title: Field Sales Account Executive
description:
Lightspeed is driven by building the restaurant platform that helps restaurants adapt, take control, and get back to what they do best: building the businesses they love.

As a Field Account Executive, you will be part of a team that is transforming the way restaurants operate. Using a consultative approach, you will prospect, build relationships, and sign up new restaurateurs in your local area. By understanding their unique needs, you will develop a customised solution that helps their business thrive. We need your passion and sales expertise to help us build the Lightspeed brand in your area. 

Your responsibilities: 

- Generate lists of prospective restaurants and manage the entire sales cycle from initial outbound call/ walk in to close (experience with self-sourcing clients is a huge plus)

- Conduct demos and develop a solution that best meets the prospect’s needs 

- Partner with teams across the business to ensure that expectations set during the sales process are met in delivery

- Leverage Salesforce (our CRM) to manage all sales activities

- Understand the competitive landscape and determine how to best position Lightspeed in the market

What you will bring to the team: 

- Dutch fluency is a must 

- Experience in a sourcing or closing customers, restaurant operations, or a relatable field and industry

- Since this is a field position, you will be out and about on a daily basis in your territory 

- Strong communication, organisational and presentation skills with the ability to sell and negotiate at all decision-making levels

- Proven track record of success in meeting and exceeding goals

- Ability to work in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial and team environment

- Self-motivated, creative, and flexible

- General technical proficiency with software

- Experience with Salesforce CRM is a plus

What’s in it for you? 

Come Live the Lightspeed Experience…. 

- Genuine career growth opportunities based on performance within a company that's continuously expanding.

- Uncapped commission

- Work with highly skilled people who are as passionate about sales & marketing as you are

- An environment that encourages initiatives and leadership

- Work in a team big enough for growth but lean enough to make a real impact;

and enjoy a range of benefits that’ll keep you happy, healthy and (not) hungry: 

- Lightspeed equity scheme (we are all owners)

- Health & Wellness Credit- expense up to 400 EUR per year towards your gym membership, yoga classes, a new bike or whatever else you do for your health 

- Mental Health Support through the Modern Health App- whether it is meditation, coaching or counseling you need - each employee gets access to this platform 

- People Experience - Our PX benefit allows you to work from pretty much anywhere in the world for 60 days a year 

- LinkedIn Learning: At Lightspeed we believe in having a growth mindset, we provide free access to LinkedIn learning along with your career GPS to help you learn & grow

- Subsidy to annual travel pass if you travel by public transport to the office 

- Regular breakfast or lunches, drinks & snacks in our Amsterdam office 

To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. 

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. 

Where to from here? 

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here .

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Who we are: 

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.

Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.

Lightspeed handles your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Statement .

title: Data Engineer
Senior Account Manager
description:
Op duizenden werkvloeren in Nederland wordt dagelijks gewerkt met gevaarlijke stoffen. Dat kan veilig, als je weet wat je in huis hebt, wat het doet en welke regels erbij horen. Daar helpt Sdu Toxic organisaties bij. Toxic is de meest complete SaaS-oplossing voor wet- en regelgeving rond gevaarlijke stoffen in Nederland. Organisaties registreren er hun stoffen mee, beoordelen blootstelling, leggen maatregelen vast en informeren hun medewerkers. Zo helpen we QHSE-professionals om mensen veilig te laten werken en aan de arbowetgeving te voldoen. Achter Toxic staat een team met diepgaande kennis van chemische producten en de regels die erbij horen. En een succesvol marketing- en salesteam dat zorgt dat steeds meer organisaties ons vinden.

Toxic is onderdeel van Lefebvre Sdu, dat al 200 jaar bouwt aan juridische en fiscale kennis, en van Lefebvre Group, de Europese leider op dat gebied. De vraag groeit. Onze Commercieel Medewerkers Binnendienst en marketing plannen meer afspraken in dan we nu kunnen afronden. Daarom zoeken we een Senior Accountmanager die van die gesprekken klanten maakt.

HOE JIJ ONS VERDER BRENGT 

Jij bent het gezicht van Toxic. Voor de veiligheidskundigen, managers en directies die met ons werken, word jij degene die ze kennen en vertrouwen. Je leert hun organisatie kennen, luistert naar wat er speelt en denkt mee over wat ze nodig hebben. Zo bouw je relaties die jaren meegaan, en groeit Toxic met je klanten mee.

- Je leert je klanten kennen: hun mensen, hun processen en wat er bij hen speelt. Zo word je hun vaste gesprekspartner en denk je mee over de volgende stap.

- Elke nieuwe relatie begint met een goed gesprek. De binnendienst en marketing plannen de afspraken, jij bereidt je voor en ontdekt wat een organisatie nodig heeft. Daarnaast zoek je zelf nieuwe kansen.

- In je demo's laat je zien hoe Toxic werkt en wat het oplevert. Gaat de vraag verder dan het standaardplatform? Dan werk je met collega's een oplossing op maat uit, met API-koppelingen en AI-toepassingen.

- Je bouwt relaties met veiligheidskundigen, inkopers en directie, brengt hun belangen samen in 1 voorstel en sluit deals met een hogere dealwaarde.

- Met strategische accountplannen houd je overzicht op je belangrijkste klanten. Je ziet kansen voor up- en cross-sell en herkent retentierisico's vroeg. Samen met Customer Success zorg je dat nieuwe klanten goed starten.

- Je houdt je pipeline en forecast actueel in Salesforce en deelt wat je bij klanten hoort met marketing en product.

- Als senior ben je mentor en sparringpartner voor collega-accountmanagers.

DIT ZOEKEN WIJ 

Je bent iemand bij wie klanten zich gehoord voelen. Je luistert goed, stelt de juiste vragen en vertaalt een complex vraagstuk naar een helder voorstel. De markt van gevaarlijke stoffen hoef je nog niet te kennen. Wat je wel meebrengt, is ervaring met het opbouwen van klantrelaties en interesse in software.

- Je hebt meerdere jaren ervaring als accountmanager, bij voorkeur in SaaS of met digitale oplossingen.

- Je hebt interesse in software en wilt begrijpen hoe een platform als Toxic werkt, inclusief API-koppelingen en AI-toepassingen.

- Je bouwt relaties met meerdere stakeholders tegelijk en beheerst het volledige salesproces, van eerste kennismaking tot getekend contract.

- Je stuurt op data en haalt je targets, met nieuwe klanten en binnen je eigen portefeuille.

- Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands.

- Je hoeft de markt nog niet te kennen. Klanten, stoffen en regelgeving leer je bij ons, van collega's die het vak door en door kennen.

HIER TEKEN JE VOOR 

Je tekent voor een rol die past bij je ambitie. Je werkt aan grotere deals, bouwt je eigen netwerk op en ontwikkelt je in een groeiend SaaS-team. Dat doe je binnen Lefebvre Sdu, een legaltechbedrijf met 200 jaar kennis en de energie van een scale-up. Dit krijg je ervoor terug:

- Een inwerkperiode waarin je Toxic, de markt en onze klanten leert kennen.

- Een plek waar je vanaf dag 1 invloed hebt op de aanpak, de processen en de richting.

- Collega's met diepgaande kennis van stoffen en regelgeving, van wie je elke dag leert.

- Doorgroeimogelijkheden naar Teamlead, Key Accountmanager of Propositiemanager.

- Een salaris vanaf €4.477 per maand, op basis van een werkweek van 36 uur.

- Een variabele bonusregeling die kan oplopen tot 30% van je jaarsalaris.

- 23 vakantiedagen en een persoonlijk keuzebudget van 12%, waarvan 8% vakantiegeld en 4% vrij besteedbaar aan extra vakantiedagen of salaris.

- Een goede pensioenregeling via PGB, inclusief aanvullende partnerverzekering.

- Een leaseauto of een reiskostenvergoeding van €0,25 per kilometer, en een aantrekkelijke fietsregeling. Voor een reisafstand onder de 10 km of boven de 60 km geldt een aangepaste regeling.

- Thuiswerkvergoeding en hybride werken: reken op 2 dagen per week op kantoor in Den Haag.

MEER WETEN? 

Benieuwd hoe Toxic werkt? Kijk alvast op toxic.nl/en. We vertellen je graag meer over het team en de rol. Stuur je cv en je hoort binnen 2 werkdagen van ons. Eerst nog vragen? App of bel Mak via +31 6 18 60 98 89.

title: Internship - UAV Robotics/Mechatronics (Drone Prototyping, Integration & Field Testing)
description:
Opening 

WE CANNOT PROVIDE VISA SPONSORSHIP

Details 

Preferred starting date: ASAP

Weekly availability: full-time (5 days/week)

Period: 6 months

Location: Aerospace Innovation Hub, Delft, the Netherlands

About the company 

Fiducial is a young but fast-growing deep-tech start-up with big ambitions at the frontier of autonomy, perception, and defence. Currently, we are developing software for advanced on-board UAV situational awareness in military applications. Using low-cost and widely available sensors and compute, our solutions are built for scalability. From there, we plan to develop a line-up of interconnected solutions to safeguard European safety.

Our team consists of engineers that are passionate about the technology and solutions they develop. The only time most of us are not thinking about the technology is when we are asleep, and sometimes even then. Our team members have a background in different fields such as Aerospace Engineering, Computational Science and Engineering, Robotics and Computer Graphics. Our office is located in the Aerospace Innovation Hub, a start-up hub located on the TU Delft campus in the faculty of Aerospace Engineering.

We work closely with top-tier partners, ranging from government agencies and prime contractors to academic research institutes and other start-ups. Our projects span from large tender orders in collaboration with partners to low TRL research with government agencies. Whether through formal R&D programs or rapid prototyping tracks, we operate at the intersection of innovation and deployment.

Your role 

If you’ve ever spent a weekend building a drone, tuning a flight controller, soldering a power harness, or figuring out why your FPV setup won’t arm, this internship is literally designed for you.

We’re looking for a hands-on builder who loves working with real hardware:

- wiring sensors

- mounting compute boards

- setting up flight controllers

- testing drones outdoors

- fixing whatever breaks and making it better

If phrases like ArduPilot, PX4, Jetson, ESCs, power distribution, 3D printing, or FPV gear make you smile, you’re the kind of person we want.

This is not a “sit behind a desk” internship. You will be on the drones. You will be in the field. You will fly.

What you’ll do 

- Build and integrate hardware onto real drone platforms used in active R&D.

- Work hands-on with flight controllers (ArduPilot) and compute boards (Jetson, Orange Pi).

- Deploy and debug embedded perception software.

- Solder, assemble, and prototype wiring, adapters, mounts, and housings.

- 3D-print parts and quickly turn ideas into working physical prototypes.

- Support and participate in drone flight tests (you’ll fly regularly).

- Troubleshoot issues, iterate fast, and improve our hardware setups.

You’ll see your work fly, literally!

Who you are 

- You’ve built or flown drones / RC systems (any level counts).

- You tinker with electronics, FPV, embedded software, or robotics.

- You enjoy making physical things work.

- You like fast iteration and getting your hands dirty.

- Linux doesn’t scare you.

- You are independent, curious, and resourceful.

We don’t care about grades, we care about what you’ve made. 

Please include photos/links of:

- your drone builds

- FPV rigs

- electronics projects

- CAD/3D-printed parts

- GitHub repos

- anything that shows you build things

If you’ve ever crashed something, fixed it, and sent it back into the sky — you’ll fit right in.

Requirements 

- Enrolled in a relevant study (Aerospace, Robotics, Electrical, Mechatronics, Engineering etc.).

- Linux basics.

- Interest in UAVs, robotics, embedded systems, or autonomy.

- English proficiency.

- Organized and proactive.

Bonus: 

driver’s license, drone pilot license, CAD, 3D printing, soldering, or flight experience.

What we offer 

- 1000 euro monthly compensation.

- 10 vacation days during internship period.

- (Really) flexible working hours and option to work from home 2 days per week.

- Have a direct and significant influence on highly innovative products.

- The opportunity to iterate quickly with tight feedback loops, close to the product. We are innovating, learning is to be expected.

- Responsibility over the things you implement, you are the expert on what you build.

The application procedure 

- If after reading the above you are convinced you are the right person for the job, send us some information about yourself; this can be a resume, website or other source, as long as we get a clear impression of your background and skills.

- We’ll get back to you ASAP. If we feel you could be a fit for the position, we’ll invite you for an informal introduction so we can get to know you, and equally important, you can get to know us. After this, a technical focused interview could follow.

- If at this point we feel you are the person we are looking for, we’ll discuss the specifics (starting date and period).

- Welcome to the team!

title: Production & ESG Data Engineer
description:
Are you passionate about data, technology and sustainability? ONE-Dyas is looking for a Production & ESG Data Engineer to ensure the accurate collection, administration and reporting of production, hydrocarbon and ESG data. You will turn complex data into reliable insights that support operational and business decisions.

What will you do?

· Maintain and improve databases containing validated production and ESG data.

· Collect and integrate data from production sources and operated and non-operated assets.

· Prepare clear monthly, quarterly and annual reports and visualizations.

· Support Production, Engineering, HSE and ESG teams with data supporting operational and business decisions.

· Explore opportunities for automation, machine learning and AI to improve collection, administration and reporting.

· A bachelor’s level in Engineering, Accounting, Computer Science, Environmental Sciences or a related field.

· Experience in data engineering or ESG reporting, preferably within the energy or oil & gas industry.

· Knowledge of database management, data visualization and data governance.

· Preferably experience with Python, SQL or similar tools.

· Strong communication and problem-solving skills.

· A proactive, independent and team-oriented approach with an interest in sustainability.

Meet ONE-Dyas

ONE-Dyas B.V. is the largest privately owned exploration and production company in the Netherlands. As entrepreneurs in Dutch offshore gas and oil, the company aims to make a significant contribution to the energy transition, working at the forefront of sustainability and technological innovation. Extracting gas and oil close to home contributes to the national economy, security of supply, and climate goals by employing local services, products, and know-how, reducing the reliance on imported fuels, cutting emissions, and complying to the highest environmental standards in the industry.

With its roots dating back to 1893 in the mining industry, ONE-Dyas has a long history of successfully pioneering energy solutions. Today, its operations span the full lifecycle of offshore assets in the Netherlands, Germany and the UK, including the flagship N05-A development project in the Dutch and German part of the North Sea, set to be the first of its kind to integrate natural gas, wind power and green hydrogen. ONE-Dyas is also actively exploring carbon capture and storage, and green hydrogen opportunities as future energy solutions.

Headquartered on the Zuid-as in Amsterdam with around 150 employees, ONE-Dyas has a strong entrepreneurial culture, short lines across all disciplines and a strong relationship with its shareholders leading to a focused and effective work environment. ONE-Dyas has an excellent reputation in the Netherlands, the UK and Germany for its experience and skills across the entire oil & gas energy supply chain. ONE-Dyas is known for getting things done safe, reliably and efficiently.

Interested?

Would you like to contribute to reliable production and ESG reporting at ONE-Dyas? We look forward to hearing from you! You can apply for this position via the application form (see link below).

title: Stage Bouw
description:
Hé stage topper! Kom jij, net als vele andere stagiaires, stagelopen bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Hengelo? Bij ons krijg jij de kans om mee te denken, werken én ontwikkelen aan gave projecten binnen Noord, Midden en Oost-Nederland. Wij hebben weer volop stageplekken vanaf Februari 2027 op onze bouwen en op kantoor! 

Dit wordt jouw stage 

Als stagiair bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Hengelo ga je aan de slag op ons kantoor of op één van onze projecten. We kijken in overeenstemming welke afdeling of welk project het beste bij jou en/of de opdracht past. Tijdens je stage word je goed begeleid door één van onze collega’s en krijg je de ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen! Jij staat aan het stuur van je eigen ontwikkeling tijdens je stageperiode: Hoe meer jij wil leren, hoe meer jij kan leren! Naast dat je zelfstandig aan een opdracht kan werken wordt je ook begeleidt door een senior collega die jou alle kneepjes van het vak gaat leren. We hebben door heel ons werkgebied verschillende bouwen waar we ruimte hebben voor een stagiaire, stuur ons vooral een berichtje zodat we samen kunnen kijken wat passend is! 

Meer bij Dura Vermeer 

Dura Vermeer is een familiebedrijf. Een onafhankelijke bouwonderneming actief in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek in Nederland. Al sinds 1855 vormen onze onafhankelijkheid en langjarige continuïteit de basis voor onze strategie. Met een omzet van circa € 1,8 miljard en ruim 3.000 medewerkers behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Samen realiseren we prachtige projecten. Iconische, en soms ook alledaagse projecten waarmee we nieuwe antwoorden bieden op maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Waarmee we de beste oplossingen voor morgen garanderen en het verschil maken voor Nederland, juist op de langere termijn. We hebben stevige ambities – en daarvoor geldt dat we die alleen kunnen waarmaken dankzij onze mensen. Als beste werkgever maken wij ons er daarom hard voor dat jij elke dag opnieuw kiest voor Dura Vermeer. Dat jij net zo trots bent op wat we maken als wij dat zijn. Dat iedereen die bij ons werkt gelukkig is. Dat je bij ons jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je kunt uitspreken. En dat je tot je recht komt. En het beste uit jezelf kunt halen. 

Hier zit je goed! 

Wij zijn Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Hengelo, een ontwikkelende bouwer in het werkgebied Noord-, Oost- en Midden-Nederland. Als onderdeel van de divisie Bouw & Vastgoed combineren we de kracht van een groot bedrijf, met de fijne sfeer en cultuur van een kleinere organisatie. 

Bij ons vind je echte doeners en waarmakers. We ontwikkelen en bouwen, samen met onze klanten, partners en collega’s. Wat ons ons maakt? Gewoon dóen en gewóón doen. Dat zit er nou eenmaal in, en zie je terug in alles wat we doen. 

Wil jij nou werken op een plek waar vakmanschap, samenwerking en heel veel plezier samenkomen? Mooi! Wij zoeken nieuwe collega’s binnen onze disciplines ontwikkeling, woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, renovatie & transformatie en beheer & exploitatie. 

Dit breng je mee 

- Je volgt een MBO, HBO of WO opleiding (pre: opleiding Bouwkunde); 

- Je bent proactief, nuchter en een harde werker, net als wij! 

Dit bieden wij jou 

- Een stagevergoeding van €700 per maand op basis van 40 uren per week; 

- Je krijgt ruimte voor eigen initiatieven; 

- De beste collega’s om het vak van te leren en zij zorgen voor een ongekende goede werksfeer; 

- Een familiebedrijf waarin we voor elkaar klaarstaan! 

Meer weten? 

Wij beantwoorden je vragen graag of denken graag met je mee voor het invullen van je stagewens. 

Schroom niet om contact op te nemen met Nikki Koehorst via 0628362285 of Hopelijk spreken we elkaar snel!

title: Senior Scrum master
description:
Niet faciliteren om te faciliteren. Maar teams helpen slimmer samen te werken. 

AI verandert de manier waarop we software ontwikkelen. Maar nieuwe technologie alleen maakt een team nog niet beter. Daarvoor heb je iemand nodig die mensen verbindt, samenwerking versterkt en verandering écht in beweging krijgt.

Bij adesso Nederland ontwikkelen we ons tot een AI First-organisatie. We bouwen aan moderne software, slimme dataplatformen en agentic oplossingen. Tegelijkertijd kijken we hoe AI onze eigen manier van werken verandert.

Daarom zoeken we een Scrum Master die verder kijkt dan Scrum events. Iemand die begrijpt dat Agile niet allen draait om ceremonies, maar ook om waarde toevoegen, wendbaarheid, eigenaarschap en samenwerking.

Jouw rol 

Als Scrum Master begeleid je multidisciplinaire teams die werken aan complexe softwareprojecten, data-oplossingen en AI-first applicaties.

Je helpt teams om beter samen te werken, obstakels weg te nemen en continu te verbeteren. Je bent een stevige gesprekspartner voor de organisatie, developers, product owners en stakeholders en weet wanneer je moet coachen, uitdagen of juist ruimte moet geven.

Maar je kijkt ook vooruit.

Wat betekent AI voor de manier waarop teams software ontwikkelen? Hoe kunnen AI-developmenttools en agentic workflows bijdragen aan kwaliteit, snelheid en samenwerking? En hoe zorg je dat teams nieuwe technologie omarmen zonder hun focus op mensen en resultaat te verliezen?

Je hoeft niet zelf te programmeren, maar je bent nieuwsgierig naar technologie en begrijpt hoe veranderingen in software engineering invloed en impact hebben op de organisatie, teams en processen. 

Wat ga je doen? 

- Coachen van Agile-teams op focus, samenwerking, communicatie en voorspelbaarheid

- Faciliteren van Scrum-events die daadwerkelijk bijdragen aan verbetering

- Signaleren en wegnemen van blokkades binnen teams en binnen de organisatie

- Versterken van de samenwerking tussen developers, product owners, business en stakeholders.

- Meedenken over de inzet van AI-tools om teamprocessen, kennisdeling, delivery en adoptie slimmer te organiseren.

- Continu verbeteren van flow, kwaliteit en de manier waarop teams waarde leveren.

- Bijdragen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze Agile-werkwijze binnen een AI First-organisatie.

- Minimaal 7 jaar ervaring als Scrum Master binnen softwareontwikkeling.

- Ervaring met multidisciplinaire teams in complexe IT-omgevingen.

- Sterke kennis van Agile, Scrum en teamontwikkeling.

- PSM I en II, CSM- of vergelijkbare certificering.

- Interesse in AI, automatisering en de veranderende wereld van software engineering.

- Het vermogen om teams, product owners te coachen, stakeholders uit te dagen en verandering te begeleiden.

- Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in Nederlands en Engels.

- Ervaring met SAFe, LeSS of andere scaling frameworks is een pré.

Je hoeft geen AI-expert te zijn. We zoeken vooral iemand die nieuwsgierig is naar de impact van AI op samenwerking en softwareontwikkeling en teams daarin kan meenemen.

Het team 

Je komt terecht in een team van zo’n 25 gedreven medior en senior developers. We zijn groot genoeg om serieuze projecten neer te zetten en klein genoeg om elkaar te kennen. Iedereen heeft invloed en goede ideeën worden niet alleen gehoord, maar ook uitgeprobeerd.

We zetten onze development expertise in bij gerenommeerde bedrijven in Nederland. Daar bouwen we met Java en Kotlin aan oplossingen die ertoe doen, en we gebruiken AI om tot de best mogelijke resultaten te komen. We onderzoeken continu hoe AI ons werk en dat van onze klanten slimmer kan maken.

Ontwikkeling staat voorop. Tijdens onze kennisavonden delen we wat we leren en we bezoeken jaarlijks (inter)nationale conferenties om scherp te blijven. Daarnaast spreken we regelmatig af voor informele activiteiten, want goed samenwerken begint met elkaar écht kennen.

Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen. 

Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt.

We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief.

Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen.

AI First: samen bouwen aan de toekomst 

Bij adesso Nederland ontwikkelen we ons tot een AI First-organisatie. We geloven dat AI de manier waarop we software ontwikkelen, met data werken en klanten helpen fundamenteel verandert.

Daarom kijken we verder dan losse AI-experimenten. We bouwen aan slimme dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die écht onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen.

Dat betekent ook dat we onze eigen manier van werken blijven vernieuwen. We omarmen nieuwe technologie, maar blijven kritisch: niet alles hoeft met AI. De beste oplossing staat altijd voorop.

En misschien wel het belangrijkste: de mensen 

We houden van collega's die nieuwsgierig zijn, kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Mensen die goed zijn in hun vak, maar ook plezier hebben in samenwerken. Je krijgt bij ons vertrouwen, verantwoordelijkheid en de vrijheid om ideeën daadwerkelijk uit te voeren.

Wat krijg je van ons? 

- Een salaris van €4.500,- tot €5.750,- afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring;

- 8% vakantiegeld;

- Contract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week;

- Een leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding boven op je salaris;

- 27 vakantiedagen en 4 studiedagen;

- €3.600 persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget per jaar en ruimte voor certificeringen;

- Hybride werken met flexibele werktijden;

- Goede pensioenregeling;

- Doorgroeimogelijkheden;

- Internationale kennis en ontwikkelmogelijkheden, gecombineerd met een hecht Nederlands team.

title: Marketing & Communicatie Stage

description:
Who We Are 

Second Dinner is an award-winning independent game development studio that is here to make the most fun games in the world. Not super fun games. Not SUPER DUPER fun games. We mean the MOST fun games. In fact, our game MARVEL SNAP has earned multiple Mobile Game of the Year Awards (Game Awards , DICE ), Best Strategy Game (IGN) , and the Apple Design Award for Innovation !

Second Dinner is a remote-first studio, so while we are headquartered in Irvine, California, most of our team is fully remote across the United States. We want the most talented teammates wherever they call home. A diverse team with varied perspectives makes us a better company and will help us make better games. If you can bring something new to the table and expand our point of view, that's a huge upside.

Our Engineering Team: 

At Second Dinner, we believe that great people in a great work environment lead to great games and player experiences. In engineering, we empower our teams to build and innovate with best-in-class tools in novel ways. Our goal is to simplify game development and redefine what is possible in game development.

Your Role: 

You will own and drive Marvel Snap’s Test Automation initiative, as well as perform various DevOps duties. You will report to the Lead Engineer of the Live Stability team and collaborate with QA analysts, engineers, and artists to create test suites, build pipelines, and develop tools to ensure we deliver the highest quality games possible to our players! - 
As an automation superhero, you’ll identify, design, and deliver technical solutions (frameworks, tests, API hooks, tools) that increase test effectiveness, coverage, and overall development velocity

- 
Build and enhance continuous integration and delivery pipelines to support development teams across MARVEL SNAP

- 
Own the long-term development and roadmap of test automation

- 
Implement metrics, analyze test data to identify patterns, and report on risk status to help enhance software quality

- 
Optimize testing efforts and develop new opportunities using automation that will empower the QA team to be more effective and efficient

- 
Automate everything: from command lines to complex workflows, find opportunities to improve how we build and test the game, ultimately to improve the player experience

What You’ll Need: 

- 
Demonstrated ability designing and owning scalable automated testing solutions, including test frameworks, test infrastructure, and execution pipelines

- 
Proficiency in unit and integration test frameworks in C#/.NET or other object-oriented programming language

- 
Experience integrating test pipelines into CI/CD workflows such as GitHub Actions or Jenkins

- 
Knowledge of industry best testing practices, including unit, integration, end-to-end, acceptance, functional, and performance testing

- 
Ability to work independently, charting the course for the company in test automation

- 
Passion for empowering teams with best-in-class automated testing tools, frameworks, and test harnesses to improve operations

- 
An agile mindset, a desire for constant improvement of tooling, automation, and process to improve the quality of our products and the lives of our teammates

- 
High levels of empathy and support for team members, both technical and non-technical

- 
Passion for playing and making great games

Nice to Have, But Not Necessary: 

- 
Experience with test automation in Unity, such as Unity Test Runner

- 
Experience with mobile, web, or game automation frameworks such as Appium, Selenium, Playwright, or GameDriver

- 
Experience developing on-device automated test pipelines for either physical hardware devices or using platforms such as AWS Device Farm or Kobiton

- 
Experience with test case management systems such as TestRail or qTest

Individual pay within this range may span multiple levels within the discipline and is determined by assessed job-related skills, experience, relevant education, or training. title: Senior Software Engineer, Developer Enablement
description:
A little about us… Fleetio is a modern software platform that helps thousands of organizations worldwide manage their fleet operations. Transportation technology is a hot market, and we’re leading the charge with raving fans and new customers signing up every day. We raised $450M in our Series D funding round in March of 2025 and are on an exciting trajectory as a company. Fleetio is also a proud founding member of the Rails Foundation !

More about our team and company: 

- Fleetio overview video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YoXyXTFWbkg 

- Our careers page: https://www.fleetio.com/careers 

Description 

Fleetio is seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer to join our Developer Enablement team. The Developer Enablement team owns Fleetio’s public API, webhooks, Developer Portal, and the tools that let customers and partners build on Fleetio. You will be a key player in making our API reliable, well-documented, and easy to build on, so that customers and integration partners can connect, extend, and automate Fleetio on their own.

If you are passionate about leveraging technology to drive meaningful impact, excel in problem-solving, and possess a keen eye for developer experience, we encourage you to apply and join us in shaping the future of fleet management software.

More About Our Team and Company 

- Watch our culture videos: https://fleet.io/culture 

- Engineering culture, interview process and videos: https://www.fleetio.com/careers/engineering 

- Fleetio Go overview video: https://www.fleetio.com/go 

- More about the Fleetio platform: https://www.fleetio.com/features

Who You Are 

The ideal candidate for this role will demonstrate a strong proficiency in backend development and API design, with a proven track record of delivering high-quality software solutions. You are passionate about building APIs and developer tools with clean, consistent design and scalable architecture. You should be an effective communicator and be comfortable working in an asynchronous environment with your team. You are product-minded and team-oriented, willing to hear others' opinions and educate on best practices.

- You will improve the experience of developers who build on Fleetio through clear documentation, examples, sandbox environments, and tooling.

- You will help prepare our API for AI-driven use, so that AI assistants and agents can work with Fleetio data safely.

- You will help customers and integration partners succeed with our API, and take part in the team’s on-call rotation to keep our API, webhooks, and integrations reliable.

Your Experience 

- 5+ years experience with Ruby on Rails 

- 2+ years experience with ReactJS, Typescript

- Varied experience building full-stack web-based systems and features

- Experience designing, building, and maintaining public REST APIs, including authentication (such as OAuth), versioning, rate limiting, and documentation (such as OpenAPI)

- Experience with webhooks, event-driven systems, or third-party integrations

- Previous experience working closely with a product team to architect solutions

- Strong attention to detail in API design, consistency, and documentation

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills

- Experienced writing unit, integration, and API tests

- Experience with developer portals, SDKs, or AI tooling is a plus

- Be sure to mention “coffee” in your application so we know you actually read this

Benefits

- Professional development funds

- Mac laptop + new hire equipment stipend
