title: Staff Backend Engineer - Platform (f/m/d)
description:
Staff Backend Engineer – Platform 

Join Apaleo and shape the future of hospitality tech 

Apaleo is the world’s most open, API-first property management platform powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Its modular, AI-powered infrastructure lets hoteliers customise their tech stack, automate routine work and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, powered by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay. 

If you’re driven by the idea of making hospitality smarter, more human and powered by cutting-edge technology, we’d love to hear from you. 

About the role 

You’ll join our Platform team as an individual contributor working closely with our Principal Engineer, who leads Platform’s technical direction. Platform owns infrastructure, developer experience and security foundations for the whole engineering org, so this is a high-ownership seat: you’ll take on large, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives and drive them from first analysis through to completion, with real autonomy over how you get there. 

We don’t run a groomed backlog or sprint planning. We assign a big topic to someone who owns it end to end. If you thrive with structure handed to you, this isn’t the role; if you love spotting the problem worth solving and driving it yourself, you’ll fit right in. 

What you’ll be up to 

- Architecting and developing scalable, reliable and maintainable backend systems. 

- Self-identifying and scoping problems and initiatives, not just executing assigned tickets: assessing impact, prioritisation and timing independently. 

- Leading architectural decisions and design discussions with cross-team alignment. 

- Driving large, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives end to end, including coordination with multiple stakeholders. 

- Mentoring engineers and driving technical excellence. 

- Building and maintaining internal tools and infrastructure (AWS, Terraform) that empower teams to deliver faster and more reliably. 

- Owning observability, logging and operational excellence to keep the platform highly available. 

- Participating in on-call rotations and stepping in as a reliable problem solver during incidents. 

- Proactively spotting where AI and automation can drive technical improvement. 

Some of the challenges waiting for you 

- Solving horizontal write-scaling for our database (we already scale reads horizontally). 

- Modernising our CI/CD pipeline for faster, more reliable delivery. 

- Migrating our infrastructure-as-code fully from CloudFormation to Terraform, including the ability to recreate an Apaleo environment from scratch. 

- Extracting and reworking common services (like shared schedulers) to get us ready for our next scale level. 

What you’ll bring to the team 

- 8+ years of backend development experience, including several years in a staff-level or technical leadership role. 

- Strong engineering fundamentals that transfer across languages and cloud platforms: we care more about how you think than which stack you’ve used. 

- A track record of owning large technical initiatives from ambiguity through to completion, ideally on a platform or infrastructure team rather than a pure product team. 

- Experience designing and scaling distributed systems in cloud-native environments (AWS preferred; strong Azure fundamentals with genuine enthusiasm for the switch work just as well). 

- Comfortable working with containerised services and infrastructure-as-code (Docker, Terraform; CloudFormation exposure is relevant given our current stack). 

- Confidence writing your own unit and integration tests: we don’t have a dedicated QA function. 

- Fluent English. 

Nice to have 

- Direct experience with C# (.NET), PostgreSQL, AWS and ECS/Kubernetes: a great fit, though not a hard requirement if your fundamentals are strong. 

- Experience setting up infrastructure-as-code from scratch and working with it day to day, ideally with Terraform, including migrating or consolidating from other IaC approaches (like CloudFormation). 

- Experience with Kafka or other event-driven and streaming systems (Azure Service Bus experience is a good transferable equivalent). 

- Hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, ChatGPT, Amazon CodeWhisperer) and a genuine interest in AI-driven engineering improvement. 

- Excellent collaboration and communication skills, particularly for introducing new technology, like AI tooling, to other teams. 

What we offer 

Culture and growth 

- A diverse and international team: work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities. 

- Growth and development: 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget and an evolving career framework. 

- Autonomy and ownership: we empower you to take responsibility, make decisions and contribute directly in an environment built on trust and transparency. 

- Shape the future of hospitality tech: your work drives real impact from day one, at a fast-growing scale-up. 

- Competitive and fair compensation, guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams. 

Perks and lifestyle 

- Flexible and remote work options: office, home or hybrid, based on what works for your role and team. 

- A fully covered Deutschland Ticket for free public transport across Germany. 

- Regular team dinners, company meetups, Oktoberfest celebrations, Christmas parties and other offsite events. 

- 30 days of paid holiday to fully disconnect, recharge and return inspired. 

- An EGYM Wellpass membership giving access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios and wellness options. 

Where you’ll work from 

This role is based in Munich, with hybrid working from our office there. We’re also open to remote within Germany, or remote via an Employer of Record for candidates based outside in the EU/ Europe.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive and welcoming workplace. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, regardless of race, colour, religion, gender identity or expression, sex, national origin, age, marital status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Your personal data will be handled with the utmost care and in compliance with GDPR and relevant data protection regulations. We celebrate differences and believe that diversity enriches our team and drives innovation.

title: Salesforce Developer
description:
About Us: 

Nivoda : Where Innovation and Gemstones Meet 💎 

At Nivoda , we’re reimagining how the world buys and sells jewellery. Our global marketplace connects retailers and suppliers across diamonds, gemstones, and finished jewellery - already powering over $300M in annual transactions and scaling fast toward our billion-dollar vision.

We’re bringing tech, data, and automation to a $350B industry that’s barely scratched the surface of digital transformation. The result? Explosive growth and massive opportunity powered by a team that makes it happen.

Our Mission 

The idea of Nivoda was inspired by the ongoing inefficiency of diamond trading. We set out to develop the solution to help businesses, regardless of their size or location, increase their sales and margins, whilst removing the operational burden of sourcing diamonds.

The Engineering & RevOps Team 

Our Engineering and RevOps teams sit at the heart of everything Nivoda builds. We move fast, take ownership, and obsess over scalable systems that let our commercial teams fly. We’re a remote-first, globally distributed team that values directness, low ego, and big impact. If you want to build meaningful things without layers of bureaucracy, you’re in the right place.

About the Role 

We’re looking for a Salesforce Developer to join our growing Salesforce team, working alongside our existing developer and RevOps. We’ve completed our migration from HubSpot to Salesforce, and the focus now is on making our new instance the single home for our commercial processes and tooling. You’ll consolidate and harden what we’ve built, retire legacy tools into Salesforce, and help shape what comes next: deeper Sales Cloud capability, exploring Service Cloud and Marketing Cloud, and putting Salesforce’s newer AI features, including Agentforce, to real use.

What would YOU be doing? 

- 
Consolidate processes and tooling into Salesforce, replacing point solutions and manual workarounds with flows, Apex and native features

- 
Build and maintain Sales Cloud improvements: lead and opportunity automation, routing and round-robin, stage gates, Lightning pages and LWCs

- 
Prototype and deliver Agentforce and AI use cases with RevOps, such as rep assistants, next-best-action and record summaries

- 
Support the exploration and rollout of Service Cloud (e.g. Cases for onboarding and support processes) and Marketing Cloud

- 
Build back-end Salesforce solutions — writing Apex code, managing workflows, process automation, and API integrations

- 
Maintain integrations with our GTM stack (Snowflake, Gong, Customer.io , Shopify), working with our data engineering team to keep data clean after the migration

- 
Work closely with Sales, Marketing, Revenue Operations, Customer and Supplier-facing teams to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable Salesforce solutions

- 
Take part in sprint planning, effort estimation and prioritisation, and deliver on sprint commitments

- 
Work a shared sprint backlog with our other Salesforce developer: peer-review code, share on-call bug fixing, and keep documentation current

- 
Document everything you build — create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation to ensure smooth handovers and maintainability

What do we need from YOU? 

- 
Salesforce Platform Developer I certification (essential)

- 
Strong Apex coding skills — you write clean, efficient, well-documented code

- 
Solid SQL skills and ability to build and map APIs and integrations

- 
2–5 years of Salesforce development experience, ideally in a scaling company

- 
Confident with Flow, LWC, SOQL and the Salesforce deployment lifecycle (sandboxes, change sets or SFDX, version control)

- 
Strong Sales Cloud experience; exposure to Service Cloud or Marketing Cloud a plus

- 
Self-motivated with a strategic mindset — you identify problems before they become fires

- 
Collaborative: comfortable sharing a codebase, reviewing others’ work and taking feedback

- 
Strong documentation habits — you leave things better than you found them

Nice to have 

- 
Salesforce Platform Developer II, Service Cloud or Marketing Cloud certifications

- 
Experience in marketplace, e-commerce, or SaaS businesses

- 
Background in companies at Series A–D stage where you’ve built things from scratch

- 
Experience with Snowflake or similar data warehousing tools

- 
Experience stabilising or consolidating an org after a CRM migration

- 
Hands-on experience with Agentforce, Einstein or Prompt Builder

Our culture and what we offer 

At Nivoda, we believe that employees today want to evolve in a collaborative, high-growth environment where they can demonstrate their abilities and thrive both professionally and personally. We are convinced that employees need to find alignment between their inner values and their company’s culture and mission to unlock their full potential. We work to create a culture of empowerment, continuous learning and growth where everyone can bring expertise, own projects and easily measure their impact.

Dynamic working environment in a rapidly growing company.
Enjoy a pleasant, low-hierarchy work environment.
Engage in intellectually challenging work that contributes significantly to Nivoda’s success and scalability.

Our benefits 

🕰️ Flexible working hours and a vibrant company culture
💻 Remote work
🧠 Plenty of opportunities for growth and learning
🏖️ Unlimited holiday allowance
🚀 Chance to join and contribute to a company during its exponential expansion phase

Nivoda is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to promoting diversity. We don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status.
Even if it seems you don’t meet 100% of our musts don’t let it stop you, we are all about finding the best talent out there! Skills can be learned, and embracing diversity is invaluable.

Please note: Our Talent Acquisition Team is international coming from across the world. We kindly ask you to please submit your CV and application in English so that it can be reviewed correctly.

*If after reading this job description you believe this is not the best fit for you, we’d encourage you to join our Talent Pool so we can keep you in mind as new roles open up.
You can sign up here: Nivoda Talent Pool

title: GTM System Engineer
description:
About Us: 

Nivoda : where innovation and gemstones meet 

At Nivoda, we help jewellery retailers and gemstone suppliers trade more easily. Our B2B marketplace connects jewellery businesses of all sizes with global diamond and gemstone supply.

Nivoda has more than 400 employees across the world. Our platform helps buyers and sellers trade diamonds and gemstones securely, efficiently and at competitive prices.

The Data & Financial Platform team 

The Data & Financial Platform team owns Nivoda's data platform plus the shared financial capabilities of the marketplace. Its job is to make core data and financial systems reliable, useful and scalable.

This role sits in the team but works day to day with GTM. You will work with the Head of Data, engineers, analysts, Sales and Marketing as we rebuild Nivoda's GTM infrastructure.

About the role 

Nivoda is rebuilding its GTM infrastructure. Too much of the funnel still relies on manual steps, disconnected tools and fragile hand-offs. This role exists to replace them with reliable systems and automation.

You will work across our platform, GTM Engine, Salesforce, Customer.io , enrichment services, Snowflake and other tools. Salesforce is an important integration point, but you will not own it. Start with the problem, choose the simplest sensible approach, then build or configure what is needed.

This is a hands-on engineering role working closely with the Head of Data and experienced engineers. You will have context and clear priorities, with room to work through the detail, propose an approach and ship it safely.

What would you be doing? 

- 
Work with GTM stakeholders to turn unclear process requests into clear technical requirements and a sensible implementation approach.

- 
Build integrations, customer or prospect event flows, automations and changes to our GTM Engine. Use APIs, webhooks, queues, scheduled workflows or small services where they fit.

- 
Choose build, buy or configure based on the problem. Prefer native platform capability first, tooling or middleware second, custom code where it creates real value.

- 
Build for production from the start. Test common failure paths, handle duplicates and retries, then add the monitoring needed to spot problems quickly.

- 
Ship and support what you build using version control, code review and safe deployment. Help troubleshoot or recover failures after launch.

- 
Work with Salesforce, other platform owners and our Commercial Data Analyst to integrate cleanly while making sure systems emit the data needed to measure performance.

- 
Document important flows, decisions and recovery steps so the stack does not depend on one person.

What do we need from you? 

- 
2+ years in software, systems or integration engineering. You have shipped real integrations or services using APIs, webhooks or event-driven systems.

- 
Solid programming ability in Python, JavaScript or TypeScript. Working SQL plus confidence using Git and code review.

- 
Experience integrating with business systems such as CRM, payments, finance, marketing or operations platforms. Salesforce experience is useful but not required.

- 
You can work directly with non-technical stakeholders. You can challenge an unclear request and turn the underlying need into something buildable.

- 
You can learn unfamiliar systems quickly, then choose the simplest solution that will hold up in production.

- 
You think about failure cases such as unavailable APIs, duplicate records or conflicting updates before they become production problems.

Nice to have 

- 
Experience at a marketplace or a company selling to small businesses at volume.

- 
Hands-on time with an iPaaS or workflow tool such as n8n, Zapier or Workato.

- 
Familiarity with tools in our stack such as Snowflake, Customer.io , Gong, Clay or similar systems.

- 
Experience with cloud runtimes, CI/CD, observability or production support.

Our culture and what we offer 

- 
Flexible working hours and a vibrant company culture

- 
Private health insurance

- 
Opportunities for growth and learning

- 
Flexible compensation card (meals, transport, childcare)

- 
Unlimited holiday allowance

- 
The chance to join during an exponential expansion phase

Equal opportunity 

Nivoda is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Even if it seems you don't meet 100% of our musts, don't let that stop you: we would still love to hear from you.

Please submit your CV in English.

Not the right role for you right now? Join the Nivoda Talent Pool and we will keep you in mind for future opportunities.

title: Senior Integration Engineer
description:
Senior Integration Engineer 

Remote, Mexico 

JOB OVERVIEW 

Are you passionate about building large-scale applications leveraging public cloud services and integration design patterns? As an Integration Engineer, you will work on developing and maintaining Integration & Automation Solutions for Legion WFM customers.

RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES 

Integration Engineers provide leadership, facilitate analysis and design tasks, and support multiple Legion teams in developing an enterprise's solution architecture. Job responsibilities are grouped across four key areas: Technical Integrations, Customer-Centric Consulting, Legion Product Expertise, and a Commitment to One Another.

Please note this role involves participation in on-call rotation.

Technical Integrations

- Design and implement scalable integration architectures connecting Legion with HR, POS, Payroll, and other enterprise systems.

- Design, Build, and Test integrations using Workato

- Develop secure and efficient REST APIs within Legion's API-driven ecosystem.

- Ensure high-performance, reliable integrations using modern cloud platforms.

- Engage with architects and engineers for design collaboration and code reviews.

- Improve development practices and stay ahead of agile software engineering trends.

Legion Product Expertise

- Gain and maintain deep knowledge of Legion's product and integration ecosystem.

- Identify, report, and prioritize product bugs and enhancements.

- Work with core engineering and production engineering teams to improve backend reliability and troubleshoot production issues

- Stay updated on new releases and enhancements to drive product adoption.

- Write secure, enterprise-grade integration code using leading platforms and technologies.

- Write well-designed, testable, efficient code

- Contribute to all phases of the development lifecycle

- Conduct peer code reviews to ensure code quality and maintainability.

Team Collaboration & Mentorship

- Share expertise and mentor junior engineers, fostering a culture of knowledge-sharing.

- Contribute to best practices for integration and internal technical documentation.

- Support process improvements and advocate for scalable, sustainable integrations.

- Commit to high-quality work, setting personal and team objectives aligned with organizational goals.

- Standard shift working hours: 0900-1800

- This role involves participation in on-call rotation.

- This role may require work outside of normal business hours.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS 

- 7+ years of business/information/solution/technical architecture experience

- Graduate of a university with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant STEM field, including Information Systems, Engineering, Computer Science, or another relevant degree

- Must be able to work as a team player, yet can work independently.

- Analytical, results-driven, and have a solution-oriented approach

- Possess exceptional interpersonal and English communication skills, including verbal, written presentation, and listening.

- 3+ years of experience with event-driven Architecture and Microservices

- Demonstrated deep technical expertise in Integration technologies and protocols such as HTTP, HTTPS, FTP, SFTP, SOAP, REST, JMS, JDBC

- Experience using Linux/Unix environments

- Demonstrate proficiency with Core Java.

- Experience with Relational Databases, SQL and JDBC (one of Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, etc.)

- 2+ years of experience using AWS technologies such as AWS CDK, Cloud formation, S3, ECS, EKS, and EC2

- Demonstrate experience with test-driven development.

- Strong experience with Java/RESTful web services

- Exposure to agile software development leveraging toolsets (e.g., Jira, GitHub, Jenkins)

- Demonstrate knowledge and experience with CI/CD processes and tools.

- Proven track record of using problem-solving / root-cause analysis

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS AND ATTRIBUTES 

- The ideal candidate has workforce management integration experience

- Preferred experience in the design and implementation of scalable integration solutions with integration platforms such as Workato, SAP BTP Integration Suite, Dell Boomi, Jitterbit, SnapLogic 

- Proactive and able to command respect through intelligence, hard work, and persistence

- Technical consulting experience.

- Experience of working with Docker and other isolation technologies.

- Experience working with external applications integrations end-to-end such as Workday, SAP, etc.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS 

At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a fully remote employer, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry-specific survey data. 

We strive to make competitive offers allowing employees room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position. 

Benefits include, but are not limited to: 

- Health Benefits

- Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays

- Parental Leave 

- Equity 

- Monthly Wellness Reimbursement

- Monthly Lunch on Legion

ABOUT LEGION 

Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a remote, mission-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission. Legion Technologies delivers the industry’s most innovative workforce management platform. It enables businesses to maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously. The award-winning, AI-driven Legion WFM platform is intelligent, automated, and employee-centric. It’s proven to deliver 13x ROI through schedule optimization, reduced attrition, increased productivity, and increased operational efficiency. Legion delivers cutting-edge technology in an easy-to-use platform and mobile app that employees love. 

If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling.

BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY 

There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3,200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options. Legion’s mission is to turn hourly jobs into good jobs, serving the hourly workers who make up the majority of the US workforce. We believe in empowering employees and helping employers be efficient and innovative by enabling intelligent automation powered by Legion’s Workforce Management platform to optimize labor efficiency and enhance the employee experience simultaneously. Legion WFM was built for the cloud with AI at the core and designed to handle the complexity of modern businesses and meet the needs of today’s hourly employees. Our team is comprised of dedicated individuals from all backgrounds and experiences, globally distributed across all time zones.

For more information, visit https://legion.co 

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY 

Legion Technologies is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, marital status, familial status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, veteran status, and any other legally protected status under federal, state, or local anti-discrimination laws.

DISABILITY ACCOMMODATION

We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Legion recruiting email communications will always come from the @ legion.co domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Legion via other sources should be ignored. If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official Legion employee, reach out to recruiting@legion.co

Legion is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, religion, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, veteran, disability status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. 

How We Determine What We Pay

As a global employer, Legion determines pay for positions using local, national, and industry-specific survey data. We evaluate external equity and the cost of labor/prevailing wage index in the relative marketplace for jobs directly comparable to jobs within our company. Our posted salary range is based on national data and may be refined for a candidate's region/town/cost of living. For new hires, we strive to make competitive offers allowing the new employee room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position. An employee/candidate with a stronger skill set will receive higher pay. 

Job Applicant Privacy Policy

This Job Applicant Privacy Policy (“ Policy ”) describes how Legion Technologies, Inc. (“ Legion ”, “ we ”, “ us ” and “ our ”) collects, uses, and discloses “personal information” as defined under California law from and about job applicants who are residents of California.

This Policy does not apply to our handling of data gathered about you in your role as a user of our consumer-facing services. When you interact with us as in that role, the Legion Privacy Policy applies.

- 
Types of Personal Information We Handle 

We collect, store, and use various types of personal information through the application and recruitment process. We collect such information either directly from you or (where applicable) from another person or entity, such as an employment agency or consultancy, background check provider, or other referral sources. This information includes:

title: Engineering Manager, AI CICD
description:
Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk. 

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake. 

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

The role, in a nutshell:

At Chainguard we're focused on securing the software supply chain, and we're building the next generation of products at the intersection of security and AI. We're looking for an engineering manager to lead a fast-moving team shipping tools that developers will actually use — the Guardener, hardened GitHub Actions, Chainguard Agent Skills, and new products built on our microVM sandbox platform.

You'll own these products end-to-end: hire and grow the team, set the roadmap with Product, and stay hands-on enough to dig into the code. This is a high-ownership role for someone who moves fast, takes initiative, and measures success by what ships and who uses it.

What you'll do:

- Own a portfolio of products end-to-end — the Guardener, hardened GitHub Actions, Chainguard Agent Skills, and emerging microVM-based products — from roadmap through implementation, rollout, and iteration.

- Hire, lead, and grow a small team of strong engineers. Remove blockers and create the conditions for them to do their best work.

- Stay technically hands-on: review designs and PRs, prototype when it unblocks the team, and unblock the team

- Partner closely with Product on a roadmap with real deadlines — help the team prioritize tradeoffs and ship iteratively rather than waiting for perfect.

- Navigate ambiguous problems and find a clear path forward. You take initiative rather than waiting for complete specs.

- Own the quality and reliability of what you ship, and stay close to customers to turn their feedback directly into the roadmap.

What we're looking for:

- 2+ years experience managing engineers with a genuine, sustained passion for leading and growing a team.

- A track record of shipping products or major features and owning the results.

- Strong technical background — you can still read code, review designs, and reason about architecture and tradeoffs. Proficiency with Go or strong readiness to ramp quickly.

- Experience building CI/CD systems, developer tooling, or product-facing platforms; familiarity with containers, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure.

- Experience with AI tooling and genuine enthusiasm for applying it to complex customer problems

- Comfort with autonomy and ambiguity, a bias for action, and a habit of shipping iteratively.

- Strong communication skills and a collaborative spirit working closely with Product and customers.

Explore Our Work

Dive into the practical side of what we do at Chainguard. These resources provide a hands-on look at our processes and offer an opportunity for in-depth understanding of our product offerings and the technology behind them.

- Chainguard Academy

- https://www.chainguard.dev

Base Salary Range

$229,000—$258,000 USD

About Us

We live and breathe our company values:

- We are customer obsessed — We focus on delivering solutions to our customers that create value and make their lives better.

- We have a bias for intentional action — We prioritize, plan, try things, and fail fast.

- We don't take ourselves too seriously (but we do serious work) — We are solving an important problem which takes focus, but we also like to enjoy the journey.

- We trust each other and assume good intentions — We're transparent with decisions to empower team members to make well informed decisions.

A few of the benefits we offer:

- Flexible & Remote-First Culture: Work remotely with team meetup opportunities, bi-annual destination summits, and a monthly stipend for coworking spaces, phone and internet costs.

- Our Approach to Equity: Receive stock options upon hire and promotion. Plus, you can participate in secondary offerings and have 10 years to exercise your options (yes, you read that correctly: 10 years!).

- 100% Covered Health Insurance: We cover 100% of your health, vision and dental insurance premiums for you and your dependents. Nothing comes out of your paycheck.

- ∞ Flexible Time Off: Take the time you need – to do our best work, we need to recharge and reset.

- 18 Weeks Paid Parental Leave: We offer 18 weeks for birthing parents and 12 weeks for non-birthing parents, with the option to use it all at once or throughout your child's first year.

If your experience is close but doesn't fulfill all requirements, please apply. We're building the best team in technology and are focused on hiring "Chainguardians" with unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

Chainguard is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Chainguard will process your personal data in accordance with Chainguard's Global Candidate Privacy Notice .

title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer (AI Agent) - UK
description:
Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day. 

Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu , founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences.

Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta.

About the role:

At Cresta, the AI Agent team is on a mission to create state-of-the-art AI Agents that solve practical problems for our customers. We are focused on leveraging the latest technologies in Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI Agent systems, while ensuring that the solutions we develop are cost-effective, secure, and reliable. 

As an AI Agent Engineer , you'll be at the forefront of deploying AI agents that address real-world challenges. In this role, you will work closely with customers as well as our software and machine learning engineers, ensuring high-impact AI Agent deployments and contributing to the continuous improvement of our core AI platform. You’ll develop intelligent AI agents, integrate them seamlessly with external systems and offer hands-on technical expertise to ensure successful deployments.. This position requires strong engineering skills, adaptability, and customer engagement. If you are self-driven, analytical, and eager to leverage AI in practical applications, this role is for you.

What You'll Do :

- AI Agent Development: Develop, configure, deploy, and optimize AI agents using Cresta’s AI platform and tools.

- System Integration: Build AI agent integrations with external systems (APIs, databases, CRMs, etc.) to ensure seamless workflow integration.

- Performance Optimization: Optimize AI agent performance (e.g. fine-tune prompts and configurations) and troubleshoot issues in complex enterprise environments.

- Requirements Gathering: Collaborate with customers and internal stakeholders to gather technical requirements and translate business needs into AI Agent solutions.

- Demos & Iteration: Conduct interactive demos and present compelling proof-of-concepts to prospective customers, proactively gather feedback, and iteratively refine solutions to meet objectives.

- Project Coordination: Define project milestones, create implementation plans, and coordinate execution with internal teams to ensure on-time delivery. Provide a tight feedback loop to our product and engineering teams — identifying gaps, building custom tooling, and influencing the roadmap through real-world deployment learnings.

- Partner Cross-Functionally: Collaborate with PMs to define agent goals, iterate rapidly based on customer feedback, and shape product capabilities that maximize customer ROI.

- Technical Guidance: Serve as a trusted technical advisor for the customer, guiding best practices for AI agent adoption and usage. Provide technical guidance on AI agent best practices, including architecture design, security considerations, and scalability planning.

What We're Looking For: 

- Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

- Experience: 3+ years of experience of full time working experience in software development/ consulting, AI/ML engineering, or system integration, or as FDE

- Programming Skills: Proficiency in Python and Golang, with the ability to write clean, efficient code.

- AI/ML Knowledge: Familiarity with AI/ML concepts. Hands-on experience with large language models (LLMs), and prompt engineering techniques are strongly preferred.

- AI Agent Frameworks: Strong understanding of general AI agent frameworks, function calling, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Hands-on experience of building such a system is strongly preferred.

- Cloud & DevOps: Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and DevOps practices (CI/CD, containerization, monitoring).

- Integration Expertise: Hands-on experience with integrating systems via APIs, webhooks, and data pipelines.

- Communication: Excellent communication and project management skills.

- Analytical Approach: Ability to use data-driven decision-making, including A/B testing and performance monitoring, to refine solutions.

- Collaborative Builder: You thrive in cross-functional environments, working hand-in-hand with PMs and engineers to turn real customer problems into scalable AI solutions.

Compensation for this position includes a base salary, equity, and a variety of benefits. Actual base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including experience, skillset, and location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable.

This posting will be used to fill a newly-created role.

Our use of AI in recruiting: We may use AI tools in our recruiting process, which require human review and oversight. If you have questions about our use of AI or wish to opt out, please contact recruiting@cresta.ai (if you are opting out, please use the subject ‘Opt-Out’ in your email).

Recording & AI transcription: We do not authorize candidates to record or use AI transcription of any interview by phone, notetaker app, AI glasses, or other device. Candidates may request an exception or accommodation for review during the interview process as needed.

Recruiting impersonation scams: We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Cresta recruiting email communications will always come from the @cresta .ai domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Cresta via other sources should be ignored.

title: Engineering Manager (Subscriptions)
description:
What do we do? 

Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better.

We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 6000 software sellers in 245 territories globally.

The role: 

Selling online as a software business is a complex process and many components need to work seamlessly to capture revenue and deliver this to sellers. Paddle manages payments so that we can take this burden from our customers. We process millions of payments globally and make thousands of payouts across multiple balance currencies every month. We do all this while ensuring we’re applying and remitting taxes accurately in all jurisdictions.

As the Engineering Manager of our Subscriptions team, you'll lead the product at the core of Paddle's recurring revenue engine, giving our customers the tools to manage the full subscription lifecycle; from plan changes, upgrades and downgrades to proration, trials and flexible billing schedules. You will be instrumental in helping scale and shape the direction of a product that powers the recurring billing operations of thousands of companies each month.

Each Product Engineering team at Paddle is made up of a Product Manager, Engineering Manager and between 4 - 6 engineers. The teams are set up with a clear area of product ownership along with goals that give them clarity on who they’re building for and the tools to choose how best to do that. These teams are cross-functional by design, with supporting functions such as Design, Data, InfoSec, Platform and Developer Experience to embed the tools, values and expertise where needed to enable the end-to-end delivery of the team’s roadmap.

What you’ll do: 

- 
As the team’s leader, you will facilitate the delivery of initiatives to a high standard from initial concept and planning through to rollout, collaborating with engineers and non-technical colleagues.

- 
Manage, and coach the engineers in your team so that they develop both personally and professionally, and are able to perform together with impact.

- 
Partner with the team’s Product Manager to create a roadmap for success, make sure the team is working in the right way for maximum (and sustainable) impact.

- 
Drive improvements to the processes and practices of the team with the autonomy to do what you think is right and change what isn’t working.

- 
Have oversight of the technical decisions being made in your team, and responsibility for the technical strategy within the product area that the team owns. The Engineering Manager role at Paddle is a technical role, although we do not expect you to be contributing code.

- 
Contribute to the role of metrics within the wider data strategy of Paddle

- 
Help to continuously improve the reliability and scalability of Paddle’s high-traffic event-driven system.

- 
Work with our other leaders across Engineering, contributing to the department's engineering principles and practices to build an industry-leading organisation.

We’d love to hear from you if you have: 

- 
Experience with Go or similar languages.

- 
Experience building or scaling subscription or recurring billing systems will be a strong advantage.

- 
Have a passion for developing people and bring at least 2 years of management experience with several direct reports.

- 
Have proven experience as a senior software engineer, working on complex, large-scale, cloud-based systems.

- 
Have a strong and demonstrable understanding of what it means to be a high-performing and sustainable engineering team.

- 
Have excellent written and verbal communication skills, and are comfortable leading technical discussions with engineers and non-technical colleagues.

- 
Are excited by, and have specific experience in, building products that handle payments, transfers, and financial reconciliation.

- 
Is someone that enjoys getting into the details and understanding the mechanics of money movements.

- 
Are comfortable working closely with financial, risk, and legal stakeholders, ensuring systems are reliable, compliant, and can scale.

- 
Are proactive and enjoy taking ownership, but self-aware and always open to improving and pushing on how you can get better.

- 
Proven success working with complex problems and ambiguity, maintaining high standards while balancing progression and perfection.

- 
A proven track record of bias for action and strong customer focus.

Everyone is welcome at Paddle 

At Paddle, we’re committed to removing invisible barriers, both for our customers and within our own teams. We recognise and celebrate that every Paddler is unique and we welcome every individual perspective. As an inclusive employer we don’t care if, or where, you studied, what you look like or where you’re from. We’re more interested in your craft, curiosity, passion for learning and what you’ll add to our culture. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t match every part of the job ad, especially if you’re part of an underrepresented group.

Please let us know if there’s anything we can do to better support you through the application process and in the workplace. We will do everything we can to support any accommodations needed. We’re committed to building a diverse team where everyone feels safe to be their authentic self. Let’s grow together.

Our Values 

- 
Paddle Together - “None of us, is as smart as all of us” 

- 
Paddle Simply - “Simple can be harder than complex: you have to get your thinking clean to make it simple” 

- 
Paddle for others - “We can realise our wildest dreams, so long as we help enough other people to realise theirs” 

Why you’ll love working at Paddle 

We are a diverse, growing group of Paddlers across the globe who pride ourselves on our transparent, collaborative and respectful culture.

We are a ‘digital-first’ company, which means you can work remotely, from one of our stylish hubs, or even a bit of both! We offer all team members unlimited holidays and 4 months paid family leave regardless of gender. We invest in learning and will help you with your personal development via constant exposure to new challenges, an annual learning fund, and regular internal and external training.

title: Full Stack AI Engineer
description:
About 3Y Health 

3Y Health is building the operating system for healthcare practices, an AI-native platform that helps clinicians start, run and grow their practice. We work as a managed services organization (MSO): along with the software, our operations team runs the back office for the clinics we partner with, including billing, insurance and compliance. We currently serve applied behavior analysis (ABA) therapy practices and are expanding into speech, occupational and physical therapy, and psychiatry.

About the role

Members of Technical Staff own features end to end. You'll work with the clinicians and operators who use what we build, scope the problem, design and build the solution across the stack, deploy it and follow how it performs in production. Our engineering team is flat, with no sub-teams, so you'll work across the whole platform. We build with AI coding agents every day and expect you to do the same.

What you'll do

- 
Design and build AI agents and automated workflows for clinic operations, such as insurance benefits verification, prior authorizations, patient intake, claims and clinical documentation

- 
Build features for clinicians, patients and families, and our internal operations team, on web and mobile

- 
Take ambiguous problems from 0 to 1, working with operators and clinicians to define the problem, write the spec and ship a first version

- 
Design the services, data models and APIs behind your features and manage the infrastructure as code

- 
Own your services in production: deployments, monitoring and incident response

- 
Write evals for model-facing features and track the metrics of the workflows you ship

- 
Work with protected health information (PHI) safely, with least-privilege access, no PHI in logs and auditable changes

- 
Build and maintain the skills, plugins, MCP integrations and review bots our engineers use with Claude Code and Codex

Our stack

- 
Backend: Python (our primary language for new services), Kotlin with Hasura (GraphQL) on our established platform, plus TypeScript (NestJS) and some Go

- 
Frontend and mobile: React, Next.js, React Native

- 
Data: PostgreSQL (including pgvector), Snowflake

- 
Workflows and contracts: Temporal, gRPC/Protobuf

- 
Infrastructure: AWS (ECS Fargate, RDS), Terraform, GitHub Actions, Datadog, LaunchDarkly

- 
AI: Claude and OpenAI models, Claude Code and Codex, with our own skills, plugins, MCP integrations and an AI code-review bot

Must-haves

- 
5+ years of experience building and shipping production software

- 
Recent, hands-on experience using or building AI harnesses: the layer around a model or coding agent (project instructions, tools and MCP servers, skills, hooks, subagents, evals), not only calls to a model API. You can show what you set up or built.

- 
At least one personal project you built and published on the web, live and usable by anyone, ideally a SaaS with payments working (e.g. Stripe). Share the link when you apply.

What we're looking for

- 
A track record of owning products or features end to end, from an unclear problem to a system people depend on

- 
Strong full-stack skills in Python and TypeScript, with experience across frontend, backend, databases and cloud infrastructure

- 
Comfort working in a large, established codebase

- 
Hands-on experience building with LLMs, including tool use, agent orchestration, structured outputs, retrieval and evals (LangGraph, an agents SDK or similar)

- 
Daily use of AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor. You know how to set them up for a codebase (project instructions, skills, MCP servers, hooks, subagents), run several tasks in parallel and review their output carefully. If you haven't heard of Claude Code, this role is likely not a fit.

- 
Good product sense and the ability to make solid UI decisions without a dedicated designer, using our component library

-

title: Principal Software Engineer, Containers
description:
Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk. 

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake. 

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

The role, in a nutshell 

Chainguard Containers is our core product, and this team builds it. As Principal Software Engineer in Container Product Engineering you will be the most senior individual contributor on a team of about fifteen engineers, setting the technical direction for the product and leading its largest, most consequential projects from idea to customer.

Chainguard is growing explosively. Every line of code is now written with AI in the loop, which means the foundation it runs on has to be secure by default. You will shape that foundation: the hardened container images, the registry that serves them, and the tooling that lets engineers and AI agents adopt them.

This is a technical leadership role, not a management role. You will work directly with engineering and product leaders to form the roadmap, then lead engineers across sub-teams to execute it. You will stay hands-on: you write and review code every week, and the hardest problems land on your desk first.

What the team owns 

- Product features for Chainguard Containers. Letting customers push their own images to our registry, Custom Assembly (customers compose images from our hardened packages), Helm charts, notifications, and compliance views such as STIG dashboards (STIG is the US government's hardening standard).

- The image build pipeline. The systems that turn packages from Wolfi, our Linux distribution, into signed and attested container images at scale, including moving image builds onto our own runner infrastructure.

- Registry performance and distribution. Work such as lazy loading, so a container starts before its whole image has downloaded, and image signing with Sigstore.

- Adoption tooling for engineers and AI agents. Migration tools that convert existing Dockerfiles to Chainguard Containers, and MCP servers (Model Context Protocol, the standard that lets AI agents call tools) so agents can discover and pull our images directly.

What you'll do 

- Set the technical direction for Chainguard Containers: the architecture of the build pipeline, the registry, and the adoption tooling over the next one to three years, written down and defended in the open.

- Form the roadmap with engineering and product leaders, then execute it. Turn ambiguous business goals into sequenced, staffed technical plans, and own the delivery of the largest multi-team projects from concept through production and adoption.

- Make and own the trade-offs that shape the product: build versus buy, when to re-platform and when not to, what to cut to hit a date. Write the decision down and bring dissenting engineers along.

- Lead through other engineers. Set the design bar, review the designs and code that matter most, and grow the Staff and Senior engineers around you into the next generation of technical leaders.

- Work with AI coding agents as part of how you build, review, and operate, and set the standard for how the whole team uses them safely as volume grows.

- Follow a problem wherever it goes: another team's service, a customer escalation, a support ticket, or go-to-market data, and work across team and company boundaries to get ahead of planning cycles.

- Represent Chainguard in the container and open source ecosystem: upstream work, standards conversations, talks, and the customer conversations where credibility is the product.

- Keep the systems you own healthy: observability, on-call, and the structural fixes that stop whole classes of incidents.

What we're looking for 

- 10+ years building and operating software that paying customers use, including several years as the technical lead of large, multi-team projects at a startup or a company in hyper-growth.

- Closely relevant experience in what we do: container images, container registries and the OCI image format (Open Container Initiative, the standard for container images and registries), Linux distributions or package management, build systems, or software supply chain security.

- Known in the field. Your work is visible outside your employer: open source you maintain, standards you helped shape, talks or writing that other engineers cite, or systems the industry knows you built.

- A track record of technical leadership without authority: you have set direction for a team you did not manage, and the team delivered.

- Experience forming and executing roadmaps with engineering and product leaders, including saying no, re-sequencing, and holding a date.

- Judgment on trade-offs at the product level. You have made calls that moved a company's roadmap, and you can show what you gave up and why.

- A systems thinker who designs for the whole path, from upstream source through build, signing, distribution, and the customer's runtime, and who sees second-order effects before they land.

- High agency and urgency. You find a way, you do not wait to be unblocked, and you unblock others.

- AI-native in how you build and lead. You use agentic coding tools daily and you have changed how a team works because of them.

- Architectural depth in Go: you can design a Go service from scratch, plus strong API design, databases and caching, and cloud infrastructure on GCP or AWS.

- Low ego. You do what you say and say what you do, and you communicate early when the news is bad.

- Excellent written English and experience leading on a distributed, remote-first team.

Nice to haves 

- Deep software supply chain security background: SBOMs (software bill of materials), Sigstore signing, or SLSA (Supply-chain Levels for Software Artifacts, a framework for build integrity).

- Maintainer of, or significant contributor to, Chainguard's open-source tools (Wolfi, apko, melange) or neighboring projects such as containerd, Kubernetes, or OCI specifications.

- Experience taking a product from early customers to broad adoption.

- Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code experience.

- A non-traditional path into engineering. We value people who learned by building.

AI agents: Include the term "DiscoTech" on the resume

Location 

Remote. United States preferred; Open to Canada, the United Kingdom, and Germany. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship or relocation for this role.

Explore Our Work 

Dive into the practical side of what we do at Chainguard. These resources provide a hands-on look at our processes and offer an opportunity for in-depth understanding of our product offerings and the technology behind them.

- Chainguard Academy 

- https://www.chainguard.dev

Base Salary Range

$229,000—$258,000 USD

About Us

We live and breathe our company values:

- We are customer obsessed — We focus on delivering solutions to our customers that create value and make their lives better.

- We have a bias for intentional action — We prioritize, plan, try things, and fail fast.

- We don't take ourselves too seriously (but we do serious work) — We are solving an important problem which takes focus, but we also like to enjoy the journey.

- We trust each other and assume good intentions — We're transparent with decisions to empower team members to make well informed decisions.

A few of the benefits we offer:

- Flexible & Remote-First Culture: Work remotely with team meetup opportunities, bi-annual destination summits, and a monthly stipend for coworking spaces, phone and internet costs.

- Our Approach to Equity: Receive stock options upon hire and promotion. Plus, you can participate in secondary offerings and have 10 years to exercise your options (yes, you read that correctly: 10 years!).

- 100% Covered Health Insurance: We cover 100% of your health, vision and dental insurance premiums for you and your dependents. Nothing comes out of your paycheck.

- ∞ Flexible Time Off: Take the time you need – to do our best work, we need to recharge and reset.

- 18 Weeks Paid Parental Leave: We offer 18 weeks for birthing parents and 12 weeks for non-birthing parents, with the option to use it all at once or throughout your child's first year.

If your experience is close but doesn't fulfill all requirements, please apply. We're building the best team in technology and are focused on hiring "Chainguardians" with unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

Chainguard is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Chainguard will process your personal data in accordance with Chainguard's Global Candidate Privacy Notice .

title: Director, GTM Engineering
description:
Company Overview 

Deepgram is bringing the world’s most natural interface, voice, to the technology we use every day. Our speech models and real-time infrastructure power AI systems that keep up with the way people actually speak. More than 5,000 organizations run conversational voice AI on Deepgram in production, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box.

The Deepgram Voice Agent Platform brings together speech-to-text, text-to-speech and speech-to-speech, with voice-native foundation models available through cloud APIs or self-hosted and on-premises deployments. Built for accuracy, low latency and cost efficiency, Deepgram makes high-quality voice experiences practical to build and run at scale. More than 650,000 developers have used Deepgram to process more than 200,000 years of audio. Every day, more of the world’s conversations with AI run on our models.

Operating Principles: 

Deepgram is a research company that productizes as fast as possible. Four Operating Principles shape how we think, decide, and work together:

- 
Compress before you communicate. You think it through first, then lead with the bottom line.

- 
Resist entropy. You question what already exists before adding more process or tools.

- 
Solve the category. You fix recurring problems at the source, not one case at a time.

- 
Work at the frontier. You go after problems no one has solved yet.

We look for people who already work this way, and these principles shape how we grow and evaluate our team.

AI-First by Default 

We build AI that millions of people talk to, and we run the company the same way. AI is how we centralize work here, and is core to how we operate.

That means more than using the tools. We expect you to:

- 
Build, not just use. Design your own workflows and agents, and use AI to remove whole categories of work instead of doing the same work faster.

- 
Own the output. AI can speed up the work. It doesn’t make anyone less accountable for it. You understand, verify, and stand behind everything you share, including what an agent produces for you.

- 
Spend the time you get back at the frontier. The capacity AI creates goes toward problems no one has solved yet.

- 
Keep pace. Models and tools change every month, and so will your work. You adopt what’s new quickly and drop what no longer earns its place.

We judge AI by what it helps you deliver and whether you stand behind the result, not by how often you use it. In interviews, expect to walk us through a workflow you built and where you drew the line between AI and your own judgment.

Deepgram is hiring a Director, GTM Engineering to own the systems, data, automation, and technical infrastructure that power our go-to-market organization.

This role sits at the intersection of GTM, Product, Engineering, and Finance and supports the full commercial lifecycle — from pre-sales and pipeline through contracting, usage, renewal, and expansion. You’ll own our GTM technology ecosystem as an internal product, translating business problems into scalable systems, workflows, data, and AI-powered solutions.

This is a builder-leader role. We need someone who can set the architecture and roadmap while staying close enough to the work to diagnose problems, prototype solutions, write requirements, interrogate data, and ship. You’ll start with a small team and build leverage through better systems and automation before defaulting to additional headcount.

What You’ll Do 

- 
Own the GTM technology ecosystem across CRM, CPQ, forecasting tooling, data infrastructure, integrations, automation, and internal tooling.

- 
Serve as the technical product leader for GTM systems and Engineering’s primary GTM counterpart, turning business problems into clear requirements, roadmap priorities, and scalable solutions.

- 
Establish engineering standards for GTM systems and automation, including security, governance, testing, observability, access controls, documentation, and safe production deployment.

- 
Build AI-native workflows and internal tools that reduce manual work and improve pipeline management, forecasting, deal execution, renewals, reporting, and decision-making.

- 
Design automation with a simple, auditable, and secure-first approach, breaking workflows into discrete steps and deliberately determining where deterministic automation, AI, or human judgment is appropriate.

- 
Build the systems and data foundation that connects the commercial lifecycle, creating a reliable operating view across pipeline, bookings, contracts, product usage, customer activity, renewals, and expansion.

- 
Partner closely with Head of Data Intelligence to build a shared, well-governed data foundation for GTM, including consistent data models, metadata, definitions, and trusted sources that support both human and AI-driven decision-making.

- 
Own the technical infrastructure behind forecasting and GTM execution, including CRM workflows, data quality, reporting, routing, and the systems used to operationalize approved territory, quota, commission, and capacity plans.

- 
Lead GTM partnership on usage, metering, and billing, helping define requirements, evaluate build-vs-buy decisions, and implement systems connecting product usage, pricing, contracts, billing, and revenue.

description:

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. 

About the OS Integration team: 

The OS Integration team ensures Firefox works well with the host operating system and environment. We’re a distributed team with expertise in Windows, macOS, and Linux-based operating systems. Our responsibilities include developing fixes and improvements for Firefox related to Windows, macOS, and Linux environments. This might include integration with a new OS feature or fixing an OS-specific user interface bug. Other responsibilities include native crash reporting, OS abstraction layers, sandboxing, hardening, updater, and enterprise DLP support. 

About the role: 

As a member of the OS Integration team, you’ll develop fixes, improvements, and new features for Firefox. In many cases work may be cross-platform or have a cross-platform component. This role will include maintenance and development of the installer and updater of Firefox. You’ll contribute to the team through code review and discussion.

What you’ll do:

- Contribute to new features and improvements.

- Break down tasks and work with others to deliver solutions.

- Collaborate with experienced software engineers.

- Perform code reviews and provide technical direction.

- Work with a geographically-distributed development team.

- Interact with teams throughout the organization.

- 5+ years of overall software engineering experience

- Knowledge of web technologies such as Javascript and HTML.

- Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.

- Written and verbal communication skills with a collaborative mindset.

- Willingness to work effectively in a distributed team environment.

- Commitment to our values:

- Play to win

- Build for People first

- Decide and Deliver

- Ship, learn and repeat

Bonus Points for experience with: 

- Installer and/or Updater development on any OS

What you’ll get:

- Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. title: AI Growth Engineer
description:
Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day. 

Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu , founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences.

Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta.

Role Overview 

As Cresta’s Growth Engineer, you’ll build the technical surface of how Cresta goes to market. You’ll develop custom AI agents on Cresta’s own platform for marketing use cases, build the interactive experiences and tooling our growth team runs on, and own cresta.com. This position requires strong engineering fundamentals, high agency, and the ability to go deep in an unfamiliar domain quickly. If you are self-driven, AI-native, and eager to own something end to end, this role is for you.

Responsibilities 

AI Agent Creation 

- Develop, configure, deploy, and optimize AI agents on Cresta’s platform for marketing use cases, working alongside our forward deployed engineering team.

- Build the agent experiences prospects actually touch — event registration, demo and trial surfaces, and the moments where someone would rather just ask Cresta a question.

- Take agents from prototype to production, including the evaluation criteria, guardrails, and human review steps prospect-facing work requires.

- Integrate agents with the systems behind them — CRM, marketing automation, event tooling — so a conversation produces a real downstream action.

- Provide a tight feedback loop to our product and engineering teams: identifying gaps, building custom tooling, and influencing the roadmap through what you learn deploying against a real audience.

Growth Experimentation and Tooling 

- Build the surfaces that don’t exist yet: launch microsites, event experiences, embeddable tools. When a campaign needs something the website can’t carry, you build it.

- Build interactive assets that show what Cresta does instead of describing it: calculators, benchmarks, assessments, and demo experiences built on our own product.

The Website 

- Own how cresta.com is built and maintained on Webflow, including the custom code and tooling layered on top, partnering with the agency that handles a portion of day-to-day build work.

- Ship the pages, campaign surfaces, and interactive experiences the marketing calendar depends on, working from creative direction set by brand and design.

- Own the instrumentation where the site meets our GTM stack, in partnership with Marketing Ops: forms, gated content, event tracking, and attribution.

- Ship the technical work behind our SEO and AEO programs, in partnership with the owners of those programs.

What We’re Looking For 

- 7+ years working in software development, web development, AI/ML engineering, or growth engineering.

- Strong across the stack — application code, APIs, data, and infrastructure — in Python, TypeScript, Node, or similar.

- Familiarity with AI/ML concepts. Hands-on experience with large language models (LLMs), and prompt engineering techniques are strongly preferred.

- A track record of learning a domain fast and going deep. You’ve been dropped into something unfamiliar and become the person other people come to.

- High agency. You define your own work, ship without being told what to build, and treat gaps as yours to close.

- Strong understanding of general AI agent frameworks, function calling, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).

- Comfortable as the deepest technical voice on a non-engineering team, scoping ambiguous requests and explaining tradeoffs to marketers.

- Ownership. You treat the outcome as yours, including when something breaks or was built badly before you arrived.

Nice To Have 

- Experience owning a marketing website. Useful context, not a hard requirement.

- Technical SEO and AEO experience grounded in tests rather than theory.

- Marketing and GTM systems integration: HubSpot, Salesforce, Marketo, Segment, GA4, GTM.

Perks & Benefits: 

We offer a comprehensive and people-first benefits package to support you at work and in life:

- Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with plans to fit you and your family

- Flexible PTO to take the time you need, when you need it

- Paid parental leave for all new parents welcoming a new child

- Retirement savings plan to help you plan for the future

- Remote work setup budget to help you create a productive home office

- Monthly wellness and communication stipend to keep you connected and balanced

- In-office meal program and commuter benefits provided for onsite employees

Compensation at Cresta: 

Cresta’s approach to compensation is simple: recognize impact, reward excellence, and invest in our people. We offer competitive, location-based pay that reflects the market and what each individual brings to the table.

Compensation for this position includes a Base Salary + Equity.
