High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- 
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- 
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

- 
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- 
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

- 
Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- 
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- 
Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- 
Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- 
Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- 
Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role 

We are looking for back-end engineers to expand the functionality of our system. There is flexibility in staffing engineers on projects across the company, depending on the project, your specific responsibilities might include: 

- 
Building and maintaining our platform on top of our cutting-edge voice models, which are used by millions of users.

- 
Improving our existing products to ensure that they’re intuitive, powerful and make innovative use of our research team’s latest break-throughs. This could involve adding significant functionality, or building integrations with other common consumer/enterprise solutions.

- 
Maintaining and strengthening our internal infrastructure as we scale and grow to ensure that our products remain live, performant and secure.

- 
Collaborating closely with engineers and others from the Frontend, Growth and Sales teams to understand, and design solutions for our customers.

Requirements 

We do not require any formal experience, certifications, or degrees. Instead, we are seeking enthusiastic software engineers who can showcase solving impressively hard problems with artifacts such as past projects, or GitHub contributions. We do require:

- 
Expertise in Python.

- 
A strong background in backend development.

- 
Familiarity with common software and system design patterns and infrastructure including APIs, cloud infrastructure tools, storage solutions, data structures etc.

- 
Knowledge about test design and security fundamentals.

- 
Bonus:

- 
Experience with Kubernetes.

- 
Experience with Stripe or other payment processing providers.

- 
Basics about how AI models work.

Location 

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Core Team)
description:
About the Role 


We’re looking for a Senior Backend Developer who thrives in a deeply hands-on environment and enjoys being close to the code on a daily basis. This role is heavily focused on building, optimising, and scaling backend services in a high-load system where performance and reliability are critical.


You’ll be working on complex, real-time challenges at the core of our platform - improving latency, ensuring high availability, and making systems more efficient at scale. This is not a coordination-heavy role; it’s for someone who enjoys writing production code, solving tough engineering problems, and seeing the direct impact of their work.


If you’re product-driven, take ownership, and prefer a “build first, improve fast” approach while working on systems where every millisecond matters - this role will feel like home.


Key Responsibilities 



- 
Work as part of a cross-functional team owning a core product within the platform




- 
Design, build, and deliver new backend features end-to-end in a distributed environment




- 
Write high-quality, production-level code daily, contributing directly to a high-load, scalable system




- 
Take ownership of services handling financial transactions at scale, with a strong focus on reliability and accuracy




- 
Proactively suggest and implement improvements in architecture, processes, and development practices




- 
Participate in code and architectural reviews to maintain high engineering standards




- 
Solve complex business and technical challenges with pragmatic, efficient solutions




- 
Participating in on-call rotations within the squad to ensure the reliability and availability of our systems




- 
Play an active role in ongoing tech transformation initiatives across the platform




- 
Collaborate closely with engineers, product, and other stakeholders to deliver impactful solutions used by millions globally





Requirements 



- 
Solid experience with Node.js/TypeScript is ideal, but we also welcome experts in other OOP languages such as Java, Python, C++, C#, or Go




- 
Strong understanding of asynchronous programming techniques




- 
Deep production experience with Kafka: confident reasoning about consumer-group rebalances and their impact on in-flight processing, offset-commit strategies under retries and duplicate delivery, and the limits of "exactly-once" semantics




- 
Experience designing idempotent, retry-safe handlers for at-least-once pipelines: transactional outbox, idempotency keys, and deduplication




- 
Experience building services with gRPC or similar RPC frameworks




- 
Strong knowledge of relational databases such as MySQL or PostgreSQL, plus production experience with at least one NoSQL technology at scale, such as DynamoDB, MongoDB, or Redis




- 
Hands-on experience running services on Kubernetes and AWS/GCP: deployment, autoscaling, resource limits, and production debugging




- 
Production operations experience: on-call ownership of a high-load system, including incident response, impact assessment, root-cause analysis, and post-incident improvements





Nice to Have 



- 
Experience with ClickHouse or other columnar/analytical databases




- 
Experience with multi-region / failover architectures: data replication, regional isolation, and graceful degradation




- 
Practical use of AI coding agents such as Cursor or Claude Code as part of daily development: effective prompting, reviewing, and validating AI-generated code




- 
Understanding of application security and industry best practices




- 
Gambling domain experience





What We Offer 



- 
Competitive Salary




- 
Quarterly Bonuses




- 
Unlimited Paid Time Off




- 
Unlimited Paid Sick Leave




- 
Remote & Flexible Working




- 
Private Medical Insurance




- 
Financial Support for Life Events




- 
Professional Development Budget




- 
International Exposure




- 
Regular Company Events





*Benefits may vary depending on location and contractual agreement 


Recruitment process 


1. HR interview (30-45mins)


2. Interview with a Hiring Manager (45mins)


3. Technical interview with live coding (90mins)


4. Final Interview with C-level (60 mins)


By submitting your application, you acknowledge that your personal data will be processed in accordance with our Privacy Policy .

Why Reka?

An Elite Team : Collaborate with top-tier engineers, researchers, operators from renowned organizations like Google DeepMind and Facebook AI Research (FAIR) and successful startups, driving innovation in cutting-edge AI technology.

title: Fullstack Software Engineer - Core
description:

In a single environment, teams design and operate analytics, machine learning, and AI agents with the transparency, collaboration, and control enterprises require. Sitting above data platforms, cloud infrastructure, and AI services, Dataiku connects the full enterprise AI stack - empowering organizations to run AI across multi-vendor environments with centralized governance.

The world’s leading companies rely on Dataiku to operationalize AI and run it as a true business performance engine delivering measurable value. For more, visit the Dataiku blog , LinkedIn , X , and YouTube .

Why Engineering at Dataiku? 

Dataiku’s on-premise, cloud, or SaaS-deployed platform connects many data science technologies, and our technology stack reflects our commitment to quality and innovation. We integrate the best of data and AI tech, selecting tools that truly enhance our product. From the latest LLMs to our dedication to open source communities, you'll work with a dynamic range of technologies and contribute to the collective knowledge of global tech innovators. You can find out even more about working in Engineering at Dataiku by taking a look here .

Here are some useful links so you preview what we do at Dataiku: Dataiku's Key Capabilities ; Dataiku's Github , you can also take a look at the Gallery , a public instance showcasing some example projects (note editing is very limited and will be regularly reset). 

Our product is called Dataiku DSS which stands for Dataiku Data Science Studio. If you’d like to know more about it, you can watch the demo here or try the free version here .

How you’ll make an impact 

As a Fullstack Engineer, you’ll contribute to building Dataiku DSS core features by joining one of the following themes:

- Data Preparation : Develop tools for data integration, transformation, and cataloging, as well as Jupyter notebooks, SQL workbenches, and APIs.

- Add new capabilities for data integration, transformation, and visualization using LLMs

- Optimize workflows for large-scale datasets and improve database support

- Strengthen developer tools like Jupyter notebooks and SQL workbenches

- Tech stack: Java, Python, AngularJS, Angular

- AI & Machine Learning : Collaborate on next-gen AI features, from statistics and time series forecasting to LLM inference.

- Build next-generation features like cross-provider LLM APIs or integration with the latest Machine Learning models

- Collaborate with research teams on innovative machine learning experiments

- Tech stack: Python, scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Java, Angular, AngularJS

- Data Consumption: build the experience that makes data accessible and actionable for everyone.

- Enhance our collaborative Workspaces to organize and explore charts, dashboards, datasets and more

- Create innovative interfaces that answer business questions and surface relevant insights using LLMs

- Tech stack: Angular, AngularJS, Java, Python

- Data Visualization : elevate our data visualization capabilities with high-performance charting tools and dashboards.

- Develop new chart types and optimize visualization performance

- Enhance dash boarding capabilities to deliver fast and flexible experiences

- Tech stack: React, AngularJS, Angular, D3.js, ECharts, Node.js, Java, Spring

- MLOps : Develop back-end capabilities for automating and monitoring ML model lifecycles while supporting cross-functional collaboration.

- Build tools to automate retraining, monitoring, and deployment of ML models

- Enhance collaboration features for ML stakeholders

- Tech stack: Python, Java, Angular, Angular.JS, Kubernetes, Docker

- Platform : Focus on scaling and securing the platform while improving cloud integrations and supporting a wide array of data sources and engines.

- Optimize processing engines for scalability and latency

- Expand capabilities to support new databases and cloud platforms

- Tech stack: Java, Python, Angular, Kubernetes, Spark, AWS, Azure, GCP

- AI Governance : Build features for AI compliance, connecting disparate systems and simplifying governance processes.

- Develop customizable platforms for managing AI compliance and governance

- Simplify policy enforcement and integration across disparate systems

- Tech stack: Java, Angular, PostgreSQL

What you need to be successful 

- We’re stack agnostic, so all you need is a significant experience in software engineering, building a real product

- We’re hiring at all levels (junior, mid, senior)

- A passion for combining backend performance with exceptional frontend user experience.

- You want to work in a fast-paced, high-growth environment that values diversity of talent, excellence of product, and exciting engineering challenges at scale

What does the hiring process look like? 

- Initial call with a member of our Technical Recruiting team (45min)

- Video call with an Engineering Team Lead (1h30)

- Technical Assessment to show your skills (Home Test or Live Coding)

- Final Interviews with our VPs of Engineering (2h) #LI-Remote

What are you waiting for! 

At Dataiku, you'll be part of a journey to shape the ever-evolving world of AI. We're not just building a product; we're crafting the future of AI. If you're ready to make a significant impact in a company that values innovation, collaboration, and your personal growth, we can't wait to welcome you to Dataiku! And if you’d like to learn even more about working here, you can visit our Dataiku LinkedIn page .

If you need assistance or an accommodation, please contact us at: reasonable-accommodations@dataiku.com

title: Devices & IOT Field Engineering Manager
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring an Embedded Linux Field Engineering Manager to lead a regionally-focused team of Field engineers in Presales and Professional Services activities, by helping customers with solution architecture, design and delivery.

Our Embedded mission is to enable companies to make fleets of very secure connected devices. Canonical provides Ubuntu, Ubuntu Core and a unique Long Term Support, with secure update and management mechanisms. Our customers create mission-critical control systems, gateways and appliances that need to meet stringent quality and security requirements, and we aspire to bring this level of security to the wider consumer electronics and device market.

Our Field Engineers are thought leaders helping our customers through their journey toward a more secure and durable solution.. They are accomplished technologists that take a hands-on approach to embedded Linux strategy and delivery. They have a passion to help customers achieve ambitious technical and business goals, and to show how the Canonical approach to open source and connected devices brings best-of-breed thinking to the emerging field of edge compute. They also care to develop their colleagues, helping them deepen their understanding of the technology, their ability to manage time, and their awareness of customer business thinking for continuous improvement and personal development.

This career opportunity requires a unique blend of skills. Successful candidates will know Linux well, understand how a distribution works, what are the unique challenges of Internet Of Things, and will also carry team building and management skills. They also enjoy the pace of change and diversity of client engagements with driven and ambitious technology entrepreneurs. Competitive, business-focused technologists at heart, they are also team drivers that take pride in team and company wins.

Location: This is a globally remote role, running a team in one of three Geos, Americas, EMEA or APAC. You will therefore need to be located in one of those three Geos to manage that specific team that spans few timezones from you

The role entails 


- Leading and developing a team of Field engineers, ranging from graduate to senior, in the areas of Presales and Professional Services

- Planning and driving progress on agreed goals and projects

- Partnering with the leadership team

- Developing and championing engineering excellence and organisational practices

- Coaching, mentoring, and offering career development feedback

- Solving customer problems by promoting our technologies and being a trusted advisor

- Working remotely in a single major time zone

- Identifying and measuring team health indicators

- Implementing disciplined engineering processes

- Representing your team and product to stakeholders, partners, and customers 

- Providing market feedback to Product and Engineering teams, and being a critical part of Ubuntu’s future

What we are looking for in you 


- Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university

- Undergraduate degree in in Computer Science or or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path

- Extensive embedded Linux experience - Yocto or other

- Extensive Linux experience - Debian or Ubuntu preferred

- Ability to manage a small team

- Experience with customer engagements

- Professional written and spoken English

- Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability

- Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments 

- An ability to communicate the business benefits of technology

- An humble learner and quick study

- Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long

- Other desirable traits include RTOS experience, additional languages (both the programming and human kinds), and previous experience working in a remote-first, diverse, distributed company.

What we offer colleagues 

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.


- Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

- Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year

- Annual compensation review

- Recognition rewards

- Annual holiday leave

- Maternity and paternity leave

- Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform

- Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues

- Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical 

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer 

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Senior Salesforce Platform Engineer
description:
Amplitude is the leading AI analytics platform, helping over 5,200 customers—including Atlassian, Burger King, NBCUniversal, and Square—build better products and digital experiences. With powerful AI Agents embedded across our platform, teams can analyze, test, and optimize user experiences faster than ever. Ranked #1 across multiple categories in G2’s Winter 2026 Report, Amplitude is the best-in-class solution for product, data, and marketing teams. Learn more at amplitude.com .

As an organization, we deliver for our customers by living our values. We operate from a place of humility, take ownership of problems and successes, approach challenges with a growth mindset, and put our customers at the center of everything we do.

Amplitude is looking for a Senior Salesforce Platform Engineer to support the scaling and ongoing evolution of our go-to-market (GTM) systems. You'll own end-to-end visibility into our Salesforce platform, from day-to-day configuration and support to long-term architecture and improvement. 

As part of our GTM Engineering team, you’ll partner with Sales, GTM Operations, Finance, Product & Engineering, and GTM leadership to deliver well-governed solutions across Salesforce and connected platforms like CPQ, NetSuite, Amplitude, and Snowflake.

Respond to reactive CPQ questions independently

What You'll Bring

- 
Hands-on experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud and a functional understanding of CPQ, pricing rules, and the quote-to-contract-to-order handoff

- 
Hands-on experience writing and maintaining Apex (triggers, classes, batch/schedulable jobs), with the ability to read, troubleshoot, and safely extend existing code

Foundational knowledge of other Salesforce development concepts (Visualforce, Lightning Web Components, SOQL/SOSL, platform limits)

Experience integrating Salesforce with third-party tools via native connectors, managed packages, or integration platforms

- 
Strong customer service orientation, with a genuine desire to help users work through problems

Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Administration, or related field (or equivalent practical experience)

Nice to Have

Salesforce certifications such as CPQ Specialist, CPQ and Billing Consultant Accredited Professional, or Platform Developer I/II

- 
Experience supporting Salesforce at a global, publicly traded company under SOX compliance

- 
Experience with Salesforce CI/CD and release automation (e.g. Copado, GitHub) across sandboxes and production

- 
Proven ability to lead Salesforce initiatives end to end, from solution design through release management and post-deployment support

Why This Role

You'll be a key contributor to the systems that power Amplitude's revenue engine, with direct ownership over the stability and scalability of our Salesforce ecosystem. This role offers the chance to work across a modern GTM tech stack and partner closely with stakeholders across the business, all while growing your technical depth in CPQ and quote-to-cash architecture.

title: Project Lion - Senior Prompt Engineer - Spain (Remote, Part-Time)
description:
We are seeking a Prompt Engineer to be responsible for the end-to-end technical migration workflow for transitioning templates to LLM autoraters. The role is required to use client’s internal tools to leverage prompt engineering techniques to maximize model performance. 

Responsibilities: 

- 
Utilize Automatic Prompt Generation (APG) tools to create baseline prompts for complex parent-child template clusters. 

- 
Run and supervise Automated Prompt Optimization (APO) tool, review the outputs, and flag when the APO reaches deadlocks or plateaus.   

- 
Manually draft, test, and refine prompts to navigate complex template architectures, overcome anti-patterns, and handle edge cases where tooling is lacking or broken. Solve edge-case scenarios by designing and refining manual prompts. 

- 
Monitor shadowbot runs to ensure sufficient disagreements (between human and LLM ratings) are registered, generated, and tracked.   

- 
Run prompt versions against established gold data to continuously measure autorater quality against the human crowd baseline, calculating accuracy metrics such as F1 scores, precision, and recall.   

- 
Draft technical launch readiness justifications (Launch Certification Documentation) for final. 

Requirement: 

- 
Language Skills : Native fluency in Spanish and fluent in English. 

- 
Location: Must be based in Spain.

- 
Education : Bachelor’s, Master’s, or Doctorate degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Computational Linguistics, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Cognitive Science, or a related analytical field.  

- 
Prompt Engineering & AI Expertise : At least 4 years' experience as Prompt Engineer. Proven experience tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) for strict, structured outputs, complex classification tasks, and familiarity with chain-of-thought and few-shot learning.  

- 
Data Analysis : Strong proficiency in identifying error patterns, analyzing model performance, and using SQL or other data analytics tools.  

- 
Technical Agility : Ability to quickly learn and master proprietary tools with minimal supervision.  

- 
Communication : Excellent verbal and written communication skills.  

Optional / Preferred Skills:  

- 
Familiarity with enterprise-grade LLM interfaces like the Goose API.  

- 
Experience in AI model evaluation, data science, computational linguistics, or software engineering.  

- 
Hands-on experience with Automated Prompt Optimization (APO) systems or tuning workflows.  

- 
Linguistic expertise, including an understanding of semantics and logic.  

Compensation

Työskentely tapahtuu pääasiassa suomeksi, mutta englannin kielen osaamisesta on etua tehtävässä. Katsomme eduksesi myös kokemuksen Mepco-järjestelmistä. Hoivatiimi ja sen esihenkilö työskentelevät pääasiallisesti Oulussa, mutta sinä voit työskennellä myös etänä toiselta paikkakunnalta.

Miksi valitsisit meidät? 

Vaikka etsimme itsenäistä, oma-aloitteista ja vastuullista ihmistä, saat seuraksesi parhaat työkaverit ja heidän tukensa. Tiimisi auttaa sinua matkan varrella ja luo yhteenkuuluvuuden tunnetta. Yhteishenki onkin yksi tärkeimmistä voimavaroistamme ja arjessamme on tilaa naurulle sekä rennolle, positiiviselle hengelle.  Talenom ille jokainen on myös tervetullut omana itsenään.  

Meille henkilökohtainen kehitys on strateginen valinta. Tarjoamme monenlaisia koulutuksia, joiden avulla voit viedä osaamisesi seuraavalle tasolle. Jotta kehitys on mahdollista myös käytännössä, huolehdimme myös työntekijöidemme hyvinvoinnista ja jaksamisesta. Voit tutustua palkanlaskentaamme tarkemminurasivuillamme.

Liity joukkoomme ja nouse kanssamme palkkahallinnon huipulle! 

Tehtävän palkkahaitari on 2300–3450 euroa määräytyen tehtävään valittujen aiemman kokemuksen sekä osaamisen perusteella. Hakuaika päättyy 29.11.2026, mutta haastattelut voidaan osittain aloittaa jo hakuaikana. Työn aloitusajankohta sovitaan valitun henkilön kanssa, mutta toivomme että pystyt aloittamaan tammikuun aikana. 

Jäikö jokin vielä askarruttamaan? Voit olla yhteydessä Hanna-Leena Lauroseen, p. 0207 52 5164, tai Tiia-Maria Kreiviin, p. 0293 722131

Tehtävään valittavalta henkilöltä tarkastetaan luottotiedot. 

Tietoa meistä 

Talenom on ketterä taloushallinnon palvelutalo sekä yksi Suomen suurimmista tilitoimistoista. Mikä on salaisuutemme? Talenom ilaiset ovat oman alansa ammattilaisia, tekijöistä parhaimpia. Meidät tunnetaan aktiivisesta otteestamme sekä ainutlaatuisesta palveluvalikoimastamme. Meillä on myös maan parhaimmat asiakkaat, joille voimme tarjota markkinoiden edistyksellisimpiä taloushallinnon ratkaisuja.

Työntekijät ovat meidän tärkein voimavaramme ja yksi tärkeimmistä tavoitteistamme on työntekijöiden hyvinvointi. Haluamme jatkuvasti kehittää toimintatapojamme saavuttaaksemme luottamuksen, ylpeyden ja yhteishengen työntekijöiden keskuudessa. Meille on myös myönnetty Great Place to Work –sertifikaatti osoituksena hyvästä työpaikasta ja suomalaisen työelämän suunnannäyttämisestä.

Cytovale is a leading innovator in early sepsis detection, revolutionizing emergency care with its advanced IntelliSep technology. This system provides rapid, actionable insights into a patient's likelihood of having or developing sepsis through a quick 8-minute blood test. IntelliSep's unique capability to assess immune dysregulation enhances the triage and treatment of sepsis, promoting patient-centered care, operational efficiencies, and provider satisfaction. Cytovale is committed to successful implementation, clinical adoption, and continual improvement of healthcare outcomes.

Position Overview: 
The Customer Success Executive (CSE) plays a critical leadership role in leading enterprise implementations of IntelliSep across health systems. As the overall implementation leader and program owner, the CSE orchestrates cross-functional implementation activities, drives implementation governance, aligns customer and internal stakeholders, manages implementation risks, and maintains accountability for successful implementation outcomes.

The CSE provides implementation leadership by orchestrating cross-functional execution across Medical Affairs, Field Application Scientists, Data Science, Sales, Customer Service, and other internal functions. While accountable for overall implementation success, the CSE leverages the expertise of functional teams responsible for technical, clinical, operational, and commercial execution within their respective areas of ownership.

- Develop executive working relationships with executive sponsors, laboratory leadership, clinical stakeholders, information technology teams, and operational leaders

- Lead executive communications, governance meetings, implementation updates, risk discussions, and customer business reviews.

- Develop an understanding of each customer's organizational priorities, success metrics, workflows, and strategic initiatives

- Balance customer priorities with Cytovale implementation best practices

Customer Success & Outcome Achievement

- Lead recurring customer governance meetings, KPI reviews, executive business reviews, and success planning sessions

- Coordinate with Medical Affairs, Data Science, and other functional teams to review implementation progress, adoption trends, customer feedback, and opportunities for continuous improvement

- Lead executive-level customer escalations by coordinating cross-functional response plans, maintaining proactive executive communication, and ensuring timely resolution of implementation issues

- Capture customer feedback, identify implementation trends, and drive continuous improvements to implementation processes and the overall customer experience

Minimum Qualifications 
- Bachelor's degree in healthcare, life sciences, nursing, business, engineering or a related field.

- Minimum of 10 years of experience leading enterprise healthcare technology implementations, implementation program management, customer success, clinical operations, laboratory operations, or other customer-facing leadership roles

- Demonstrated success implementing complex medical technologies within acute care hospitals or integrated delivery networks

- Proven experience leading enterprise implementations involving executive, laboratory, clinical, operational, and information technology stakeholders across multiple concurrent workstreams

- Exceptional presentation, communication, executive facilitation, stakeholder management and influence skills

- Strong enterprise implementation program management, organizational, governance, and problem-solving abilities, including experience developing integrated implementation project plans, managing critical path activities, facilitating governance meetings, tracking action items, and leading multiple complex customer implementations simultaneously

- Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional implementation programs through influence rather than direct authority in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office with the ability to independently develop executive presentations, implementation project plans, dashboards, implementation documentation, and customer-facing materials

Preferred Qualifications 
- Experience leading enterprise implementation programs involving multiple concurrent workstreams, executive governance, organizational change management, and cross-functional stakeholder alignment

- Demonstrated ability to build credibility and influence executive, clinical, laboratory, operational, and information technology stakeholders across complex healthcare organizations

- Frontline experience in clinical care, healthcare technology, or hospital operations, with an understanding of how new technologies are implemented and adopted within hospital environments

- Familiarity with laboratory operations, emergency department workflows, clinical implementation, healthcare information technology, and regulated healthcare environments

- Experience interpreting operational or clinical data to measure adoption, program success, and organizational outcomes

- Experience leading executive business reviews, customer governance meetings, and executive implementation reviews

This position requires some travel, approximately 10-20%, including travel to customer sites throughout implementation, post-live optimization, executive business reviews, and strategic customer engagements.

Location 
This is a remote, field-based position.

Competitive salary and benefits package, commensurate with experience. Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Finance & Accounting Lead - Business Central Setup, AI Agents & Latvian Tax
description:
Location: Fully remote 
Company: Latvia-based startup 
Compensation: We operate on a startup budget. Compensation will be discussed transparently during the hiring process and paid monthly in USD. 
Engagement type: Full-time
Working hours: Flexible

About Us

We are a Latvia-based startup building a finance function that combines accurate accounting, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central and practical AI automation.

We are looking for a finance professional who can personally manage our accounting, configure the systems supporting it and use AI agents to carry out the work more efficiently.

Job Description

You will personally perform and take ownership of our accounting and financial operations, using AI agents to support your work. Your responsibilities will cover daily bookkeeping, reconciliations, closing, financial reporting, cash planning and applicable Latvian tax reporting.

You will personally carry out the complete migration from QuickBooks to Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, using AI agents to support your work. You will be responsible for all implementation tasks, from planning and data preparation through configuration, import, validation and go-live. No external implementation partners will be involved. As part of preparing and importing the data, you will review the complete accounting records for the past five years, identify gaps and errors, and reconcile the migrated data to the source records. You must be comfortable both doing the accounting and setting up the accounting system.

AI agents will assist with document processing, transaction preparation, matching, reconciliation and reporting. You will define their tasks, supervise their execution, investigate exceptions and verify their outputs. You remain responsible for the accuracy and completeness of the work.

Key Responsibilities

- Perform day-to-day bookkeeping, accounts payable and receivable, invoicing, expense accounting and bank reconciliations.

- Complete month-end and year-end closing, balance sheet reconciliations, accruals and supporting documentation.

- Set up, configure and maintain Business Central, including the chart of accounts, posting groups, dimensions, VAT setup, bank accounts, accounting periods and relevant financial workflows.

- Personally execute the complete migration from QuickBooks to Business Central, including data extraction, account and tax mapping, cleansing, system configuration, trial imports, reconciliation and go-live. Review all accounting records for the past five years during migration preparation and import, investigate missing or incorrect entries, document corrections and preserve supporting documents and a traceable audit trail.

- Prepare and manage applicable Latvian tax and statutory reporting, including VAT, corporate income tax, payroll-related obligations and VID/EDS processes.

- Handle international customers, suppliers, contractors, foreign currencies and cross-border transactions.

Poste

Souhaitez-vous faire partie d’une équipe qui a à cœur de renforcer et de soutenir la profession de consultant en immigration et en citoyenneté? Le ou la titulaire du poste fournit de l’assistance juridique et administrative afin de soutenir le fonctionnement des comités du Tribunal. Cela comprend la surveillance et le respect des échéanciers, l’établissement de rapports, la gestion et la distribution de dossiers liés aux cas aux fins de préparation aux audiences ou aux procédures des comités du Tribunal.

- Fournir une aide juridique et administrative afin de soutenir le fonctionnement des comités du Tribunal.

- Délicatesse et discrétion afin de travailler sur des affaires confidentielles et de nature sensible.

Formation et expérience requises

As a Freelance Marketo Email Specialist, you'll build, test, and launch email programs in Marketo for a range of client brands. This is a hands-on, execution-only contract role with no leadership or management responsibilities. You'll take approved briefs and turn them into working programs, building responsive templates and modules, setting up smart lists and flows, and making sure every send goes out right the first time. You know Marketo well enough to spot a broken token, a misfired trigger, or a segmentation gap before it reaches a subscriber. You'll take direction from our internal team, get up to speed fast, and deliver accurate builds on schedule with minimal oversight.

Key Responsibilities 

- Build and launch email programs in Marketo, including one-off sends, nurture streams, engagement programs, and triggered campaigns.

- Set up smart lists, smart campaigns, flow steps, and segmentations that match the targeting and logic in the brief.

- Use tokens, dynamic content, and snippets to personalize emails and keep programs easy to clone and reuse.

- QA every email before launch: rendering across clients and devices (e.g. Litmus or Email on Acid), links, tokens, personalization fallbacks, and list logic.

- Manage program structure, naming conventions, and folder organization so client instances stay clean and easy to navigate.

- Build to the brief and requirements provided, and flag any gaps or errors in the request before they become problems in the send.

- Communicate status, timelines, and blockers clearly with your internal point of contact.

- Document builds and processes so other team members can pick up, update, or reuse the work.

- Follow established Marketo, deliverability, and accessibility standards on every build.

Qualifications

- Strong working knowledge of Marketo programs, smart lists, smart campaigns, tokens, snippets, and dynamic content.

- Proficiency in HTML and CSS for email, including responsive and hybrid coding and Marketo template syntax.

- Experience with email rendering and QA tools such as Litmus or Email on Acid.

- A detail-oriented QA process that catches errors in logic, links, and personalization before launch.

- Experience working across multiple clients or Marketo instances, adapting quickly to different setups and conventions.

- Clear, proactive communication, including flagging risks early and giving accurate time estimates.

- Ability to work independently, take direction well, and hit deadlines across overlapping requests.

Preferred 

- Marketo Certified Expert or Marketo Certified Associate.

- Familiarity with email deliverability, authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), and list hygiene.

- Experience with email accessibility standards (e.g. WCAG).

- Experience with lead scoring, lifecycle programs, and Marketo–Salesforce CRM sync.

- Experience with other marketing automation platforms (e.g. Salesforce Marketing Cloud, HubSpot, Braze).

- Agency or consulting experience.

Why Current 

At Current, we believe the best digital work happens when strategy, design, production, and technology operate as one team. We partner with ambitious brands to create digital experiences that are thoughtful, scalable, and built to drive real impact.

We're a remote-first agency with teams across the US, working collaboratively across websites, platforms, campaigns, CRM ecosystems, and digital product experiences. Our environment is fast-paced, highly collaborative, and built for people who enjoy solving complex technical challenges alongside smart, supportive teammates.

You'll have the opportunity to work across a variety of clients and technologies, and contribute to meaningful digital experiences within a growing agency environment.

This is a freelance, contract engagement. The target hourly rate for this role is $50 - $70 per hour. Actual rate is influenced by a wide array of factors, including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location.

title: Director, AI-Enabled Fraud Prevention & Investigations
description:
Headquarters: Remote - USA

Clover Health is investing in our fraud detection and investigation capabilities and is seeking a Director, AI-Enabled Fraud Prevention & Investigations to join our Legal department as a senior individual contributor. This hybrid role combines: (1) managing hands-on investigations of potential provider fraud with (2) building AI-powered tools and processes to make investigations more efficient and help catch potential future fraud earlier. You will develop and pilot new AI-enabled investigatory processes for Clover’s Medicare Advantage business, and own resulting investigations, in collaboration with Clover’s Special Investigations Unit (SIU) and other stakeholders.

This is a non-attorney role. You will work hand-in-hand with Clover’s lawyers and SIU to ensure that new investigatory processes you develop, and the resulting investigations, comply with Clover policies and regulatory requirements. Success in this role requires someone sharp, creative, and technically hands-on—someone who does not just use existing analytics tools but builds their own. That might mean writing a script to automate repetitive work, pulling apart a dataset when a standard report falls short, or working with an LLM until it produces something genuinely useful—all with the goal of finding smarter, more effective ways to investigate potential provider fraud.

As a Director, AI-Enabled Fraud Prevention & Investigations, you will: 

- Build Your Own Investigative Tooling: Use AI to write the queries, scripts, and prompts that turn millions of claim lines and/or medical record data into a prioritized list of leads. Prototype detection logic yourself rather than waiting on a roadmap, and hand off what works to data science and engineering to productionize. We expect you to be the person who builds v1.

- Investigate Potential Fraud End-to-End With AI in the Loop: Own a portfolio of fraud investigations sourced using the tooling you develop, in collaboration with Clover’s SIU. Develop investigative plans, gather and analyze evidence (including claims data and medical records), and reach well-supported conclusions. Use LLMs and analytics to compress the parts of an investigation that have always been slow — reading unstructured data, triaging grievance narratives, and sizing exposure.

- Diagnose complex failures: Lead root-cause analysis across client/server, protocol, network, authentication, metadata, and distributed-system boundaries using logs, telemetry, profiles, benchmarks, and production evidence.

- Build compatibility and reliability: Maintain API and protocol stability; create automated compatibility, interoperability, performance, scale, reliability, observability, and diagnostics coverage; and define practical migration paths for supported and legacy clients.

- Collaborate and influence: Partner with Product, Query Execution, QA, Support, SRE, Documentation, and external technology partners to resolve dependencies and improve certification, customer experience, and supportability.

- Raise the engineering bar: Participate actively in code and design reviews, mentor and coach engineers, improve team practices, and contribute to relevant upstream open-source projects when aligned with Dremio priorities.

- Use AI-assisted development tools responsibly: Apply Dremio-approved AI tools to code comprehension, debugging, test generation, and documentation while protecting proprietary and customer data and validating results through review, testing, and sound engineering judgment.

What we're looking for 

- Staff-level ownership: 8+ years of production software engineering experience, or equivalent depth demonstrated through sustained ownership of complex systems and multiple substantial team-area features.

- Programming expertise: Deep proficiency in Java, C++, Rust, Go, or another systems or services language, with the ability to work effectively in adjacent languages and frameworks.

- Connectivity and systems depth: Experience designing and debugging APIs, protocols, client libraries, drivers, or distributed services, with strong knowledge of data structures, concurrency, asynchronous programming, networking, and failure handling.

- Problem-solving ability: Able to identify and solve non-obvious problems across client/server and distributed-system boundaries and turn findings into durable fixes and regression coverage.

- Quality mindset: Experience building comprehensive unit, integration, compatibility, performance, or reliability tests and working with production CI/CD, packaging, release, certification, and engineering quality controls.

- Communication and influence: Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical trade-offs, surface risks early, align contributors across teams, and influence without formal authority.

- Mentorship: Demonstrated ability to mentor and coach engineers and improve the effectiveness and engineering practices of the team around you.

- Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Advanced degrees and equivalent industry experience are welcomed.

Bonus points if you have 

- Experience developing JDBC, ODBC, ADBC, or other database drivers.

- Experience with Apache Arrow or Arrow Flight SQL.

- Experience with SQL engines, databases, data platforms, or source connectors.

- BI interoperability experience with Power BI, Tableau, Excel, or similar tools, including collaboration with partner engineering teams.

- Knowledge of OAuth, OIDC, TLS, enterprise authentication, metadata discovery, or query pushdown.

- Cross-platform native build, packaging, release engineering, compatibility certification, or upgrade support experience.

- Observability, production diagnostics, customer escalation, long-running data transfer, cancellation, keepalive, timeout, or proxy experience.

- Contributions to Apache Arrow or other relevant open-source projects.

What we value 

At Dremio, we hold ourselves to high standards when it comes to People, Thinking, and Action. Our Gnarlies (that's what we call our employees) communicate with clarity, drive accountability, and are respectful towards each other. We confront brutal facts and focus on results while operating with a sense of urgency and building a "flywheel". People who like to jump in and drive momentum will thrive in our #GnarlyLife. 

Dremio is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other unlawful factor. 

Dremio is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter. 

Dremio has policies in place to protect the personal information that employees and applicants disclose to us. Please click here to review the privacy notice. 

Important Security Notice for Candidates 

At Dremio, we uphold trust and transparency as paramount values in all our interactions with customers, partners, employees, and the general public. We have been targeted by individuals creating fake domains similar to ours to scam prospects and candidates. Please note that all official communications from us will be from an @dremio.com domain. If you suspect you've been targeted by a scam, it's imperative to report the incident to your local law enforcement agencies. For more information about this type of scam, please refer to Dremio's official statement here .

title: Senior Java Developer
description:
Headquarters: Ghent - Belgium

URL: https://www.twikey.com/jobs 

Are you a driven back-end developer who doesn't wait for instructions, but is already thinking two steps ahead? Who experiments with new technologies and smart solutions alongside the job? Then we want to talk to you.

Straight forward but clear: Twikey isn't looking for someone to just execute. We're looking for someone who thinks, does and keeps going when the going gets tough. 

Because fintech is evolving at breakneck speed. That calls for real ownership and for someone who can dive deep on the technical side to keep innovating and improving our platform. You get plenty in return, such as the freedom and responsibility to deliver your own projects. Thanks in part to our organisational structure, you can shape your ideas in the short term and see the results of your hard work quickly.

Driven by your passion for building scalable, performant and secure back-end systems, you continuously raise the bar for your own skills and for our product.

As a member of our development team you work closely with our CTO, 3 fellow developers and 2 testers on the core of our software application. A small, strong team in which you take on a role with real impact on the future of our product.

- You focus on developing and improving the back-end of our platform, optimising the architecture and data processing while keeping the security and stability of our system in mind. This lets you put your technical skills to full use and come up with innovative solutions.

- With your expertise you'll make valuable suggestions and streamline processes for all our stakeholders, so we can work more efficiently and achieve better results.

- You provide technical support on integration projects with software houses, banks and large companies, solving complex technical problems. That gives you the chance to work on challenging projects and to get in touch with a wide range of technologies and industries.

Once you know our product inside out, there are plenty of challenging projects for you to help build.

What are we looking for in you?

- You are driven, curious and enterprising. Not only in your job, but outside of it too. You have a pro-active attitude and are always a few steps ahead: you spot opportunities, grab them and get to work.

- Technical challenges? You take them on, not because you have to, but because you want to learn . You're a self-starter and quickly get to grips with new technologies, languages or frameworks.

- You understand that a good product is never "finished". You draw energy from that mix of creating and fine-tuning . You think along, question things and keep building new solutions.

- You have experience using AI tools to build integrations. You're actively exploring how AI can contribute to smarter user experiences and more efficient software development. Experience with data analytics is an asset.

- You therefore attach a lot of importance to the security, stability and reliability of a system and know what it takes to get there. You work in a structured, meticulous way and write code that is clean, reusable and easy to test.

- You have demonstrable experience with Java, Go and the Spring framework . Experience with API integrations, web services, Linux or other relevant areas is a plus.

- You have a deep understanding of databases. You don't just know how to use them, you know how they work. You have an opinion on structured, high-quality code, architecture and back-end technologies.

- You have a very good command of English , for smooth collaboration with all colleagues and stakeholders. Dutch is an asset.

- You are based in a time zone within one hour of CET , so your working day overlaps with the team's for the daily stand-ups and close day-to-day collaboration.

- You can work independently and enjoy a small team where switching gears quickly, collaboration and knowledge sharing are central.

Twikey offers you:

- An environment where challenge, innovation and autonomy come first.

- The room to experiment, to challenge and to improve. And we expect you to really take that room.

- An ideal setting if you want to grow fast and healthily, both technically and personally. Training, ownership, taking on new or additional roles based on your talents and interests, ... a lot is possible here, and you're at the wheel!

- A complementary team of more than 35 colleagues who move forward together in a respectful and open atmosphere.

- A motivating workplace with plenty of knowledge and expertise , shared both formally during the daily stand-ups and the weekly Friday call, and informally at the coffee machine.

- Appreciation, openness and critical dialogue. Our Friction Hunter Trophy is an example: every month we celebrate the colleague who made the biggest difference for customers, teammates or internally. Your impact gets noticed!

- A modern workplace with different zones (conference, connect, co-work, concentrate) in a recently built, industrial-style office building. Easy to reach by car, by bike and by public transport on the edge of Ghent, right next to the KBC tower.

- A salary package tailored to your experience and skills, with plenty of extra-legal benefits, a collective bonus system and a cafeteria plan to convert your 13th month as you choose.

- The chance to work in an innovative Belgian fintech scale-up that is active in several countries, in a sector that is growing fast!

A job ad doesn't tell you everything. Our colleagues tell you here what it's really like to work at Twikey.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/twikey-senior-java-developer

title: Customer Value Architect III
description:
Headquarters: Remote, US

About Mixpanel 

Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at mixpanel.com .

About the Team 

The Customer Value Architects team sits inside the revenue organization and owns the connection between what customers buy and what they actually get out of Mixpanel. We turn product usage into measurable business outcomes, working across onboarding, adoption, and renewal to make sure customers see the value they signed up for.

About the Role 

The right candidate is a relationship-first advisor who connects a customer's Mixpanel investment to real outcomes for a defined book of accounts. You'll own the adoption and value plan for each account end to end: understanding why the customer bought Mixpanel, tracking whether they're getting the ROI they expected, and driving the enablement and product usage that gets them there. You'll build trusted relationships with business and technical stakeholders, partner closely with your Account Executive and renewal counterparts, and bring a growing point of view on how customers should think about AI in their product workflows. This role suits someone who can own a project end to end and is ready to start extending their influence beyond their own accounts to the wider team.

Responsibilities 

- Own the value plan for each account in your portfolio, connecting the business problem that led the customer to buy Mixpanel with the outcomes they measure.

- Build relationships with business and technical stakeholders, aligning Mixpanel's capabilities to what customers care about most.

- Run discovery on customer priorities and pain points, and turn what you learn into concrete adoption plans and internal updates.

- Partner with your Account Executive on expansion and your renewal counterpart on renewal execution, bringing the value case and adoption evidence that supports both.

- Lead enablement/best practices sessions on dashboard design, funnel analysis, and retention modeling to grow how deeply and widely a customer uses Mixpanel.

- Monitor usage and health signals and lead business reviews that surface what's working, deepen adoption, and catch risk early.

- Spot underused features and contracted capabilities, and turn them into clear recommendations for the customer.

- Triage product questions and issues, solving what you can and routing the rest to the right team.

- Build a working point of view on a customer's AI maturity, and use Mixpanel's own AI surface to help them build on their product data.

- Coordinate with GTM, Product, and Engineering on escalations, and share what works with the broader Customer Value Architects team.

We're Looking For Someone Who Has 

- 4 - 6 years of experience in customer success, consulting, or a related field supporting B2B SaaS accounts, or equivalent experience.

- A track record of managing relationships across a range of stakeholders, from business partners to technical teams.

- The ability to translate technical concepts, like data models and product metrics, into terms that land with non-technical stakeholders.

- Experience turning product usage into a clear story about customer outcomes and ROI.

- Comfort building and running adoption plans that tie daily work to a customer's larger goals.

- Hands-on experience with AI or agentic tooling beyond casual use, such as MCP-based workflows or LLM copilots.

- A collaborative approach to working across account teams and internal partners to move plans forward.

- Good judgment for prioritizing which accounts and actions need attention first.

Bonus Points For 

- Background in product analytics, growth, or data-driven product development.

- Experience in a technical advisory or professional services capacity.

- Familiarity with analytics instrumentation, event tracking, or data tooling.

#LI-Remote

Benefits and Perks 

- Comprehensive Medical, Vision, and Dental Care

- Mental Wellness Benefit

- Generous Vacation Policy & Additional Company Holidays

- Enhanced Parental Leave

- Volunteer Time Off

- Additional US Benefits: Pre-Tax Benefits including 401(K), Wellness Benefit, Holiday Break

*please note that benefits and perks for contract positions will vary* 

Culture Values 

- Make Bold Bets: We choose courageous action over comfortable progress.

- Innovate with Insight: We tackle decisions with rigor and judgment - combining data, experience and collective wisdom to drive powerful outcomes.

- One Team: We collaborate across boundaries to achieve far greater impact than any of us could accomplish alone.

- Candor with Connection: We build meaningful relationships that enable honest feedback and direct conversations.

- Champion the Customer: We seek to deeply understand our customers’ needs, ensuring their success is our north star.

- Powerful Simplicity: We find elegant solutions to complex problems, making sophisticated things accessible.

Why choose Mixpanel? 

We’re a leader in analytics with over 29,000 customers and $277M invested from prominent investors: like Andreessen-Horowitz, Sequoia, YC, and, most recently, Bain Capital. Mixpanel’s pioneering event-based data analytics platform offers a powerful yet simple solution for companies to understand user behaviors and easily track overarching company success metrics. Our accomplished teams continuously facilitate our expansion by tackling the ever-evolving challenges tied to scaling, reliability, design, and service. Choosing to work at Mixpanel means you’ll be helping the world’s most innovative companies learn from their data so they can make better decisions.

Mixpanel is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity. At Mixpanel, we are focused on things that really matter—our people, our customers, our partners—out of a recognition that those relationships are the most valuable assets we have. We actively encourage women, people with disabilities, veterans, underrepresented minorities, and LGBTQ+ people to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance or other similar laws that may be applicable, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We’ve immersed ourselves in our Culture and Values as our guiding principles for the impact we want to have and the future we are building. 

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/mixpanel-customer-value-architect-iii-1

title: Head of Technology
description:
Headquarters: New York City

URL: https://sanctuary.computer 

We are hiring a Head of Technology for the garden3d creative collective, to lead engineering at Sanctuary Computer and garden3d in the era of agentic computer code.

Original job posting link 

About garden3d 

We are worker owned creative collective, innovating on everything from brands and IRL communities to IoT devices and cross platform apps. We share profit, open source everything, spin out new businesses, and invest in exciting ideas through financial and/or in-kind contributions.

Our client roster includes Google, Stripe, Figma, Hinge, Black Socialists in America, ACLU, Pratt, Parsons, Mozilla, The Nobel Prize, MIT, Gnosis, Etsy & Gagosian.

We’re the software team behind innovative products like The Light Phone & Mill, and we operate a global, decentralized community space collective called Index Space.

We think of our garden3d as collective for creative people, prioritizing a happy, talented, and diverse studio culture. We work on projects that bring value to our world, and we balance deep care for the work we do with a genuine curiosity about life outside of our jobs.

Sanctuary Computer - Development 

At Sanctuary Computer we’re building a different type of technology shop – one that prioritizes close collaboration between the client and the craftsperson.

Our projects range from design-forward websites, to robust web apps, to native mobile development.

XXIX - Design 

When we started XXIX in 2013, we set out to create a different kind of design studio and we’ve thrived because we continually ask what a creative practice can be.

We’re building a radically different kind of organization that values autonomy, growth, transparency, and shared responsibility.

Index - Community 

Index is network of physical spaces all around the world, Index provides space for the exchange of knowledge and tools.

We nurture trust within the creative community through generosity and abundance of ideas and care.

garden3d TK — Media 

At garden3d, we’re in the early stages of building an experimental media company exploring emerging themes related to the evolving landscape of technology, design and culture.

We aim to monetize this outlet, publish books, produce screenplays, and release music.

Plus, our partner organizations

Lightphone 
Mill 
IngredientAI 

⛰️ The Head of Technology Role

The garden3d Head of Technology has one mandate: everything we build works, holds up in production, and gets built the smartest way available to us. We are a house of brands - Sanctuary Computer (development), XXIX (design), Index Space (community), USB Club (digital community), and the garden3d umbrella itself - and a lot of what all of them ship runs on software we wrote. Working in close partnership with our founder & president Hugh Francis, this person sets the engineering standard, and builds the culture that holds it.

You can be based anywhere. A lot of our people are in New York and there's some gravity here, but we already work across timezones and we would happily hire in Europe, Singapore, Chicago, or wherever you are. If you're the right person, we want to hear from you.

This role works with studio leads, developers, designers, project managers and clients across every garden3d vertical.

This person can move between a Rails migration, a Next.js app, a firmware release plan and an agent loop in the same week, and raise the bar on each of them.

They span all of garden3d, but their home base is Sanctuary Computer, where roughly 70% of their time goes. Our development studio is where the engineering standard gets set, and where it either holds or slips: architecture, code review, estimation, and the hardest technical calls on our biggest projects. The other 30% goes to garden3d's broader technology story: how we ship product for USB Club, build with agents across the collective, which tools and platforms we bet on, and what we build for ourselves.

They are also how we get better people. Our work is only as good as the engineers making it, so this person hunts for exceptional talent, sells them on us, and sets them up to do the best work of their careers. The ideal candidate looks at a worker-owned collective with four studios, an open P&L and clients like Google, Stripe, Brooklyn Museum and The Nobel Prize, and sees an engineering practice they can propel among the best in the world.

Responsibilities & Mandates 

️ Systems that hold up 

We build web apps, native apps, data pipelines, content platforms and connected devices for clients who can't afford for them to fall over. This person has engineered complex systems for a long time, and it shows in the architecture they draw before a line is written. They own the technical blueprint on our most important projects, and they make the hard calls on the rest: what to build, what to buy, and what to leave out.

All in on agentic development 

The way software gets built changed, and we intend to be ahead of it. This person is already deep in it: loop engineering, agents running against evals, agents that open their own PRs, and the guardrails that make all of that trustworthy. They make agentic development the default way Sanctuary Computer works, and they can tell the difference between a demo and a system a team can rely on.

Practical engineering 

We strongly prefer convention over configuration, boring technology, and platforms that let a small team ship a lot. TypeScript is the default language, Rails and Phoenix handle what they're best at, and we'd rather deploy to a platform like Render or Heroku than run our own infrastructure. This person practices value engineering: the simplest thing that works, built well, at a cost the client is glad to pay.

Code quality at Sanctuary Computer 

Sanctuary Computer is where our engineering standard lives, so this is where most of their energy goes. They set what good code review looks like, keep our senior developers sharp on architecture and quality, and make sure that bar holds without slowing the team down.

Hiring and empowering the very best 

They are a magnet for exceptional engineers. They know where to find them, how to convince them, and how to give them enough room to do their best work while still holding them to the standard. People who work for this person should get visibly better, and should say so.

Estimation, scoping and delivery 

They make sure our teams can reliably estimate and story point the work ahead, and that we deliver at a pace that meets the dates we promised and protects our margins. When an estimate is wrong, they find out why and fix the process.

The technical voice in new business 

Our clients include Google, Stripe, Figma, Mozilla and The Nobel Prize. This person joins new business calls as the trusted technical consultant, scopes the work, writes the technical side of proposals, and can explain a hard tradeoff to a client's CTO and their CEO in the same meeting.

Hardware sense 

We're the software team behind The Light Phone and Mill, so a good share of our work touches devices. This person doesn't need to be a firmware engineer, but they understand how hardware works, where it constrains the software, and how to plan a project that spans both.

The garden3d technology story 

Across the collective, they decide which tools and platforms we bet on, how every studio uses agents, and which internal tools are worth turning into products. When someone at garden3d asks "how should we build this?", this person has the answer, or knows who does.

Culture 

They model garden3d's values of partnership, curiosity, and accountability. The engineers they lead do the best work of their careers here, because the feedback is honest, the recognition is earned, and the craft rubs off

Special Projects 

In addition to day to day responsibilities, here’s an idea of some of the projects this role may spearhead or support in coming years →

- Making agentic development the default way Sanctuary Computer builds, with loops and evals the whole team trusts

- Setting the shared technical conventions every garden3d studio builds from

- Landing the kind of flagship engineering engagement that changes what people think we do

- Hiring the next generation of the engineering team, across every garden3d studio

- Turning the internal tools and agents we build for ourselves into products

- Partnering with the Head of Design so our own studio websites are as well engineered as they are designed

Qualifications

This is a great opportunity for someone looking to make a significant impact in a growing, dynamic company. Based on the responsibilities of this role, we think the right candidate has the following experience and skills:

Must have: 

- 12+ years building software, at least three of them leading engineers inside a studio, agency, startup or founder-led company

- Deep experience engineering complex systems, shipped and run in production: distributed services, data pipelines, multi-platform products

- A true technology generalist, comfortable across frontend, backend, data, infrastructure and native

- A strong preference for practical engineering: convention over configuration, boring technology, and platforms as a service over bespoke infrastructure

- All in on agentic development: loop engineering, evals, and agents doing real work in a real codebase

- Fluency across most of our stack: React, Next.js, Ruby on Rails, Elixir & Phoenix, Sanity, Postgres, Redis. You won't use all of it every week, but you should be able to review any of it

- Experience as the technical lead in winning work: scoping, estimating and pitching to clients

- A track record of hiring exceptional engineers, and of people who got measurably better working for them

- Hands-on. This person can still write the code, not only review it (and will get on the tools when the need arises)

Nice-to-have: 

- A sense of how hardware works: firmware, embedded systems, IoT, and shipping software for physical products

- Experience in a client services environment (a consultancy, agency or studio)

- Experience in a Sales Engineer or Solutions Architect role

- Open source projects they've started or maintained

- Experience fostering close collaboration between design and engineering teams

- Experience inside a worker-owned, open-book, or otherwise unusual company

- A network in the engineering community: the meetups, the conferences, the people worth hiring

- Interests in design, art, music, food or fashion. We find these people have a well rounded sense of quality

Who you are

The person we’re looking for is happy, relaxed and easy to get along with and appreciates a commitment to a culture of transparency, non-dictatorial leadership styles, and alternative methodologies. They’re flexible on anything except conceits that will lower their usually outstanding work quality. They work “smart” by carefully managing their workflow and team.

How we interview

After you submit your application, a member of our team will reach out. Our interview process starts with an intro call to answer any questions you have about the role and to learn a bit more about your experience and interests.

From there, we’ll follow up with a panel interview call where you get to meet a few members of our team, to openly discuss some of our challenges and ensure your skills and interests align with where we’re going as a business.

For qualified candidates, the process wraps with a reference call, and an offer to follow.

Compensation

This is a permanent leadership role. If this individual exceeds expectations in their first four months, we'll shape the permanent role together, with scope and compensation that grow as the studios and their revenue do. After a period of proven success (12 - 24 months), they become eligible to join our worker ownership program.
